attorneys.name: Domenick Carmagnola
attorneys.practice_type: Employment Law Lawyers in Morristown, NJ
attorneys.bio:
Domenick Carmagnola, a Certified Civil Trial Attorney, concentrates his practice in the areas of labor and employment law representing management and individual defendants in both the private and public sector; non-compete litigation; appellate practice; commercial litigation and business disputes. His practice involves counseling on, and litigation of, all types of labor and employment matters including discrimination claims, sexual harassment claims, breach of contract, whistleblower, public policy and employment-at-will claims, restrictive covenant and trade secret matters, business torts, NLRB claims and ERISA claims. He also provides advice concerning company policies and procedures, training of employees and performs internal corporate investigations. His firm is the New Jersey member of Worklaw® Network, a network of independent law firms that focus their practices exclusively in the area of labor and employment law.

He is a Past President of the New Jersey State Bar Association (NJSBA) having served in that position from May 2021 to May 2022. He has been an active member of the NJSBA for many years. He served as a member of the NJSBA Board of Trustees from 2008 to 2014 and as an officer from 2015 to 2023. He was the Chair of the NJSBA Labor and Employment Section from 2011-2013 and is an Editor Emeritus of the NJSBA Labor and Employment Law Quarterly, having previously served as Editor-in-Chief, Managing Editor and Editorial Board member. He is also a Past President of the Sidney Reitman Labor and Employment Law American Inn of Court (2001-2007). He is a past President of the Essex County Bar Association (ECBA) (2002-2003), having also served ECBA as Vice-President, Treasurer, Secretary and a Trustee.

Domenick has received the recognition of his peers throughout his legal career. Among his many honors and awards, he has been named to New Jersey Monthly magazine's Super Lawyers list: New Jersey Super Lawyers: 2005 through 2023; Top 10 New Jersey Super Lawyers: 2007, 2009-2015, 2020, 2023; Top 100 New Jersey Super Lawyers: 2005-2023.

Additionally, The Best Lawyers in America, named Domenick "Top 40 Lawyers Under 40" by the New Jersey Law Journal in 2002 and he was the recipient of the NJBA Young Lawyers Division "Young Lawyers of The Year: Professional Achievement Award" in 1998.

*The Super Lawyers list is issued by Thomson Reuters. See the Super Lawyers website for a description of the selection methodology and other information about Super Lawyers (https://www.superlawyers.com/about/selection_process.html). No aspect of this advertisement has been approved by the Supreme Court of New Jersey.

Domenick is a frequent lecturer on labor and employment, trade secrets and restrictive covenant matters. He co-authored the chapter on "Employment Torts" in the Desk Reference Book, Business Torts Litigation (ABA 1992, 1999 and 2004) and was an Editor/Chapter Co-Author of the ABA publication Employment Litigation Handbook (ABA, 1998) Desk Reference and was an Editor/Chapter Author of New Jersey Labor and Employment Law, published by New Jersey ICLE (ICLE, 1998 and 2005). He was an Associate Editor of the ECBA book, Traps for the Unwary (ECBA, 1997) and served as Chair of ECBA History Committee that compiled a book celebrating the 100th anniversary of the Essex County Bar Association. He also served as Special Editor of the Employment Law issue of New Jersey Lawyer, the Magazine published in April 1999.

attorneys.firm_name: Weinberger Divorce & Family Law Group, LLC
attorneys.practice_type: Family and Matrimonial Law Lawyers in Parsippany, NJ
attorneys.bio:
Dianna C. Cavaliere is a family law and divorce attorney at Weinberger Divorce & Family Law Group LLC in New Jersey. She received her Juris Doctorate from Seton Hall University School of Law in 1999. While attending law school Ms. Cavaliere was chosen to be a member of the Seton Hall Center for Social Justice where she provided legal aid services in the areas of matrimonial and family law to local Newark, New Jersey residents. After Ms. Cavaliere's graduation from law school she served as a judicial law clerk to the Honorable Robert J. Passero, J.S.C., Assignment Judge of the Superior Court of New Jersey, Passaic County. Prior to attending law school Ms. Cavaliere received her undergraduate degree, a Bachelor of Science, in Business Administration from Montclair State University in 1996.

Ms. Cavaliere has successfully handled a variety of cases in her practice of family and matrimonial law over the last decade. Ms. Cavaliere has experience with all facets of family law litigation, including contested issues of custody, parenting time, child support, alimony and equitable distribution of assets. Ms. Cavaliere is also a certified divorce mediator and has provided mediation services to clients who have chosen to work collaboratively on resolving their family and matrimonial issues.

Since 2006, Ms. Cavaliere has volunteered her time to serve as a panelist in the Early Settlement Panel Program in the Essex County Family Court.

In March 2010 Ms. Cavaliere was recognized as a "New Jersey Super Lawyers - Rising Star"*.

attorneys.practice_type: Family Law Lawyers in Parsippany, NJ
attorneys.bio:
Heejae Chang is an Associate at the Williams Law Group, LLC and devotes the majority of her litigation to Family Law. Heejae exclusively practices family law and related matters, including all aspects of divorce, separation, custody and parenting time, relocation, emergent applications, alimony and child support, equitable distribution, prenuptial agreements, separation agreements, mediation, arbitration, domestic violence, and post-judgment matters. Heejae is compassionate and strives to make what is often a very stressful and taxing time as smooth as possible for her clients. Heejae develops a professional and meaningful relationship with her clients and upholds the highest levels of professionalism, respect, and diligence in her practice. While Heejae is very compassionate, she is just as fierce in her advocacy and fights wholeheartedly for her clients’ interests.

Heejae received her Juris Doctor (JD) degree from George Mason – Antonin Scalia Law School, where she served as a student advocate attorney for the Mental Illness Law Clinic and assisted the Assistant County Attorney for commitment hearings. Heejae received her Bachelor of Arts (BA) degree from Rutgers University, where she graduated summa cum laude. Heejae prides herself on the relationships she is able to forge with her clients and on zealously advocating for her clients and for the best interests of their children. Heejae is honest and transparent in her representation. Heejae discusses all options with her clients and possible outcomes and works fervently to create the best legal strategy for each of her clients that optimizes their chances of obtaining what they want.

attorneys.name: P. John Chen
attorneys.practice_type: Business Administration Lawyers in Palisades Park, NJ
attorneys.bio:
P. John Chen is a graduate of Brooklyn Law School, during which he interned with a judge of the New York State Supreme Court and a judge of the United States Bankruptcy Court - Eastern District of New York. After law school, he worked as an associate attorney at boutique law firms in the New York City area where he gained experience in litigation and transactional matters. John is currently admitted in the states of New York and New Jersey, as well as the federal District Courts for the Eastern and Southern Districts of New York, and the federal District Court of New Jersey.

Prior to his admission to the Bar, John worked for property management firms and was involved with managing and developing a diverse real estate portfolio including both commercial and residential properties in New York and New Jersey.

At KLP, John specializes in prosecuting and defending complex commercial litigation involving breach of contract, breach of fiduciary duty, partnership disputes, fraud, employment, and shareholder disputes and derivative actions.

Fueled by over a decade of experience in real estate management, John is thoroughly well-versed in real estate-related issues including landlord & tenant matters, commercial and residential leasing, and numerous transactions. John continues to provide counseling to property owners on how to best manage their properties with cost-effective measures to maximize their investment returns.

John's client-centric approach accounts for the circumstances and needs of each client to best determine an effective course of action that attains their goals. John's clients find him to be proactive and thoughtful as he often advises them on risk mitigation and when to take a preventative approach to address a problem before it festers. His efforts have resulted in awards of over a million dollars on behalf of his clients.

Awards and Honors

Honors

Million Dollar Advocates Forum

attorneys.name: Celina M. Cho
attorneys.practice_type: Immigration Lawyers in Palisades Park, NJ
attorneys.bio:
Celina Cho is a partner, leading the immigration department at Kim, Lim & Partners. Ms. Cho's practice is exclusively in the areas of immigration and nationality law before US Citizenship & Immigration Services, US Immigration Court, US Department of Labor, US Department of State, Board of Immigration Appeals, Administrative Appeals Office, and Board of Alien Labor Certification Appeals. Ms. Cho has entirely dedicated to serving individuals and businesses of all sizes from diverse industries in all aspects of immigration. She frequently represents multi-national conglomerates and their U.S. entities in complex business immigration matters.

Ms. Cho successfully represented over 7,000 clients across the nation and from foreign countries including employment-based and family-sponsored immigration, all types of non-immigrant visas, naturalization, waivers of inadmissibility, appeals to BIA, AAO and BLACA, and removal proceedings.

"All I do IMMIGRATION and I do it very well!" As a result of her dedication to excellence in the practice of immigration law, Ms. Cho is recognized as a prominent immigration attorney in the Korean-American community. Ms. Cho has been invited to radio shows as a weekly regular guest speaker on immigration since 2009.

Immigration law is complex and the process may be frustrating at times. KCL immigration team understands the challenges you are experiencing and here we are to assist you: With our exclusive immigration law expertise and dedication to excellence, we advocate your right for the best possible outcome you deserve in each immigration case.

attorneys.name: Corrin A. Cicoria
attorneys.practice_type: Employment Law Lawyers in Roseland, NJ
attorneys.bio:
Corrin Cicoria is a Managing Associate at Resnick Law Group, P.C.

Corrin has devoted her career to being an advocate for employees who face discrimination, harassment, and retaliation in the workplace. She has worked on cases involving whistleblowers, hostile work environments, workplace accommodations, family and medical leave, negligent hiring and retention, and much more. Corrin believes everyone deserves to work in an environment free of discrimination, harassment, and retaliation and loves being the voice for employees who have been wronged.

Corrin has been working in the employment law sector for employees for over 25 years and has developed a thorough understanding of New Jersey’s employment laws. Her experience spans the entirety of the legal process, from a case’s inception all the way to trial. Her personal, client-focused approach and insightful legal arguments quickly earned the respect of the Managing Partner and her co-workers. Her efforts have been pivotal in numerous trial victories and favorable settlements.

In addition, her decades of law practice management skills allow her to supervise, mentor, and guide co-workers and colleagues. These skills are vitally important to the productivity and efficiency of the firm.

Prior to joining Resnick Law Group, Corrin earned an Associate Degree in Paralegal Studies and a Bachelor of Arts from Montclair State University where she graduated cum laude. She then received her Juris Doctor from Elisabeth Haub School of Law – Pace University where she graduated cum laude.

attorneys.name: Vincent T. Cieslik
attorneys.practice_type: Business Litigation Lawyers in Mt. Laurel, NJ
attorneys.bio:
As Co-Chair of the firm's Business and Banking Group and a Shareholder in the firm's Commercial Litigation and Health Care Groups, Vince focuses his practice in the representation of individuals, small businesses, not-for-profits and large corporations in complicated and often high-risk litigation. Vince's areas of expertise are in commercial litigation, health care law, and estate law.

Vince provides his clients with a sophisticated, nuanced approach to solving problems that reflects an understanding of the concerns of modern business. He counsels clients in pre-litigation matters, and seeks to assist clients in resolving disputes and problems at the early stages, through a common sense and real-world approach to business solutions, in order to avoid adverse publicity, minimize the risk of adverse litigation, and save the time and costs of expensive litigation. Vince's trial experience allows him to advise clients on the potential liabilities they face, analyze risk, and devise a strategy to best protect the client and its interests.

Experience:

Complex Civil, Commercial, and Estate Litigation

Defense of corporations and officers in securities litigation alleging hundreds of millions of dollars in damages, and in civil actions related to ongoing criminal/civil investigations and charges.

Experience handling high risk and complex litigation, in the areas of securities, securities fraud, banking, real estate, franchise, employment, and complex personal injury litigation.

Estate litigation related to estate administration, guardianship litigation, and related real estate law.

Experience handling complicated civil and commercial litigation related to non-competes, shareholder disputes, franchise litigation, banking, and other commercial matters.

Health Business and Banking Care

Representation of companies, physicians, pharmacists, therapists, and health care companies in a wide variety of legal disputes.

Vince has experience handling Medicaid and Medicare fraud cases, whistleblower/qui tam disputes, and complex reimbursement disputes concerning physicians, hospitals and governmental entities.

He has assisted for profit and not-for-profit companies with reimbursement disputes and audits with state and federal agencies.

Has handled complex and extensive civil and criminal claims related to state and federal reimbursement.

Business and Banking

Representation in transaction and litigation matters pertaining to commercial loans, real estate development, construction and various other types of matter

attorneys.name: Angelo Cifelli Jr.
attorneys.firm_name: Piro Zinna Cifelli Paris & Genitempo LLC
attorneys.practice_type: Land Use Government Lawyers in Nutley, NJ
attorneys.bio:
Angelo Cifelli, Jr., a partner at Piro Zinna Cifelli Paris & Genitempo, has advised many New Jersey governmental entities during the past three decades, specializes in land use, environmental matters, complex real estate transactions, governmental and corporate matters. He has served as a Special Counsel to the Nutley Board of Education regarding land use issues and presently represents the Essex Regional Health Commission. Cifelli has served as counsel to the Franklin Township Planning Board, and as a review attorney for Pascack Community Bank and currently serves as a Review Attorney for Lakeland Bank. He has served as counsel to the Newark Zoning Board of Adjustment since 1982. He currently serves as special counsel to the Township of Nutley for Land Use matters. Cifelli served two terms as an Essex County Freeholder. He has also been a member of the Essex County District Ethics Committee. The Fordham University and New York Law School graduate clerked in Essex County for one year before entering private practice with the firm Giannone & Capone and then establishing a general practice of law in 1978. He joined Piro Zinna in 1982.

attorneys.practice_type: Workers Compensation Lawyers in Freehold, NJ
attorneys.bio:
Patrick Cimino is an attorney in the firm’s Workers’ Compensation Department, where he practices exclusively in representing injured workers. With extensive experience handling traumatic injury and occupational exposure claims, Patrick is committed to advocating for the rights of those injured on the job.

Before dedicating his career to injured workers, Patrick practiced insurance defense, giving him valuable insight into the strategies used by employers and insurers. He graduated Cum Laude from West Virginia University in 2009 with a Bachelor of Science and earned his Juris Doctor from the West Virginia University College of Law in 2012, where he served as an editor of the West Virginia Law Review.

Patrick is admitted to practice in New Jersey and brings a wealth of knowledge and a client-focused approach to every case he handles.

attorneys.name: Melissa Cipriano Esq.
attorneys.practice_type: Family and Matrimonial Law Lawyers in West Caldwell, NJ
attorneys.bio:
Ms. Cipriano graduated from Nova Southeastern University, Shepard Broad Law Center with a Juris Doctorate Degree. Ms. Cipriano obtained a Master's of Business Administration from Fairleigh Dickinson University. She graduated from Wells College.

Ms. Cipriano is admitted to practice law in New Jersey, New York and Florida. She is also admitted to the United States Supreme Court, the United States Court of Appeals 3rd Circuit, the United States District Court for the District of New Jersey, and the Southern and Eastern Districts of New York.

Ms. Cipriano volunteers on both the Morris County and Essex County Matrimonial Early Settlement Panels. She has tried numerous matrimonial cases to completion and is also a qualified family law mediator. In addition Ms. Cipriano has taken on the role of Parenting Coordinator. Her tremendous experience assisting families through contentious situations affords her a keen insight into problem solving for families in regards to both economic issues and parenting time concerns. She uses her vast experience to help families move through what may seem to be insurmountable obstacles. She also taps on her business sensibilities to assist owners as they untangle their business interests for their marital concerns.

She opened the firm in 2003 and the office has been in West Caldwell since 2007.

Ms. Cipriano was honored as a "Best of New Jersey Among our Most Distinguished Americans of Italian Descent" and conferred the "Stivale D'Italia Award of Excellence" by the Italian Tribune for her "honesty, integrity and dedication to fair and ethical business practices" and her "outstanding reputation as a Woman Whose Word is Her Bond".

Ms. Cipriano is a member of the New Jersey State Bar Association and the New Jersey Association for Justice. She is also a member of the Florida State Bar Association and New York State Bar Association.

attorneys.name: John E. Clancy Esq.
attorneys.practice_type: Matrimonial Lawyers in Whippany, NJ
attorneys.bio:
Mr. Clancy has been a member of the firm since its inception, and has been a partner since 2012. He focuses exclusively on matrimonial and family law matters. He is admitted to practice in the State of New Jersey and the U.S. District Court of New Jersey. From 2013-2015 Mr. Clancy received the honor of being included in the Super Lawyers Rising Stars* list published by Thomson Reuters, relative to being a divorce attorney. Mr. Clancy also is an approved family law economic mediator pursuant to R. 1:40-12. Mr. Clancy handles all family law, divorce and related matters. Mr. Clancy also has extensive experience in issues surrounding grandparent visitation, high net worth divorces and same sex marriage. Mr. Clancy volunteers and sits on the Morris County Early Settlement Panel for pending divorce cases in the Superior Court.

Mr. Clancy also has extensive experience appealing family matters, which has resulted in several successful unpublished cases and two published cases known as Elrom v. Elrom 439 N.J. Super. 424, 434 (App. Div. 2015), and Major v. Maguire, 218 N.J. 530 (2015) (Landmark NJ Supreme Court Grandparent Visitation Case).

Mr. Clancy is a resident of Morris County and is the Treasurer of the Board of Directors of his Homeowner's Association.

attorneys.name: John E. Clark
attorneys.practice_type: Lawyers in Montclair, NJ
attorneys.bio:
John E. Clark, 67, of Montclair, NJ, one of the original founding members of Clark Guldin Attorneys at Law, passed away on Sunday, November 26, 2023.

A graduate of Rutgers University and Rutgers’ School of Law, John used his strong work ethic, personal charm, and professionalism to fashion a law career that spanned nearly three decades.

Prior to practicing law, John was involved in various businesses, including managing a specialty contracting firm in New York, and other ventures including restaurants and specialty food marketing. He began his career in the construction industry as a project manager for a New York City developer. Thereafter, he graduated with honors from Rutgers University and later obtained his law degree.

John established Clark Guldin Attorneys at Law in November 2010. Mr. Clark concentrated his practice in the areas of construction law and litigation, business law, and business litigation and dispute resolution, and provided counseling and advice to businesses and individuals concerning a wide range of business ventures, transactions, and disputes. He was admitted to practice in the state and federal courts in New York and New Jersey. Prior to founding the Firm, John was a Member of Epstein Becker & Green, a 400-lawyer national law firm headquartered in New York, where he led the construction law practice in New York, New Jersey, and the Northeast. Prior to EBG, John was for two years the Vice President & Chief Counsel of New Jersey Schools Development Authority, brought in as part of the agency reforms instituted by the then-newly elected Governor Jon S. Corzine. Prior to his stint at NJSDA, John practiced law at Lowenstein Sandler PC. In addition to fierce advocacy, John frequently lectured on construction law topics and has been an adjunct professor of philosophy at his alma mater, Rutgers University. He was a Fellow of the Construction Lawyers Society of America.

John was hard-working, kind-hearted, intelligent, thoughtful and valued his family and close friends immensely. He used empathy, practicality, and common sense to make connections. John was good at networking; he remembered people’s names and what was important to them.

John Edward Clark was born November 8, 1956 in Kearny, NJ. He spent much of his youth in Florida until he moved to New Jersey at the age of 22.

John had a deep love for the arts, especially classical music and Beethoven. He held season tickets to Carnegie Hall. He traveled extensively, often enjoying performances around the globe. Among his favorite destinations were London, Greece and New Orleans. John loved baseball and the New York Mets. He was most happy when enjoying a good meal with good company with an even better bottle of wine.

attorneys.name: Christine C. Cockerill
attorneys.practice_type: Family law Lawyers in Woodbury, NJ
attorneys.bio:
Christine C. Cockerill grew up in the nearby community of Wallingford/Media, Pennsylvania and has been a resident of Gloucester County for the past 29 years. Her husband, Stephen, is a lifelong resident of Barnsboro, New Jersey.

After graduating with honors from Villanova University in 1990, Ms. Cockerill pursued her law degree at Villanova University School of Law. Ms. Cockerill served as summer law clerk in 1991 in the Federal Court, Eastern District of Pennsylvania, to the Honorable Charles Weiner. As a third-year law student, Ms. Cockerill was certified by the Supreme Court of Pennsylvania to prosecute domestic violence cases for Delaware County Legal Aid. She was the recipient of the Wapner, Newman & Wigrizer Award for Excellence in Trial Advocacy in 1993. She received her Juris Doctor degree from the Villanova University School of Law in 1993.

After graduation, Ms. Cockerill went on to serve as law clerk to the Honorable John D'Amico, Jr., Chancery Division, Family Part, Monmouth County, for the 1993-94 term. Since the conclusion of her clerkship, her practice has been devoted to family law, complex matrimonial litigation, interstate and international support and custody issues, and assisted reproductive technology law.

In 1998, Ms. Cockerill was named Young Lawyer of the Year by the New Jersey State Bar Association. She received the Award of Merit from the National Center for Missing and Exploited Children in 1998 as well. Ms. Cockerill received the Woman in Law Award from the Gloucester County Commission on Women in 2002, and the E. Henrietta Roesler, Esquire Women in Law Award, from the Gloucester County Bar Association Women in Law Committee, in 2010.

Ms. Cockerill has served as a Matrimonial Early Settlement Panelist in Monmouth, Camden, Salem and Gloucester Counties. She is a member of the Gloucester County and New Jersey State Bar Associations, as well as the Family Law Section of the New Jersey State Bar Association. Ms. Cockerill served as Trustee for the Gloucester County Bar Association, from 2001-2007, and as Co-Chairperson for the Gloucester County Family Law Committee from 2003 to 2016. She has acted as a presenter for the Putting Children First Seminars in the Gloucester County Family Court.

Ms. Cockerill served on the New Jersey State Bar Association Family Law Executive Committee (FLEC) during 2011-2012. She is currently a member of the Statewide MESP Panel Chair Committee on appointment from FLEC.

In connection with her assisted reproductive technology practice, Ms. Cockerill represents clients for adoptions, gestational carrier agreements, donor egg agreements, and establishment of parental rights and status after gestational carrier birth. She is a Fellow of the Academy of Adoption and Assisted Reproduction Technology Attorneys.

In addition to her family law and assisted reproductive technology practice, Ms. Cockerill is a New Jersey Court Rule 1:40 Approved Mediator, and accepts mediation clients for family law issues including, but not limited to, custody, support, equitable distribution of property, dissolution of marriages and civil unions.

Ms. Cockerill has volunteered additional time in service to the bench and bar, as a Member of the Gloucester County Domestic Violence Advisory Committee, the Vicinage Liaison Committee on Best Practices, the District IV Ethics Committee and the New Jersey State Bar Association Speaker's Bureau. She has volunteered both on the board, and as a speaker for Laws of Separation and Divorce Workshops provided through the Center for People in Transition community project, at Rowan College of South Jersey, Gloucester County.

Christine C. Cockerill has presented in several programs offered through the Gloucester County Legal Education Association. She is an active member of her parish church, Incarnation in Mantua, New Jersey, where she taught in the Parish Religious Education Program for over 20 years.

Honors

Recipient of the Wapner, Newman & Wigrizer Award for Excellence in Trial Advocacy, 1993

Young Lawyer of the Year by the New Jersey State Bar Association, 1998

Award of Merit from the National Center for Missing and Exploited Children, 1998

Woman in Law Award from the Gloucester County Commission on Women, 2002 - Present

E. Henrietta Roesler, Esquire Women in Law Award, from the Gloucester County Bar Association Women in Law Committee, 2010 - Present

attorneys.name: Douglas L. Cody Esq.
attorneys.practice_type: Military Justice Lawyers in Hammonton, NJ
attorneys.bio:
Douglas Cody graduated from Villanova University in 1992, and was commissioned a Second Lieutenant in the U.S. Marine Corps. He served on active duty in a variety of assignments as a Marine Infantry Officer until 1995, when he was selected for the Marine Corps Funded Law Education Program. Mr. Cody attended Rutgers School of Law and graduated with honors in 1998.

Mr. Cody served as a Federal prosecutor and trial defense counsel in all types of major felony criminal cases. Additionally, while serving in the military law branch in the Pentagon, he was responsible for providing legal advice to Commandant of the Marine Corps, Department of Defense Office of General Counsel, and Office of the Secretary of Defense in matters of military law pertaining to the conduct of the Global War on Terror.

Professional Experience and Representative Cases:

Military Justice and Criminal Law

Personally prosecuted over 200 felony criminal cases and innumerable misdemeanors.

Successfully litigated dozens of contested Federal jury trials and bench trials involving charges of manslaughter, rape and sexual assault, child rape, molestation and abuse, maiming and aggravated assault, larceny, conspiracy, and felony drug possession and trafficking.

As Chief Trial Counsel for Marine Corps Base, Quantico, Virginia, supervised several junior prosecuting attorneys.

Defended scores of Marines charged with grave felonies before courts-martial and achieved, over a period of years, a rate of dismissal or acquittal of over 80 percent.

Reviewed Naval Criminal Investigative Service reports of investigation for matters of interest and concern to various Government agencies.

Monitored all high visibility investigations, courts-martial, and adverse administrative proceedings, and provided appropriate legal advice to the Commandant of the Marine Corps and Secretary of the Navy on same.

Since 2004, defended nearly one hundred private clients charged with a variety of crimes and offenses under the New Jersey criminal code.

As the public defender for Mullica Township, New Jersey, represented dozens of indigent defendants in the municipal court charged with offenses including motor vehicle violations, drunk-driving, domestic violence, drug offenses and violent assaults.

Civil, Administrative and Employment Law

Served as Government counsel in numerous administrative hearings concerning the involuntary separation of members from the Armed Forces for misconduct and substandard performance of duty, and represented dozens of service members before such hearings.

Investigated and prepared replies to special interest and Congressional correspondence concerning formal administrative investigations and adverse administrative personnel actions.

Administered officer misconduct cases including evaluation of reports of misconduct; providing legal review and recommendations regarding appropriate case disposition; monitoring criminal and administrative proceedings involving Marine Corps officers; and preparing documents to effect delays of promotion, removal from promotion lists, revocation of appointments, convening of administrative separation boards, and officer resignations.

Formulated advisory opinions and made legal recommendations to the Board for Correction of Naval Records regarding individual petitions alleging error or injustice in official administrative records.

Provided legal review of Defense Department policies, directives, procedures, letters of instruction, memoranda of understanding, and inter-service support agreements concerning military law and related matters.

On behalf of a private company, prepared and negotiated a commercial lease of the Salem Terminal Facilities with the South Jersey Port Corporation.

Represented employee in class action lawsuit under the Fair Labor Standards Act of 1938 and New Jersey Wage and Hour Law.

Successfully represented a New Jersey corporation in its challenge of the award of a municipal demolition project under the Local Public Contract Law of the State of New Jersey.

Effectively represented a New Jersey plaintiff in lawsuit alleging common law and consumer fraud in a dispute over the sale and transfer of real property.

Achieved dismissal of all charges on behalf of New Jersey local elected officials wrongfully accused of bribery by political opponents.

Profitably advocated the interests of a beneficiary in a dispute with the trust division of a national bank over the management of real property and handling of environmental hazards.

Negotiated a particularly favorable settlement on behalf of a New Jersey trucking corporation sued by a national banking institution for liability upon the commercial loan of a predecessor company.

Handled dozens of matrimonial actions that presented the full panoply of family law issues including cause of action, custody of children, child and spousal support, equitable distribution of property and domestic violence.

attorneys.name: Jill R. Cohen Esq.
attorneys.firm_name: The Law Office Of Jill R. Cohen
attorneys.practice_type: Criminal Defense Lawyers in Haddonfield, NJ
attorneys.bio:
Jill Cohen has been fighting for citizen’s right since graduating top in her class from Law School. She is kind, fearless, attentive, aggressive and she is great at what she does.

Since 1983 as a Philadelphia Assistant District Attorney she tried numerous felony and juvenile cases. She also was an appellate lawyer in the office which equipped her to be an expert at criminal law and to fight all the way for her position.

After moving to New Jersey she was appointed Assistant Camden County Prosecutor where she tried and won jury trials in drug cases, murders, aggravated sexual assaults, domestic violence and other serious crimes. She was well respected and liked by judges, court personnel and colleagues.

She became equipped to do what she loved – representing citizens of New Jersey who were accused of the most serious crimes, and small offenses throughout the State in the Municipal Courts, the trial courts and in the appellate courts. As a criminal defense attorney she has tried and won trials before juries in Gloucester County, Atlantic County, Burlington County and Camden County. No case is too complex or too little for her to fight it until getting the result that you want.

In addition to criminal law she has represented those wrongfully accused of domestic violence gaining dismissals of many Temporary Restraining Orders. She understands that restraining orders are used offensively by plaintiffs who seek to punish a spouse or boyfriend for things that they just didn’t do.

If you are charged with any crime in New Jersey she is fearless yet respectful and stands up to any lawyer or even a judge to fight for her beliefs and your rights.

attorneys.bio:
Steven R. Cohen is a name partner and shareholder in Selikoff & Cohen.

Steven has represented unions and union members before the New Jersey Supreme Court and other state trial and appellate courts, the Public Employment Relations Commission, the Office of Administrative Law, the State Board of Education, and other state agencies as well as in TEACHNJ and other teacher tenure proceedings for more than 45 years. Areas of expertise include workplace discrimination and accommodation claims, union contract negotiation, tenure rights claims, unfair labor practices, union representation petitions, tenure charges and other disciplinary matters.

Steven was Chair of the New Jersey State Bar Association's Labor and Employment Law Section from 2009-2011, and is also a former Master of the Sidney Reitman Employment Law American Inn of Court. He is currently a member of the Section's Executive Committee and Sidney H. Lehmann Award Committee, as well as the State Bar Association's Legislative Committee. attorneys.name: Paul D. Colangelo
attorneys.practice_type: Lawyers in Camden, NJ
attorneys.bio:
In 2023, Paul joined DeCosmo Law as an Associate Attorney. Paul has been practicing law for 30 years. He served two County Prosecutors over the course of a 25-year career from which he recently retired, working as an Assistant Prosecutor, Trial Section Chief, Deputy First Assistant Prosecutor, and First Assistant Prosecutor. In those capacities, Paul tried over 60 cases, prosecuting individuals charged with possession and/or distribution of drugs, aggravated sexual assault, sexual assault, vehicular homicide, assault by auto, kidnapping, aggravated assault, official misconduct, robbery and murder. He is Certified by the New Jersey Supreme Court as a Criminal Trial Attorney. There are over 40,000 Attorneys in the State of New Jersey. Less than three hundred (300) have been approved by the Supreme Court of New Jersey as a Certified Criminal Trial Attorney. The Supreme Court vets attorneys to ensure that only those with substantial criminal trial experience receive the designation, obtaining as part of this process superior references from both judges and opposing counsel, and administering a comprehensive written examination on the subject of criminal trial law which the attorney must pass.

Before beginning as a career prosecutor in New Jersey, Paul served for 4 years in the United States Air Force as an Assistant Staff Judge Advocate assigned to Pope Air Force Base in North Carolina. He dedicated the first two years of his assignment to military prosecution, the latter two to defense. Paul prosecuted and/or defended both enlisted and officer personnel charged domestic violence assault, possession and/or distribution of drugs, rape, theft, as well as military-specific crimes such as desertion.

Paul has extensive experience in litigation. After graduating from the Rutgers University School of Law in Camden, New Jersey, he became a Superior Court Judicial Law Clerk to the Honorable George H. Stanger, Jr., in the Criminal Part. After completing his military service, Paul was hired as an Assistant Prosecutor in the Salem County Prosecutor's Office, prosecuting both juvenile and adult cases to verdict. He continued as a career prosecutor with the Gloucester County Prosecutor's Office, continuously trying cases, but also serving as Legal Advisor to the major investigative units of that office, specifically the Major Crimes, Narcotics, Sexual Assault, and Professional Standards, or Internal Affairs, Units. Paul's deep experience with each of these units provides him with knowledge of police investigative tactics and techniques, forensic interviewing techniques, Fourth Amendment search and seizure procedure for challenging illegal searches and seizures by the police, and police disciplinary issues.

attorneys.name: Bernard J. Cooney
attorneys.practice_type: Lawyers in Montclair, NJ
attorneys.bio:
Bernard is a former federal prosecutor with a focus on complex commercial litigation, white-collar criminal defense, and government investigations.

Before joining Clark Guldin, Bernard served more than a decade as a federal prosecutor in the U.S. Attorney’s Office for the District of New Jersey. In this role, he developed extensive experience investigating and prosecuting health care and other white-collar fraud cases and held several supervisory positions. As Chief of the Health Care Fraud Unit, Bernard led criminal and civil prosecutions of complex health care fraud schemes and violations of the Anti-Kickback Statute and the False Claims Act. He also served as Chief of the Government Fraud Unit responsible for government program fraud, including COVID-19 loan fraud and customs evasion, and as Acting Chief of the Opioid Abuse Prevention & Enforcement Unit focused on prosecuting improper diversion of opioids and health care offenses. Bernard also led civil enforcement actions arising from qui tam cases brought by whistleblowers under the False Claims Act.

In addition to his federal prosecutorial experience, Bernard also previously worked as Principal Litigation Counsel at the Financial Industry Regulatory Authority (FINRA).

Prior to his government service, Bernard worked at a leading law firm in New Jersey and New York representing clients in commercial litigation and criminal and regulatory matters. He also served as a law clerk to the Honorable Steven L. Lefelt, New Jersey Superior Court, Appellate Division.

Bernard is also the manager and a board member of his son’s special needs hockey team, the New Jersey Dare Devils.

attorneys.name: Kelly Correnty Esq.
attorneys.practice_type: Social Security Disability Lawyers in Phillipsburg, NJ
attorneys.bio: Kelly Correnty is an experienced attorney who actively practices in both Pennsylvania and New Jersey, focusing in employment, domestic violence, family, and social security disability law. Before entering private practice, Kelly was a law clerk for the Honorable Judge Samuel P. Murray at the Court of Common Pleas of Northampton County, Pennsylvania and prior to her clerkship, was a Judicial Extern with the Honorable Henry S. Perkin of the United States District Court for the United States District Court of Pennsylvania. Kelly is also admitted to practice before the United States District Courts for the Eastern District of Pennsylvania and District of New Jersey. Kelly serves as an Arbitrator for the Northampton County Court of Common Pleas. Beyond her legal practice, Kelly is committed to serving her community. Kelly is an active volunteer with NAMI Lehigh Valley, having served on its Board of Directors, and is a long-time member of the Bethlehem Food Co-Op, having previously served as the Co-Op’s Board Secretary. Kelly is also a member of the Northampton County Bar Association and Warren County Bar Association. Kelly earned her Juris Doctorate from Delaware Law School, where she was on Law Review, serving as its Articles Editor, and graduated with cum laude honors. Kelly holds a Bachelor of Arts where she graduated among the top of her class with the highest honors, summa cum laude. Born and raised in the Lehigh Valley, Kelly is driven by her passion for helping others and her community. She is results-driven, diligent in her work, dedicated to each of her clients, and believes that being a good listener is one of the most important skills an attorney can have. She strives to pursue justice for all of her clients.

attorneys.name: Kevin Michael Costello Esquire
attorneys.practice_type: Employment Lawyers in Mount Laurel, NJ
attorneys.bio:
Kevin Costello was admitted to the Bar in 1991 and is a founding Member of Costello & Silverman, LLC, a full-state Employment, Complex Personal Injury, School Bullying, and Civil Rights trial firm in Mount Laurel. He's one of the approximately just under 3% (as of 2016) of trial lawyers Certified as a Civil Trial Attorney by the New Jersey Supreme Court. He's a former President of the New Jersey Association for Justice (NJAJ) and a former member of the American Association for Justice's (AAJ) Council of Presidents.

Kevin is a founding and present Chair of NJAJ's Employment Section, is the present PAC Chair and a past Education Foundation Chair for NJAJ, and has served as an NJAJ officer since 2011. He has also served as a CLE faculty member for NJAJ for decades, and on the NJAJ Board of Governors since 2006. Presently chairs a number of committees in the NJAJ.

Kevin is a present Trustee of the Camden County Bar Association, is a founding and past Chair of the CCBA's Labor & Employment Committee, has served as a Chair for multiple state and local bar association committees, and has chaired or served as a speaker for in excess of 70 CLE events on trial work, employment, complex personal injury, school rights and civil rights. Kevin is presently the Diversity, Equity & Inclusion Chair for CCBA Committee and, as well, a Chair of the Civil Rights Committee for CCBA.

Kevin has made numerous appearances on local and national radio and television to discuss employment and civil rights and has been published on dozens of occasions on the same subjects. He's spoken often to organized labor organizations, civic groups, advocacy groups and professional associations on civil and employment rights.

He's been named to the Million Dollar Advocates' Forum as well as to the Multi-Million Dollar Advocates' Forum, has been awarded the Roosevelt Nesmith Civil Rights Award by the Southern Burlington County NAACP, the "Champions of Equality" Award" by Garden State Equality, has been named a "Super Lawyer" in Employment Law for nineteen consecutive years, a "Top 100 Trial Lawyers" by The National Trial Lawyers' Association, and has been given a "BV Distinguished Rating in Legal Ability and Ethics Standards" and "BV Distinguished Peer Rating" by Martindale-Hubbell.

Kevin lives in South Jersey with his wife, Sonia, college-student son, Brennan, and two labradoodles who keep everyone on their toes.

attorneys.name: Rachel S. Cotrino
attorneys.firm_name: The Law Office of Rachel S. Cotrino, LLC
attorneys.practice_type: Family Law Lawyers in Hamilton, NJ
attorneys.bio:
Attorney Rachel Cotrino began her legal career as a student at Vermont Law School where she graduated with her Juris Doctor in 2007. That same year she worked as a Law Clerk to the Honorable James Blaney, in the Superior Court of Ocean County. It was here that she had the chance to provide her services to prepare tentative decisions and orders regarding issues of visitation, custody and child support. She was also able to mediate disputes that took place in the Special Civil Part of the court, allowing her to develop skills that she still uses today, including negotiations and mediation. In 2008 went on to work at Gertner Mandel & Peslak as an Associate Attorney.

During her time in legal practice she has continued to dive deeper and deeper into her field, enhancing her knowledge and experience in the topic. She currently resides in Ocean County, New Jersey where she serves those in the local area with the divorce related situations. She puts her focus on this area, allowing her to strive to be the best at what she does, rather than attempting to cover too many areas like countless attorneys do. She is very familiar with matters of child custody, spousal support, property division and more. She shares her insight into these topics through The Family Law Blog that she writes.

Attorney Cotrino eventually decided to open her own practice which she has devoted to matrimonial issues. Her lengthy time in these cases has allowed her to see all sides of a case. She has witnessed first-hand the urgency in these cases, as well as how personal they can be. To her, it is the client that she puts her attention on and she seeks to get to know them and then pursue a solution that can work in their favor. Each case is unique and she believes that service should be tailor made to fit the particular details of each client's situation.

Much of these cases are based off of personal and financial matters and she looks to become thoroughly acquainted with these details of her clients relationship early on. Since divorce can be largely based on these categories, having this foundation from the beginning can allow her to move forward in a more effective manner. In cases such as these it is beneficial to have a lawyer that is not only knowledgeable and experienced, but also sensitive and compassionate to these matters that can often times be trying to address. She looks out for clients at the time of the divorce, along with considering the later ramifications. She looks to find an outcome that works for them in the long run, and when clients are too distraught to address this she can be a strong support system. Call the office for a consultation from an adept lawyer to learn the ways they can work along with you.

attorneys.name: John J. Coughlin
attorneys.practice_type: Lawyers in Moorestown, NJ
attorneys.bio:
John J. Coughlin has been licensed to practice in New Jersey and Pennsylvania State and Federal Courts since 1991. The majority of Mr. Coughlin's practice has focused on general litigation, with emphasis in commercial law and transactions. The experience gained through litigating matters has also provided the insights necessary to counsel clients as they enter into relationships, to gain advantage and avoid litigation over misunderstandings later.

Before forming his own firm, Mr. Coughlin was a Partner in the trial Department of Duane Morris, LLP, a full service international law firm where he spent 11 years litigating a broad range of legal issues for clients as large as fortune 50 Companies and as small as the single business owner or individual. Mr. Coughlin formed his own law firm to reduce the cost of his services while continuing to provide his clients with the level of skill and expertise found in large corporate law firms. The reduced cost also allows for the expanded representation of individual clients for a variety of legal needs.

In addition to his private practice, Mr. Coughlin was appointed by the Supreme Court of New Jersey to serve as Chairperson for the District IIIB Fee Arbitration Committee. In this capacity, Mr. Coughlin presides over a panel of attorneys and public members to decide fee disputes between clients and law firms.

attorneys.name: LaDonna M. Cousins Esq.
attorneys.practice_type: Family Law Lawyers in Parsippany, NJ
attorneys.bio:
LaDonna M. Cousins, Esq. has devoted her practice to matrimonial and family law, including divorce proceedings, post-judgment matters, issues related to custody, parenting time, child support, pre-nuptial agreements, stepparent and adult adoptions, and more. She received her undergraduate degree, a Bachelor of Arts in English and Spanish, from Georgetown University. Thereafter, in 2011, she achieved her Juris Doctorate from Temple University, Beasley School of Law. While attending law school, LaDonna participated in the Trial Advocacy program as well as the Domestic Relations Mediation Clinical, where she was trained in mediation skills and conducted mediation sessions with parties referred by the Family Court. After LaDonna’s graduation from law school, she served as a judicial law clerk to the Honorable Susan F. Maven, J.S.C., of the Superior Court of New Jersey, Atlantic County.

LaDonna is admitted to practice in New Jersey (admitted in 2011) and Pennsylvania (admitted in 2011) and is a member of the New Jersey Bar Association and the Middlesex County Bar Association.

She is also a serving member of the Family Law Executive Committee for the New Jersey State Bar Association for the 2023-2024 term.

LaDonna is honored to have been selected for inclusion in the Super Lawyers Rising Star list for the years 2017 through 2021.

attorneys.name: Therese Cunningham
attorneys.firm_name: Starkey, Kelly, Kenneally, Cunningham, Turnbach & Yannone
attorneys.practice_type: Alternate Dispute Resolution Lawyers in Toms River, NJ
attorneys.bio:
Judge Therese A. Cunningham, PJ Ch (Ret) is a Rule 1:40 qualified mediator and of counsel to the firm. Judge Cunningham served on the New Jersey Superior Court bench from 2015-2025. During her tenure on the court, she served in the Family, Criminal and Chancery Divisions. For more than five years of her judicial service, Judge Cunningham presided over probate and general equity matters in the Chancery Division. She retired as Presiding Judge of the Chancery Division in 2025. Shortly after retirement, the Ocean County Bar Association presented Judge Cunningham with the James D. Clyne Memorial Award for Excellence in the Administration of Justice.

Judge Cunningham started her legal career as a judicial law clerk in Ocean County during the 1990-91 term. Prior to being appointed to the bench, she gained extensive civil litigation experience while employed with Starkey, Kelly, Blaney & White (1991-1998) and King, Kitrick, Jackson & Troncone (2002-2007). While in private practice, Judge Cunningham honed her ADR skills as a volunteer mediator in Ocean and Monmouth Counties and a UM/UIM arbitrator throughout the state.

In addition to her experience in the private sector, Judge Cunningham also has extensive experience as both a prosecutor and defense attorney. She served as a Deputy Attorney General in the Office of Insurance Fraud Prosecutor (1998-2001) and a Senior Assistant Prosecutor in Ocean County (2007-2015), as well as an Assistant Municipal Public Defender in Brick (2002-2007) and Berkeley (2002-2004) Townships.

Judge Cunningham brings her vast and diverse experience to the firm’s alternate dispute resolution practice and stands ready to assist with the resolution of your matter.

attorneys.name: Adelaide Riggi Cutalo
attorneys.firm_name: Sarno da Costa D'Aniello Maceri Webb LLC
attorneys.practice_type: Family Law Lawyers in Roseland, NJ
attorneys.bio:
Adelaide Riggi Cutalo, partner at Sarno da Costa D’Aniello Maceri Webb LLC, devotes her practice exclusively to all aspects of divorce and family law. She is certified by the Supreme Court of New Jersey as a matrimonial law attorney. Her practice includes divorce litigation and mediation, post-judgment litigation, custody and parenting time issues, alimony and child support, pre-nuptial agreements, matrimonial settlement agreements, palimony suits, adoption, domestic violence, and domestic partnership matters. In particular, she is experienced in handling custody and parenting time disputes.

As a mother, wife, and daughter, Adelaide understands the importance of each of her cases and the impacts decisions on such matters can have on all parties involved. She dedicates her time to helping her clients navigate these difficult personal matters while ensuring that the family structure is as protected and minimally impacted as possible. Keeping the larger picture in mind and prioritizing the needs of the children; Adelaide ensures that her clients’ needs are not sacrificed or overlooked in the process. As a seasoned negotiator, she utilizes her experience in and out of the courtroom when settling even the most complex matters.

Adelaide handles complex matrimonial matters, which can involve the engagement of a variety of experts, including forensic accountants, employability experts, real estate and personality appraisers, and custody and substance abuse evaluators. Adelaide has commercial litigation experience and assists clients with the distribution of businesses and professional practices and executive benefits, such as stock options and restricted stock. She counsels clients regarding alimony, child support, custody and parenting time issues, and the equitable distribution of assets.

To complement her family law practice, Adelaide is actively involved in various professional commitments outside of the firm. She has spoken at divorce and family law programs and seminars and authored articles on matrimonial matters. She serves as a Matrimonial Early Settlement Panelist for Somerset County. She has been Co-Chair of the Vincent J. Abruzzese Mock Trial Competition in Somerset County since 2011 and was Co-Chair of the Educational Committee for the Young Lawyers Division, Family Law Section of the New Jersey State Bar Association from 2009 to 2010. Adelaide is also the Immediate Past Chair of the Somerset County Bar Foundation, a nonprofit organization that reaches out to the public and the local legal community to offer programs, services, and funding.

Adelaide served as a judicial clerk to the Honorable James M. Havey, P.J.A.D., Superior Court of New Jersey, Appellate Division. She also held a judicial internship with The Honorable Joseph A. Greenaway, Jr., U.S.D.J., United States District Court, District of New Jersey and a legal internship with the State of New Jersey, Office of Attorney General, Appellate Bureau. While pursuing her law degree, she was the Executive Editor of the New York Law School Journal of Human Rights and was a New York Law School Public Interest Fellow.

attorneys.practice_type: Divorce Lawyers in Morristown, NJ
attorneys.bio:
Laurence J. Cutler has been involved in virtually every activity in which a New Jersey matrimonial lawyer could be involved over the span of his more than four decades of practice exclusively limited to matrimonial law and related matters.

He has been a chairman of the Family Law Section of the New Jersey State Bar Association. He was also a founding fellow of the International Academy of Matrimonial Lawyers; a founding diplomat of the American College of Family Trial Lawyers; and a founding affiliate of the Matrimonial Lawyers Alliance, and currently, is it's director. He has been a member of five New Jersey Supreme Court Committees, and is presently a member of the Supreme Court's Committee on Family Law Arbitration. He has been designated by the New Jersey Supreme Court as a Certified Matrimonial Attorney. He is also a Master in the New Jersey Family Law Inns of Court.

Mr. Cutler is the 1994 recipient of the prestigious Saul Tishler Award of the Family Law Section for his contributions to the advancement of Family Law in the State of New Jersey, and the 2002 recipient of the coveted Alfred C. Clapp Award of the New Jersey Institute for Continuing Legal Education for his outstanding contributions and his ongoing commitment to the advancement of continuing legal education for the New Jersey Bench and Bar.

Mr. Cutler has been included in the prestigious designation of "The Best Lawyers in America*” list by Best Lawyers for many years. He has been selected for inclusion in the New Jersey Super Lawyers* list in the New Jersey Monthly Magazine and Law & Politics Magazine.

Mr. Cutler has written and taught extensively, most notably as an Adjunct Professor of Law at Seton Hall Law School, and as co-author of New Jersey Family Law Practice, a multi-volume treatise used by virtually every family law judge and lawyer in New Jersey.

Mr. Cutler is a court-authorized mediator of family law matters; an arbitrator of family law matters; and a mediator/arbitrator of aviation matters.

Statement

Best Lawyers is the oldest and most respected peer-review publication in the legal profession. A listing in Best Lawyers is widely regarded by both clients and legal professionals as a significant honor, conferred on a lawyer by his or her peers. For more than three decades, Best Lawyers lists have earned the respect of the profession, the media, and the public, as the most reliable, unbiased source of legal referrals anywhere. Best Lawyers is conferred by Woodward/White, Inc.. No aspect of this has been approved by the New Jersey Supreme Court.

Our lists of outstanding attorneys are compiled by conducting exhaustive peer-review surveys in which tens of thousands of leading lawyers confidentially evaluate their professional peers. If the votes for an attorney are positive enough for inclusion in Best Lawyers, that attorney must maintain those votes in subsequent polls to remain on the list for each edition. Lawyers are not permitted to pay any fee to participate in or be included on our lists.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content:
Laurence J. Cutler has been involved in virtually every activity in which a New Jersey matrimonial lawyer could be involved over the span of his more than four decades of practice exclusively limited to matrimonial law and related matters.

He has been a chairman of the Family Law Section of the New Jersey State Bar Association. He was also a founding fellow of the International Academy of Matrimonial Lawyers; a founding diplomat of the American College of Family Trial Lawyers; and a founding affiliate of the Matrimonial Lawyers Alliance, and currently, is it's director. He has been a member of five New Jersey Supreme Court Committees, and is presently a member of the Supreme Court's Committee on Family Law Arbitration. He has been designated by the New Jersey Supreme Court as a Certified Matrimonial Attorney. He is also a Master in the New Jersey Family Law Inns of Court.

Mr. Cutler is the 1994 recipient of the prestigious Saul Tishler Award of the Family Law Section for his contributions to the advancement of Family Law in the State of New Jersey, and the 2002 recipient of the coveted Alfred C. Clapp Award of the New Jersey Institute for Continuing Legal Education for his outstanding contributions and his ongoing commitment to the advancement of continuing legal education for the New Jersey Bench and Bar.

Mr. Cutler has been included in the prestigious designation of "The Best Lawyers in America*” list by Best Lawyers for many years. He has been selected for inclusion in the New Jersey Super Lawyers* list in the New Jersey Monthly Magazine and Law & Politics Magazine.

Mr. Cutler has written and taught extensively, most notably as an Adjunct Professor of Law at Seton Hall Law School, and as co-author of New Jersey Family Law Practice, a multi-volume treatise used by virtually every family law judge and lawyer in New Jersey.

Mr. Cutler is a court-authorized mediator of family law matters; an arbitrator of family law matters; and a mediator/arbitrator of aviation matters.

Best Lawyers

Statement

Best Lawyers is the oldest and most respected peer-review publication in the legal profession. A listing in Best Lawyers is widely regarded by both clients and legal professionals as a significant honor, conferred on a lawyer by his or her peers. For more than three decades, Best Lawyers lists have earned the respect of the profession, the media, and the public, as the most reliable, unbiased source of legal referrals anywhere. Best Lawyers is conferred by Woodward/White, Inc.. No aspect of this has been approved by the New Jersey Supreme Court.

Our lists of outstanding attorneys are compiled by conducting exhaustive peer-review surveys in which tens of thousands of leading lawyers confidentially evaluate their professional peers. If the votes for an attorney are positive enough for inclusion in Best Lawyers, that attorney must maintain those votes in subsequent polls to remain on the list for each edition. Lawyers are not permitted to pay any fee to participate in or be included on our lists.

Methodology

Inclusion in Best Lawyers is based entirely on peer-review. The methodology is designed to capture, as accurately as possible, the consensus opinion of leading lawyers about the professional abilities of their colleagues within the same geographical area and legal practice area. Best Lawyers employs a sophisticated, conscientious, rational, and transparent survey process designed to elicit meaningful and substantive evaluations of the quality of legal services. Our belief has always been that the quality of a peer-review survey is directly related to the quality of its voting pool.

attorneys.name: Richard P. Cushing
attorneys.practice_type: Complex Litigation Lawyers in Annandale, NJ
attorneys.bio:
PRIMARY AREA OF PRACTICE

Richard P. Cushing is a trial and municipal lawyer who specializes in complex litigation land use matters, and the representation of public entities, corporations and insurance companies.

REPRESENTATIVE EXPERIENCE

Representation of Individuals and Business in Complex Litigation. Mr. Cushing regularly represents persons who have sustained severe personal injuries and other substantial losses. He has represented persons who have suffered personal injuries from automobile accidents, construction site accidents, fall downs, defective or dangerous products, fires, and other traumatic incidents. In addition, he has represented individuals of businesses who have suffered losses to their financial assets, property or possessions by virtue of the wrongful actions of corporations, banks, stockbrokerage companies and other large entities. He also represents individuals in estate and trust disputes. Mr. Cushing recently represented a trust that had been looted by a dishonest lawyer. Because the lawyer was in jail, he sued the stockbrokerage company used by the lawyer to sell the trust stock, the banks in which the checks for the sale of the trust assets were deposited and several multinational corporations whose stock was sold. He recovered assets and judgments in excess of one million dollars for the estate. In addition, Mr. Cushing recently represented a young woman who, while having her nails done, sustained a slight cut to her nail bed. It became infected, which led to hospitalization and the development of a severe medical condition. Mr. Cushing recovered a settlement having a value substantially in excess of one million dollars for the woman. He has recovered numerous other substantial verdicts in settlement for individuals.

Representation of Government Entities. Mr. Cushing represents numerous municipalities, school boards and counties as either special counsel or municipal counsel. As municipal counsel, he represents the Town of Clinton (Hunterdon County), the Borough of Washington (Warren County), the Borough of Hampton (Hunterdon County), the Township of East Amwell (Hunterdon County), and the Township of Knowlton (Warren County). He is also attorney for the Delaware Township Municipal Utilities Authority.

In addition, he has been engaged to represent hundreds of municipalities, school boards, counties, authorities and other public entities in claims against them involving harassment, discrimination, civil rights, sexual harassment, housing discrimination, sewer, water, defective, roads and disputes involving police misconduct. He represented a large Bergen County municipality in a two hundred million-dollar claim by a developer who asserted the municipality purposely delayed his development, causing it to fail. He represented the Borough of Bernardsville in a claim against it by a quarry alleging thirty million dollars in loss. After a trial in which the Borough prevailed, the case was successfully defended in the Supreme Courts of New Jersey and the United States. The New Jersey Supreme Court Opinion in the matter has become a landmark case in New Jersey, Bernardsville Quarry v. Bernardsville 129 N.J. 221. Mr.Cushing is the author of "A Survey of Municipal Immunity in New Jersey", 3 Seton Hall L.Rev 416 (1972) and coauthor of "Sewer Service: Possible Anti-Trust Liability?", N.J. Municipalities, Volume 63, No.6, (June 1986).

Mr. Cushing has also been a frequent lecturer to mayors, township governing body members, police chiefs, law enforcement officers and other municipal officials with respect to municipal issues, and has written extensively on public entity issues.

Representation of Insurance Companies. Mr. Cushing is regularly asked by insurance companies to defend the interest of their insureds in public entity cases, complex construction, general liability, fire and fraud cases. Mr. Cushing represented the JUA/MTF, a state chartered insurance organization, in a fraud action where two chiropractors sought nearly fifty-million dollars in recoveries from it. In cooperation with the New Jersey Attorney General's office, Mr. Cushing opposed this and filed counter claims for fraud in violation of the New Jersey Fraud Prevention Act. As a result of his efforts, not only were the chiropractors paid no money, but they paid a $750,000.00 fine and had their licenses suspended.

EDUCATIONAL AND PROFESSIONAL BACKGROUND

Mr. Cushing was born in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania. He attended Boston College and Upsala College, where he received a Bachelor of Arts in 1968. He received a Juris Doctorate, cum laude, from Seton Hall University Law School in 1972 and was admitted to practice that year in New Jersey. He was a member of the Seton Hall Law Review from 1970-1972. He served as a Law Secretary to Justice Mark Sullivan, Supreme Court of New Jersey. He served as an Adjunct Professor of Law at Seton Hall University from 1976-1979. He joined Gebhardt & Kiefer in 1978 and became a partner in 1979.

COMMUNITY AND PROFESSIONAL AFFILIATIONS

Mr. Cushing is a member of the Hunterdon County and New Jersey State Bar Associations, the New Jersey Trial Lawyers and the New Jersey Defense Association, and is a Trustee of the Institute of Municipal Attorneys. He is a past president of the Hunterdon County Bar Association and was the recipient of the Hunterdon County Professional Lawyer of the Year award for 2001 from the New Jersey State Bar Association Commission on Professionalism.

attorneys.bio:
Jerry S. D’Aniello, the managing partner of the firm’s Somerset County office in Bridgewater, devotes his practice exclusively to all aspects of divorce and family law. Jerry is certified by the Supreme Court of New Jersey as a Matrimonial Law Attorney and provides his clients with strong, strategic legal advice, and has proven to be a formidable adversary both in and out of the courtroom. Divorce and family law covers the most valuable aspects of your life. Jerry ensures that each of his clients receives the strong legal representation needed to attain favorable results.

Far more disputes are resolved through negotiation than by litigation. Jerry is a seasoned negotiator having successfully negotiated over a thousand agreements in his over 25 years of practicing for his clients and in his role as a mediator. To add to the breadth of his negotiation experience, he has successfully completed the intensive interactive Program on Negotiation at Harvard School of Law.

Jerry is an experienced mediator and arbitrator for all divorce and family law-related matters. He is one of the few trained mediators in New Jersey authorized to mediate cases that include domestic violence FRO. Jerry is a trained arbitrator and has successfully completed the American Academy of Matrimonial Lawyers’ Arbitration Training Institute. He is also a court-appointed custody mediator and is admitted to the rosters of Mediators for Economic Aspects of Family Law Cases for thirteen New Jersey counties, including Somerset, Hunterdon, Mercer, Morris, and Union.

In addition to traditional client representation in divorce litigation, Jerry is a trained Collaborative Law Attorney. His collaborative practice involves working with clients to resolve legal disputes outside the court, through a written agreement between all parties, as well as full disclosure of information. The goal of which is to achieve what is best for both parties and the family by resolving all issues without contentious court proceedings.

After law school, Jerry served as an Assistant Prosecutor in Somerset County before entering private practice and concentrating on family law matters. His experience in the prosecutor’s office offered him insight in the courtroom that has led him to be an impressive litigator and negotiator who continues to garner favorable results for his clients.

Professional Recognition

Since 2000, he has served as a Matrimonial Early Settlement Panelist for Somerset and Hunterdon Counties. Jerry received Certificates of Appreciation from the Somerset County Superior Court in recognition of his valuable contributions as a Mediator for Economic Aspects of Family Law Cases, for the Custody & Parenting Time Program, and as a facilitator for the Matrimonial Early Settlement Panel. He has served on the New Jersey State Bar Association, Family Law Executive Committee, and is a former Investigator and Prosecuting Attorney, appointed by the Supreme Court of New Jersey, to the District XIII Ethics Committee. Jerry serves on the Executive Matrimonial Law Committee of the New Jersey Association for Justice.

Jerry is a frequent speaker and author on a wide variety of family law topics. His experience made him a great candidate to serve as a Family Law instructor for Fairleigh Dickinson University’s paralegal studies division.

Jerry is a Fellow of the American Academy of Matrimonial Lawyers, the pre-eminent family law association in America. Jerry is a past-President of the New Jersey Chapter of the American Academy of Matrimonial Lawyers. He is also a member of the International Academy of Family Lawyers (IAFL). In 2023, the American College of Family Trial Lawyers, an invitation only select group of 100 of the top family trial lawyers nationwide, inducted Jerry as a Diplomate.

Jerry has attained a high degree of peer recognition and professional achievement having received an AV pre-eminent rating from Martindale-Hubbell®, the highest possible rating in both legal ability and ethical standards. The AV pre-eminent rating is the pinnacle of professional excellence earned through a strenuous peer review rating process.

attorneys.name: John B. D'Alessandro
attorneys.firm_name: The Law Offices of John B. D'Alessandro, LLC
attorneys.practice_type: Commercial and Residential Real Estate Transactions Lawyers in Union, NJ
attorneys.bio:
Real Estate, Family Law and Divorce

At the offices of attorney John B. D'Alessandro, LLC, in Union, we have been providing compassionate counsel to individuals in real estate and family law matters for almost 20 years. We understand the stress and anxiety that often accompany an unresolved legal matter. We strive to provide an environment where you have the confidence that your best interests are being protected, listening carefully to your concerns and questions so that we can identify solutions that work for you. To set up an appointment, contact our offices or call us.

Our Practice

We focus our representation on matters related to family law and real estate, handling cases involving:

Divorce: We work with people at all stages of a divorce, from the decision to file through negotiations, mediation, and trial to requests for enforcement or modification of existing decrees.

Alimony/spousal support: We will help you evaluate whether alimony is warranted and whether it needs to be temporary, permanent or rehabilitative.

Child support: We will make certain your child support order complies with New Jersey guidelines and that any special needs of the child are appropriately addressed.

Child custody and parenting time: We will help you put in place an arrangement for custody and visitation that promotes the best interests of your children and protects your rights as a parent.

The division of marital debts and assets: We will help you structure an agreement for the fair and equitable distribution of your marital property.

Requests for modification of support or custody orders: When circumstances dictate, we will help you seek changes in child support, alimony or custody decrees.

Residential and commercial real estate transactions: We handle all matters related to residential and commercial real estate transactions, from the negotiation of terms to the preparation of documents to the closing.

Real estate litigation: We represent parties in boundary disputes, breach of contract actions and landlord-tenant controversies.

We also work with individuals, businesses and business owners, handling all matters related to business formation, as well as many different types of commercial litigation. We are located near Route 78 and the Garden State Parkway.

attorneys.name: Joseph D'Aversa
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Marlton, NJ
attorneys.bio:
Joe has engaged in the general practice of law since becoming an attorney in 1995 specializing in Personal Injury, Workers’ Compensation, Criminal Law and Municipal Court Practice. Having spent the first five years of his legal profession as a municipal prosecutor, Joe gained invaluable insight into the New Jersey municipal court system which has served him well in representing those who have been issued traffic summonses from speeding to Driving While Intoxicated and disorderly persons offenses from marijuana possession to simple assault. Such prosecutorial experience lead to several appointments as special prosecutor for governmental disciplinary hearings.

As a criminal defense attorney, Joe succeeded at the New Jersey Appellate Court level in overturning the denial of his client’s admission into the New Jersey Pre-Trial Intervention (PTI) Program and, thus, ensuring that all future applications in the County where said denial occurred are evaluated properly. Joe also obtained favorable results for those facing harsh criminal penalties.

In the area of personal injury, Joe has recovered substantial damages for many of his clients.

attorneys.name: Paul D`Alessandro CFRE
attorneys.firm_name: Law Offices of Peter G. Aziz & Associates LLC
attorneys.practice_type: Nonprofit Organizations Lawyers in Clifton, NJ
attorneys.bio:
Paul D`Alessandro focuses his practice on nonprofit law, charitable gift planning, philanthropic advisory, family law and real estate law. His experience includes counseling individuals, families and businesses on the complexities of charitable giving, reviewing charitable gift contracts made by donors to nonprofits, and conducting operational assessments and multi-year philanthropic plans for Section 501 (c) (3) organizations. He also devotes part of his practice to family law matters.

Mr. D’Alessandro has also created a firm, which counsels non-profits and donors in strategic planning, capital planning and management, organizational effectiveness, fundraising and dealing with high net worth individuals. His initial practice of law started as a Judicial Clerk for the Tax Court of New Jersey. This led to work in Deloitte's Consulting Practice and later Alexander Consulting Group where he was Vice President of the International Division focusing on tax matters of high net worth individuals living overseas.

Mr. D'Alessandro graduated from the University of Notre Dame with a major in business management and received his Juris Doctor from St. John's University School of Law. He also spent a year studying at the Universität Innsbruck (Austria). He was admitted to practice law in 1984 in New Jersey, New York ,Florida and the US Supreme Court. He is also accredited with the New Jersey Association of Professional Mediators.

Mr. D'Alessandro is involved with all cases handled by the firm. He knows every matter and every client from the beginning of their case to the conclusion of representation. All of the clients' needs are considered and discussed prior to the acceptance of any and every case to ensure that all matters are adequately handled to the best of the firm's abilities. Emergency matters are handled expeditiously and every client can communicate directly with the attorney and his staff.
