attorneys.name: Christine M. Dalena
attorneys.practice_type: Matrimonial Lawyers in Morristown, NJ
attorneys.bio:
Christine M. Dalena, Esq. has been a family law attorney for over 36 years. For the past 20+ years, Ms. Dalena has been an equity partner with Laufer, Dalena, Jensen & Doran, LLC, in Morristown, New Jersey. Managing Partner Ms. Dalena has extensive experience in handling complex, high net worth and high conflict mediation, collaborative law and family law litigation matters.

Although Ms. Dalena's specialty is in handling family law related matters (divorce, dissolution of civil unions, adoptions, domestic violence, custody & parenting time, marital torts, paternity, co-habitation agreements & pre-nuptial agreements), she has extensive experience in other areas of the law - real estate transactions - which allows her to handle a broader spectrum of issues that customarily arise in the matrimonial law context. Each case is unique so she employs the most appropriate strategy - mediation, arbitration or litigation - based on the particular circumstances that exist in each individual matter.

Her mediation and collaborative training skills, coupled with her knowledge of the law, ability to handle complex financial issues, and compassion for her client's needs and goals have enabled her to handle the intricacies of family law successfully. She is a passionate advocate in mediation, collaborative law and family law and is sensitive to the personal conflicts and emotions that arise in family law matters.

Ms. Dalena has been selected for inclusion in the New Jersey Super Lawyers list since 2009 and as one of the top 50 women attorneys in the State of New Jersey for 2010, 2011 & 2012. In addition to being a member of the New Jersey State Bar, Ms. Dalena is also a member of the US District Court of New Jersey and Pennsylvania State Bar. She is a member of the American Association for Justice, American Bar Association, NJ State Bar Association, Morris County Early Settlement Panel Program, Morris County Bar Association, NJ Collaborative Law Group, NJ Association of Professional Mediators and International Academy of Collaborative Professionals.

She served as a law clerk to the Hon. George P. Helfrich, Superior Court of New Jersey, Law Div., Civil Part, Morris County. She received an undergraduate degree in Business Administration from the University of Delaware and her Juris Doctorate from Seton Hall School of Law.

Ms. Dalena continues her commitment to helping others by serving as a member/trustee on several civic/community, political and charitable organizations.

attorneys.name: John Daniels
attorneys.practice_type: Lawyers in Camden, NJ
attorneys.bio:
John Daniels is a ten-year Navy veteran, having served as a Spanish linguist while leading a team of deploying personnel in San Antonio, Texas. Mr. Daniels has diligently pursued immigrants' rights since his time in the Navy. During the family separation policy, he volunteered with grassroots immigrants' rights organizations assisting asylum seekers in detention and upon release in Central Texas and on the border with Mexico. After his enlistment, he attended Seton Hall School of Law in Newark, New Jersey, serving as a student attorney at the Immigrants' Rights Clinic, with the Karnes Family Detention Center Pro Bono trip, and as vice president of the Immigration Law Society.

Before joining DeCosmo Law as an associate attorney, Mr. Daniels worked at Harlan York and Associates for two and a half years. From the start of his legal career, he has exclusively represented immigrants in all forms of immigration matters, including naturalization, adjustment of status, asylum, consular processing, and removal defense. He currently provides pro bono representation to Afghan asylum seekers through the American Immigration Council.

Mr. Daniels draws on a broad range of experiences and perspectives in order to formulate the best strategy for our clients' needs. Together with our expert team of attorneys, paralegals and support staff, Mr. Daniels uses a wide array of knowledge and skills to guide clients through the various government processes that U.S. immigration law encompasses.

Before joining DeCosmo Law as an associate attorney, Mr. Daniels worked at Harlan York and Associates for two and a half years. From the start of his legal career, he has exclusively represented immigrants in all forms of immigration matters, including naturalization, adjustment of status, asylum, consular processing, and removal defense. He currently provides pro bono representation to Afghan asylum seekers through the American Immigration Council.

Mr. Daniels draws on a broad range of experiences and perspectives in order to formulate the best strategy for our clients' needs. Together with our expert team of attorneys, paralegals and support staff, Mr. Daniels uses a wide array of knowledge and skills to guide clients through the various government processes that U.S. immigration law encompasses.

attorneys.name: Mark G. Davis
attorneys.practice_type: Criminal Law Lawyers in Hamilton, NJ
attorneys.bio:
Mark G. Davis, Esq. is the proud founder of The Davis Law Firm, LLC. Building this practice has been his dream since childhood. Born and raised in Mercer County, New Jersey, he became dedicated to helping his community by using his selflessness and naturally competitive spirit to represent the disadvantaged, wronged, downtrodden, damaged, and wrongly accused.

After graduating from The Hun School of Princeton, he laid a solid foundation for his legal career by earning a Bachelors Degree in Criminology from the University of Maryland, College Park. Three years later, he emerged from one of the Nation's elite law schools, The George Washington University, armed with a license to stand in your shoes and go toe-to-toe with State and corporate giants.

He began his legal career as an attorney with a prominent civil litigation firm with offices in both Philadelphia, PA and Princeton, NJ. In that capacity, he gained extensive insight into the defensive strategies and inner-workings of not only major corporations and insurance companies, but their legal counsel as well. This experience allows him to now evaluate and approach each plaintiff's matter with reasonable anticipation of the applicable defenses and counter-claims.

After this stint with the defense firm, he finally crossed over and began his career representing plaintiffs and criminal defendants under the tutelage of the one of the most renowned and formidable trial attorneys in Mercer County. And as an attorney with the Law Offices of Charles J. Casale, Jr., Esq., he was able to cultivate his skill as a litigator, fighting vigorously to protect the legal rights and entitlements of those needing it the most.

Equipped with the significant resources of his own firm, Mark now takes great pride in answering the community's call for an attorney:

To not only relate to, but to confidently rely upon;

To actually FIGHT on their behalf and provide aggressive representation, instead of simply "talking the talk";

To believe in their causes and craft persuasive, passionate arguments on their behalf; and

To take each client's matter personally.

attorneys.practice_type: Criminal Law Lawyers in Red Bank, NJ
attorneys.bio:
I am an established attorney located in Red Bank, (Central) New Jersey. I am a New Jersey native, raised in Monmouth County. I attended Boston College, graduated cum laude in 1999 with a degree in Political Science and Communications. Prior to attending law school, I worked in the field of broadcast journalism at both NBC News in New York and CBS News in Boston, MA.

In 2005, I graduated from Seton Hall University School of Law. While at Seton Hall, I served on the Moot Court Board and the Women's Law Forum. I was the recipient of the Best Brief Award in the Gressman Moot Court Competition and named Best Oralist in the Appellate Advocacy class. Following graduation, I had a summer internship in 2004 with the Federal Public Defenders Office; in 2005-2006 I clerked for the Honorable Francis P. DeStefano, Superior Court of New Jersey, Monmouth County. I also served as a law clerk in the Appellate Section of the Monmouth County Prosecutor's Office in 2007. In 2010 I served as a per diem attorney at the Office of the Public Defender, arguing cases on behalf of juvenile defendants.

In private practice, I focus on Criminal Law matters (including but not limited to juvenile offense, Assault & related offenses, Drug Violations, Expungements, Sex Crimes, DUI/DWI, etc…), Municipal matters as well as Estate and Trust matters. Further, I handle matters in Small Claims Court, as well as Landlord/Tenant Court. I am a local Red Bank attorney who strongly advocates on behalf of my clients. I understands that the legal process can be a stressful experience and attempt to alleviate that burden.

attorneys.name: James De Norscia
attorneys.practice_type: Personal injury / Accidents Lawyers in New Brunswick, NJ
attorneys.bio:
James De Norscia is an accomplished trial attorney in both New York and New Jersey, who specializes in all personal injury matters. Jim has extensive experience in the State and Federal trial and appellate courts of New York and New Jersey with proven success in complex, high profile cases. Based on his extensive trial experience, the Supreme Court of New Jersey has certified Jim as a Civil Trial Attorney.

His proven success as a litigator and trial attorney has resulted in several published and unpublished opinions issued from the State and Federal appellate courts of New York and New Jersey. Recently, he obtained a high six figure verdict on behalf of his client who was injured while a passenger in a bus.

He is very dedicated to his clients, who he recognizes have their respective individual needs and goals. Regardless of the size of the client or the scope of the case, his objective is to provide the highest quality legal representation with prompt, personal service.

In 2018, the New York Daily News recognized Mr. De Norscia's work on a trial on behalf of a minor child injured due to hazardous lead paint.

Mr. De Norscia received his Bachelor of Arts and Master of Business Administration from Fairleigh Dickinson University. He received his Juris Doctor from Seton Hall University School of Law. Mr. De Norscia is admitted to the New Jersey Bar, New York State Bar, as well as the U.S. District Court Districts of New Jersey, the Eastern District of New York and the Southern District of New York.

attorneys.name: Robert A. De Santo
attorneys.firm_name: Gruccio Pepper De Santo & Ruth P.A.
attorneys.practice_type: Real Estate Lawyers in Vineland, NJ
attorneys.bio:
Mr. De Santo is a partner in the Vineland law firm of Gruccio, Pepper, De Santo & Ruth. He received a Bachelor of Arts Degree in Business Education from Trenton State College, where he was active in numerous organizations and committees. He served in the U.S. Army and, thereafter entered the Rutgers University School of Law, where he received his Juris Doctor Degree.

Mr. De Santo served as Associate Solicitor for the City of Vineland from 1980-1988. He was Secretary of the New Jersey Supreme Court Fee Arbitration Committee from 1982-1985, and a member of the Supreme Court District I Ethics Committee from 1993-1996. He served as Trustee (1984-1986), Vice-President (1986-1987) and President (1987-1988) of the Cumberland County Bar Association. He served as Solicitor to the Vineland Board of Education from 1988 to 2024. He is a former Board member of the American Trial Lawyers Association of New Jersey. Mr. De Santo is a charter member and Past President of the American Board of Trial Advocates - South Jersey Chapter.

Mr. De Santo was honored by the New Jersey Commission on Professionalism with the prestigious Professional Lawyer of the Year Award for 2002. He was designated as a “Top Attorney" by New Jersey Monthly Magazine from 2005-2016. His peer rating is “AV” by Martindale-Hubbell, the highest attorney peer rating designated by that lawyer rating service. Mr. De Santo was certified by the New Jersey State Supreme Court Board on Trial Certification as a Certified Civil Trial Attorney from 1984 - 2021. He served for over 15 years as a court appointed mediator in various New Jersey counties.

Mr. De Santo served on the Board of Directors of the Greater Vineland Chamber of Commerce for 13 years including a two-year term as President. He served on the Board of Directors of the Vineland Downtown Improvement District/Main Street for 11 years, including three years as Chairman. He currently serves as a member of the Board of Directors of the Vineland YMCA and the Board of Directors of the Cumberland County College Foundation, where he is serving a seventh term as Chairman. He is also a veteran member of American Legion Post 270.

Mr. De Santo was a founding member of the Italian American Benevolent Associates and serves as advisor to the Board of Trustees. The Association provides scholarships to eligible high school students and financial assistance to disabled individuals and needy families. He was honored by the newspaper The GrapeVine as a “Hometown Hero” in 2010, by the Italian Cultural Foundation with its 2011 Spirit of Achievement Award, and by the Vineland Downtown Improvement District/Main Street with its Volunteer Recognition Award in 2017.

attorneys.name: Shauna Monique Deans
attorneys.practice_type: Probate and Estate Administration Lawyers in Springfield, NJ
attorneys.bio:
Shauna M. Deans focuses her practice on estate and trust administration and estate planning for individuals and families in New Jersey and New York. She has extensive experience guiding clients from a wide range of financial and family backgrounds through wealth-preservation strategies, multigenerational planning, and tax-efficient transfers, including federal estate, gift, and generation-skipping transfer (GST) tax considerations.

Before joining Levine Haddad & Gregory, LLC, Shauna served as a Senior Staff Attorney in the private clients group of a large international law firm in New York, where she advised high-net-worth clients on sophisticated estate planning and trust administration matters. Her work included preparing federal and state estate tax returns, facilitating probate and ancillary probate proceedings, and drafting complex planning instruments such as revocable and irrevocable trusts, pour-over wills, powers of attorney, and advance directives. She regularly worked alongside fiduciaries, accountants, financial advisors, and government agencies to implement efficient and compliant planning and administration strategies.

Prior to her work in New York, Shauna practiced at regional law firms in New Jersey, where she advised clients with estates ranging from modest to highly complex. She administered estates involving multi-jurisdictional assets, significant tax considerations, and sensitive family dynamics; prepared a broad array of estate, inheritance, and gift tax returns; and drafted settlement agreements, disclaimers, waivers, and refunding bonds and releases.

Shauna began her legal career as a Law Clerk to the Honorable Frederick J. Schuck, J.S.C., in the New Jersey Superior Court, Law Division, where she supported judicial decision-making through research, analysis, and mediation of disputes. She also previously gained experience as a Summer Associate at a large national law firm in New York.

Shauna is committed to client-centered representation that emphasizes clear communication, efficiency, and practical, tax-advantaged solutions. She has been recognized as a New Jersey Super Lawyers Rising Star and has presented on estate planning topics for the New Jersey Institute of Continuing Legal Education.

attorneys.name: Christopher Anthony DeAngelo
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Howell, NJ
attorneys.bio:
Before joining the firm, Christopher worked as an Associate at a personal injury law firm in Princeton, NJ where he assisted senior partners in complex personal injury litigation. He started his legal career as the law clerk for the Honorable F. Patrick McManimon in the Superior Court of New Jersey, performing research and helping draft opinions, orders, and memoranda. His duties also included participating in judicial conferences to resolve cases and acting as a mediator during mandatory civil mediations.

Christopher received his bachelor’s degree in History in 2008 from Haverford College in Pennsylvania before returning to New Jersey to study law. He received his law degree from Seton Hall University School of Law in 2011, where he was a member of the Law Review and served as the president of the school’s Dispute Resolution Society.

Christopher is also admitted to practice law in the State of New York and the District of Columbia. Having grown up in Mercer County, he now resides with his wife, Heather, in Burlington County. While he works primarily out of the firm’s Howell and Forked River offices, Christopher represents injured victims throughout the State of New Jersey.

attorneys.name: Derek A. DeCosmo
attorneys.practice_type: Immigration Law Lawyers in Camden, NJ
attorneys.bio:
Derek A. DeCosmo is the founding and managing Partner of DeCosmo Law. Since 2005, Derek has guided clients through the maze of immigration law. Derek is experienced, responsive and driven by results. Derek has successfully represented thousands of immigrant clients, whether they've been in deportation proceedings or in their applications for immigration benefits. Derek has handled every type of immigration case. Derek has extensive experience advising clients on the immigration consequences of criminal convictions and in defending immigrant clients charged with crimes.

Derek created and developed a course on the interplay between criminal and immigration law, which he has been teaching at Rutgers School of Law since 2016. Derek is the lead author of the Guide to Immigration Consequences for Criminal Defendants in New Jersey. Derek previously served as Chair of the New Jersey Chapter of the American Immigration Lawyers Association and he currently serves as Co-Chair of the Immigration Section of the Camden County Bar Association. Derek has offices in Camden, Haddonfield and Mount Holly, New Jersey.

When not in a courtroom or teaching other lawyers and law students, Derek is passionate about donating his time to charitable causes and giving back to the community. He hosts lectures at various churches and organizations to inform the community of their legal rights. As a native of Burlington County, Derek knew from the start that serving the communities of South Jersey would be central to his practice.

attorneys.name: Michael J. Deem Esq.
attorneys.firm_name: R.C. Shea & Associates, Counsellors at Law
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Litigation Lawyers in Toms River, NJ
attorneys.bio:
Michael J. Deem, Esq. was first admitted to the State Bar of New Jersey in 1999 after four years of undergraduate and three years of post-graduate study at Touro Law School in Huntington, New York. (B.A. 1993; Juris Doctor, 1998). While at Law School, Mr. Deem received distinction in Tort Law and Contracts. Shortly after graduation, Mr. Deem gained admission to practice in New Jersey, as well as within the following jurisdictions: U.S. District Court, District of New Jersey (1999) and the Unites States Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit. Since 2012, he has been Certified by the Supreme Court of New Jersey as Civil Trial Attorney and Certified by the National Board of Trial Advocacy as a Civil Trial Lawyer. As of May 2024, Mr. Deem is the only attorney in Ocean County who is Certified by both the Supreme Court of New Jersey as Civil Trial Attorney and Certified by the National Board of Trial Advocacy as a Civil Trial Lawyer. Mr. Deem is a Rule 1:40 Qualified Mediator as well as a Civil Arbitrator and Contract Arbitrator for the Superior Court's Mandatory, Non-Binding Arbitration Program.

Mr. Deem is a member of the Ocean County Bar Association, the New Jersey Association for Justice, and the American Association for Justice. Since March 2014, Mr. Deem has been recognized by New Jersey Super Lawyers magazine as one of New Jersey's Top plaintiff's Personal Injury lawyers. Only the Top 5% of New Jersey Lawyers are selected as Super Lawyers. This selection process is conducted by an independent Firm that determines which lawyers in New Jersey have attained a high degree of peer recognition and professional achievement. He has lectured for the New Jersey State Bar Association and the New Jersey Association for Justice on topics including Wrongful Death, Jury Voir Dire, Expedited Trials, Exposing Deceptive Defense Medicine, Cross Examining Doctors, Medical Ethics, and the Collateral Source Rule.

Mr. Deem began his career as a Law Clerk to the Hon. Martin Kravarik, J.S.C. (Middlesex County) where he handled a variety of civil matters including personal injury, LAD, insurance coverage issues, and commercial litigation. In fact, he wrote the option for the trail court in the case of National Union Fire Ins. Co. of Pitt. v. Transportation Ins. Co, which was later affirmed by the Appellate Division in its published opinion at 336 N.J. Super 437 (App. Div. 2001). After his Clerkship, Mr. Deem spent the earlier part of his legal career defending insurance companies and self-insured businesses against consumer allegations of injury because of the negligent acts or omissions of others. Defending insurance companies also included researching and litigating insurance coverage issues, claims for indemnification, and claims for contribution.

In 2005, Michael chose to pursue a more gratifying professional career, so he began representing individuals who have suffered injury as a result of the negligence of others. He has since broadened his trial practice beyond personal injury litigation to include commercial transactions and litigation, consumer protection litigation, insurance coverage litigation, and estate litigation. Now Mr. Deem is making good use of his insurance-defense knowledge and trial experience. In fact, following a multi-million-dollar personal injury verdict, the trial judge stated on the record that, "on cross examination, Mr. Deem was Joshua and the defense expert were the wall because he came tumbling down. Frankly, I've never seen an expert wilt that badly during testimony."

From the first time Mr. Deem meets a client, he starts preparing for battle against his adversary by searching outside the box for unique trial strategies that his adversary will never see coming. "I invest a great deal of time keeping up with the current changes in the law. I continually educate myself with new trial techniques, legal research, and internet research which has proven to be fruitful grounds to expose my adversary's weaknesses." In addition, Mr. Deem is an accomplished transactional attorney who has negotiated several multi-million dollar deals on behalf of Roy Jones Jr. Promotions.

attorneys.name: Kelly Degen Esq.
attorneys.practice_type: Family Law Lawyers in Woodland Park, NJ
attorneys.bio:
Kelly Degen joined Bastarrika, Soto, Gonzalez, and Somohano, LLP as an associate in October 2019. She received her Bachelor of Arts, magna cum laude, from Montclair State University and her Juris Doctorate from Rutgers Law School – Newark.

During law school, Kelly was the Articles and Submissions Editor for the Women’s Rights Law Reporter and served as the senior coordinator for Rutgers Chapter of Sanctuary for Families Courtroom Advocates Project. Additionally, she also participated in the Rutgers Law School Child Advocacy Clinic as a clinical student where she provided legal assistance to children in matters involving abuse and neglect, special immigrant juvenile status, and social security income issues.

Prior to joining the office, Kelly completed a judicial clerkship for the Honorable Imre Karaszegi, Jr., J.S.C. in the Superior Court of New Jersey, Passaic County, Family Part from August 2018 to August 2019. As a law clerk, Kelly primarily performed legal research and prepared memoranda on issues in cases involving children in court and the Division of Child Protection and Permanency. Moreover, Kelly frequently conducted consent conferences in non-dissolution cases regarding custody, parenting time, paternity, child support, and medical support, was a certified mediator for small claims and landlord-tenant cases, and made recommendations regarding the disposition of post-judgment matrimonial motions.

Kelly is a member of the Passaic County Bar Association. She also serves as a panel member for the Passaic Vicinage Matrimonial Early Settlement Panel Program and the Passaic Vicinage Non-Dissolution Mediation Panel Program.

attorneys.name: Benjamin M. Del Vento
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury - Plaintiff Lawyers in Livingston, NJ
attorneys.bio:
For over 57 years, Benjamin M. Del Vento has been fighting for people injured in all types of accidents. Ben graduated from Rutgers University in 1961 and received his law degree from Rutgers University School of Law in Newark in 1964. While in law school, Ben was President of the Student Body and member of the moot court team. Ben clerked for the Hon. James R. Guiliano, A.J.S.C. in New Jersey Superior Court, Essex County and was an assistant prosecutor under future Governor Brendan T. Byrne in Office of the Prosecutor of Essex County.

Ben founded the current law firm in 1971 and focuses his practice on personal injury and workers' compensation litigation. Throughout his career, Ben has tried all types of criminal and civil cases from homicides to product liability matters.

While an undergraduate at Rutgers University, Ben was a member of the men's basketball team and men's golf team attending Rutgers on a full New Jersey State Golf Association Caddie Scholarship. Since graduation from law school, Ben has been actively involved in community service including raising money for the New Jersey State Golf Association Caddie Scholarship Foundation. He is a former President of the New Jersey State Golf Association and the 2016 recipient of the NJPGA/NJSGA Distinguished Service Award .

Throughout his 5 decades of practice, Ben has been a lecturer and presenter at continuing legal education programs. In 2021 Ben received the Lifetime Achievement Award from the Essex County Bar Association and in 2005 received the Walter A. Lucas Special Merit Award from the Essex County Bar Association.

Awards and Honors

Honors

Essex County Bar Association - Lifetime Achievement Award, 2021

Essex County Bar Association - Walter Lucas Special Merit Award, 2005

The Columbian Foundation Distinguished Humanitarian & Achievement Award, 2008

Unico National Community Service Award, 2009

Benjamin M. Del Vento, Jr. is an experienced plaintiff's personal injury lawyer who joined the family firm in 1999. As a New Jersey Supreme Court Certified Civil Trial Attorney, Ben Jr. handles automobile accident, premises liability, trucking accident, product liability, construction accident, real estate, criminal and municipal court matters and both medical and legal malpractice cases.

Ben Jr. began his career in 1994 as the law clerk to the Hon. Eugene J. Codey, Jr., P.J.Cv. in New Jersey Superior Court, Essex County. attorneys.practice_type: Family Law Lawyers in Marlton, NJ
attorneys.bio:
Jill has experience in all aspects of family law, including divorce, child custody, equitable distribution, support, domestic violence, pre-marital agreements, and adoption. She is committed to fully understanding the client’s situation, offering them empathy, yet explaining how the law works so that they have a realistic view of their options. Jill handles their cases with an eye towards obtaining the best resolution to enable them to move forward with their lives.

Jill graduated from Rutgers University - Camden with a Bachelor of Arts degree in Political Science, and has always had an interest in law. During her undergraduate tenure, she was active in the Pre-Law Society. Upon graduation from Rutgers, she became a legal assistant in family law. Jill continued her pursuit of a legal career and received her Juris Doctor from Rutgers University School of Law - Camden. While in law school, Jill earned her Certification in Mediation and her Certificate of Professional Development. Jill also participated in the Wills for Heroes program and in the Domestic Violence Clinic.

Domzalski, J.S.C. in the Family Part of the Superior Court of New Jersey. Upon completion of her clerkship, she then became an associate with Weinberg, Kaplan & Smith.

Jill is a Matrimonial Early Settlement Panelist for Burlington and Gloucester Counties.

attorneys.name: Skylar B. DeMartinis
attorneys.practice_type: Employment Lawyers in Red Bank, NJ
attorneys.bio:
Ms. DeMartinis is an associate at McOmber McOmber & Luber, P.C. in the firm’s Marlton, New Jersey office. Ms. DeMartinis primarily focuses her practice on employment law and civil litigation, representing clients in matters involving discrimination, sexual harassment, retaliation, wrongful termination, and whistleblower claims.

Ms. DeMartinis graduated magna cum laude from Coastal Carolina University, completing all course work in three years, with a Bachelor of Arts in Intelligence and National Security Studies. Following her graduation from Coastal Carolina, Ms. DeMartinis worked in the corporate Asset Protection department at Wegmans Food Markets where she handled all aspects of employment dispute investigations. Subsequently, Ms. DeMartinis attended Rutgers Law School – Camden on a Dean’s Merit Scholarship.

During law school, Ms. DeMartinis was a student attorney in the Rutgers Expungement Clinic, where she represented individuals who could not otherwise afford legal representation in their pursuit of expunging their past criminal records. Following her first year at Rutgers Law, Ms. DeMartinis served as a law clerk in the Philadelphia Office of the Department of Homeland Security, where she gained valuable experience in litigation, including an opportunity to litigate a merits hearing on the record. While attending Rutgers Law, Ms. DeMartinis also served on the Rutgers Journal of Law and Public Policy for two years and was a class representative for the Sports and Entertainment Law Society.

Following her second year of law school, Ms. DeMartinis wished to use her prior experience in employment disputes and investigations to help others. Coupling this experience with her interest in litigation, Ms. DeMartinis joined the team at McOmber McOmber & Luber, P.C. as a law clerk in the firm’s Marlton Office.

In her free time, Ms. DeMartinis enjoys live music, visiting her family down the shore, and traveling.

attorneys.name: Stephen P. DeNittis
attorneys.practice_type: Class Actions Lawyers in Marlton, NJ
attorneys.bio:
Stephen P. DeNittis is the managing partner of DeNittis Osefchen Prince, P.C. An experienced consumer fraud class action litigator and catastrophic personal injury litigator, Mr. DeNittis and the firm have recovered over $500 million for victims of severe injury or corporate fraud in federal and state courts across the country. He currently serves as lead or co-lead counsel in many class actions currently pending in federal and state court. Since 1998, Mr. DeNittis has successfully served as lead or co-lead counsel in over one hundred and seventy-five (175) class actions involving consumer fraud, false advertising, food mislabeling, construction defects, wage and hour violations, RESPA violations and mass tort litigation throughout the country.

In 2013, he was designated by the Supreme Court of New Jersey as a Civil Trial Attorney, a high honor of achievement as only 1.5% of attorneys in New Jersey hold such a designation. He is also rated AV, the highest rating given by Martindale Hubbell, the country's foremost legal directory. He has also been named to the Super Lawyers List from 2013-2021 (and previously a "New Jersey Rising Star" from 2006 thru 2011) by Law and Politics Magazine and New Jersey Monthly where he was recognized in the top 2.5% of attorneys practicing in New Jersey. Also he has been recognized in 2011, 2012-2021 by SJ Magazine as Top Class Action lawyer and South Jersey Magazine as an "Awesome Attorney" in the field of Personal Injury.

In 2020, Mr. DeNittis also received two more high honors. He was named as on of America's Top 100 High Stake Litigators, an honor less than one-half percent of active attorneys in the United States has received. In the same year he was also named as one of The National Trial Lawyers: Top 100 Trial Lawyers, again a designation bestowed to less than 1% of attorneys nationally.

Mr. DeNittis' notable cases include:

In the last six years:

• Barba et al. v. Old Navy. where Mr. DeNittis served as lead counsel and obtained a class settlement of approximately $250 million on behalf of a class of 50,000,000 consumers. The class alleged that Gap Factory Outlet and Banana Factory Outlet stores and website offered products with false reference prices which results in fake discounts and fake sales. Consumers received up to $10 in vouchers to obtain free products or use to receive discounts off products.

• Andrews et al. v. Gap. where Mr. DeNittis served as lead counsel and obtained a class settlement of approximately $144 million on behalf of a class of 25,000,000 consumers. The class alleged that Gap Factory Outlet and Banana Factory Outlet stores and website offered products with false reference prices which results in fake discounts and fake sales. Consumers received up to $12 in vouchers to obtain free products or use to receive discounts off products.

• Coladonato v. JCrew where Mr. DeNittis served as one of the lead counsels and obtained a class settlement of $24 million on behalf of a class of 2.6 million New Jersey, New York and California consumers. The class alleged that JCrew Outlet stores and website offered products with false reference prices which resulted in fake discounts and fake sales. Consumers received up to $16 in vouchers to obtain free products or use to receive discounts off products.

• Sekelew et al. v. Burlington where Mr. DeNittis served as lead counsel and obtained a class settlement of $9.6 million on behalf of a class of 1,000,000 New Jersey consumers. Ryder Truck Rental, where he obtained a $7 million dollar settlement on behalf a client who suffered a devastating brain injury as a result of a slip and fall that occurred in a parking lot in 2005. National Collector's Mint where Mr. DeNittis was lead counsel and obtained a settlement valued at $9 million dollars on behalf of a class of 176,000 class members who were defrauded into purchasing a fake coin allegedly issued by the U.S. Mint to commemorate the "9/11" Terrorist Attack. Sal DePinto was admitted to the New Jersey Bar in 1984 and is a life long resident of central New Jersey. While at Rutgers College, Sal was a part of the Political Science Honors Society. He was also a part of the Phi Alpha Delta Law Fraternity while attending The Delaware Law School and served as an editor for the school's Law Review, known as The Delaware Law Journal of Corporate Law. Sal has spent his entire career providing legal services for residents of central New Jersey.

Operating from his office in Hamilton Township, Mercer County, New Jersey, Sal DePinto represents clients in the surrounding areas of Robbinsville, Allentown, Bordentown, East Windsor, West Windsor, Lawrenceville and Cranbury.

attorneys.name: Jared DeRosso
attorneys.practice_type: Divorce Lawyers in Livingston, NJ
attorneys.bio:
Jared DeRosso focuses his practice primarily on divorce and other family law matters. Working out of the firm’s office in New City, New York, he provides representation to clients throughout Rockland County and the surrounding Hudson Valley. Throughout his career, Mr. DeRosso has appeared in many different courts in the State of New York, including in Rockland, Westchester, New York, Bronx, Kings, Queens, Suffolk, Orange, Dutchess, and Sullivan Counties, and has argued before the Appellate Division, Second Department in Brooklyn, New York. Jared has been admitted to practice before all New York state courts since 2013.

A significant portion of Jared’s client base is made up of area residents who are seeing their marriages come to an end and who are thus having to deal with such divorce-related issues as the division of complex assets and debts, child custody and visitation, maintenance/alimony and child support. A forceful courtroom advocate for his clients when litigation is necessary, he often helps them avoid the stress and uncertainty of a trial by encouraging them to come to an accord on these issues through the negotiation of a settlement agreement. For his clients whose marriages have already been dissolved, Jared appears with them in court when they are seeking the enforcement of or modifications to existing parenting and support orders, and for those who are considering getting married, he prepares and reviews prenuptial agreements.

Jared’s successful track record and high degree of ethics in handling what are often emotional and contentious issues have earned him the respect of his colleagues, including a “Superb” peer review rating through Avvo. He has also been named as a Super Lawyers Rising Star Honoree in the New York Metro Area, a Lawyers of Distinction Honoree for Excellence in Family and Divorce Law, a Top 10 Best Attorneys for Client Satisfaction in New York by the American Institute of Family Law Attorneys, and one of the Top 10 Family Law Attorneys Under Age 40 by the National Academy of Family Law Attorneys. A 2012 graduate of Albany Law School, Jared’s professional affiliations include the Columbian Lawyers Society of Rockland County and the Rockland County Bar Association.

When not at the office, Jared enjoys spending time with his wife, Ashley, and their dog, Jack.

attorneys.name: Kerdesha Desir
attorneys.practice_type: Divorce Lawyers in Livingston, NJ
attorneys.bio:
Kerdesha Desir is an Associate Attorney at Ziegler Law Group LLC, where she represents clients in complex and emotionally sensitive family law matters. Her work spans divorce, child custody and support, alimony and spousal support, parenting time and relocation disputes, and domestic violence proceedings. She also has experience handling related criminal and municipal matters that frequently arise from family-related incidents.

Kerdesha approaches every case with care, structure, and a strong focus on her clients’ goals—helping them understand the legal process while working toward outcomes that protect their best interests.

Family Law Representation Focused on Clarity and Client Goals

Kerdesha regularly represents individuals navigating high-conflict family law situations, including contested divorces and custody disputes. She is experienced in motion practice, non-dissolution family matters, and proceedings that require detailed legal strategy combined with emotional awareness.

Her approach is grounded in preparation, communication, and advocacy—ensuring that clients are informed, supported, and positioned to make sound decisions during pivotal moments in their lives.

Experience in Domestic Violence and Courtroom Advocacy

A significant part of Kerdesha’s practice involves representing clients in domestic violence matters, including appearances at Final Restraining Order (FRO) hearings. She understands the urgency, seriousness, and long-term impact of these proceedings and works diligently to protect her clients’ rights and safety.

Kerdesha has also handled criminal and municipal matters that intersect with family law cases, giving her a broader courtroom perspective and the ability to manage situations where multiple legal issues overlap.

Training Inside the New Jersey Family Court System

Before entering private practice, Kerdesha served as a student attorney with the Center for Social Justice Family Law Clinic, where she worked directly with individuals and families in need of legal representation. She also completed a judicial clerkship with The Honorable Lisa F. Chrystal, P.J.F.P. (ret.) in the Family Part of the Superior Court of New Jersey, Union County.

This firsthand exposure to the inner workings of the New Jersey family court system strengthens her ability to anticipate procedures, understand judicial reasoning, and advocate effectively for her clients.

Academic Excellence with Real-World Application

Kerdesha earned her Bachelor of Arts degree from the University of South Florida, graduating magna cum laude, a Latin honor meaning “with high praise.” This distinction reflects a sustained record of academic excellence based on GPA and coursework performance—not a symbolic award, but a measurable achievement.

She went on to receive her Juris Doctor from Seton Hall University School of Law, where she held leadership roles in the Black Law Students Association and the Family Law Society. During law school, she also served as a research assistant for the American Law Institute’s Restatement of Children and the Law, contributing to nationally recognized legal scholarship in family law.

A Client-Centered Approach in Family and Criminal Law Matters

Kerdesha understands that family and criminal law cases are not just legal disputes—they are deeply personal. With every case she takes on, she works directly with clients to demystify the legal process, explain options clearly, and pursue strategies aligned with their long-term interests.

Her combination of legal rigor, courtroom experience, and human understanding makes her a trusted advocate for clients facing some of life’s most difficult transitions.

Before entering private practice, Kerdesha served as a student attorney with the Center for Social Justice Family Law Clinic, where she worked directly with individuals and families in need of legal representation. She also completed a judicial clerkship with The Honorable Lisa F. Chrystal, P.J.F.P. (ret.) in the Family Part of the Superior Court of New Jersey, Union County.

This firsthand exposure to the inner workings of the New Jersey family court system strengthens her ability to anticipate procedures, understand judicial reasoning, and advocate effectively for her clients.

Academic Excellence with Real-World Application

Kerdesha earned her Bachelor of Arts degree from the University of South Florida, graduating magna cum laude, a Latin honor meaning “with high praise.” This distinction reflects a sustained record of academic excellence based on GPA and coursework performance—not a symbolic award, but a measurable achievement.

She went on to receive her Juris Doctor from Seton Hall University School of Law, where she held leadership roles in the Black Law Students Association and the Family Law Society. During law school, she also served as a research assistant for the American Law Institute’s Restatement of Children and the Law, contributing to nationally recognized legal scholarship in family law.

A Client-Centered Approach in Family and Criminal Law Matters

Kerdesha understands that family and criminal law cases are not just legal disputes—they are deeply personal. With every case she takes on, she works directly with clients to demystify the legal process, explain options clearly, and pursue strategies aligned with their long-term interests.

Her combination of legal rigor, courtroom experience, and human understanding makes her a trusted advocate for clients facing some of life’s most difficult transitions.

attorneys.name: Neil H. Deutsch
attorneys.practice_type: Employment Law Lawyers in Hackensack, NJ
attorneys.bio:
Neil H. Deutsch has been practicing law for over 35 years. Until 1986, he served several major corporations, including Dairylea and Panasonic, as Associate General Counsel, and Patent Scaffolding, a construction products division of a Fortune 300 company, as General Counsel. During this period, among his many other responsibilities, he handled employment discrimination matters and negotiated and administered union contracts. In 1986, he began his transition to private practice and soon thereafter became a plaintiff's employment and discrimination lawyer. His practice grew and, as of 2005, he was the sole shareholder of a firm of ten lawyers, paralegals and support staff. Mr. Deutsch has been the host of a radio show, the Employee Rights Forum, been a guest on several TV shows on employment law topics and conducted over 30 seminars for the public on employment and discrimination law. He has litigated many cases and tried them to favorable verdicts for his clients. Several of the cases that he has been involved in have set precedent and been published. One, which reached the New Jersey Superior Court, made it clear that plaintiff's are entitled to a jury trial even if their performance is lacking, so long as there is evidence of discrimination. Another established the principal that independent contractors, as well as employees, may assert claims under the New Jersey Law Against Discrimination if they have been terminated for a discriminatory reason. Mr. Deutsch has been selected for inclusion in the New Jersey Super Lawyers list in the area of employment litigation in 2005, 2006, 2008 and 2009. He is a skilled negotiator and uses a bottom line approach, emphasizing risk analysis and cost effectiveness, to maximize his client's recovery. Mr. Deutsch is a member of the New Jersey Bar Association, the New Jersey Employment Lawyers Association and the National Employment Lawyers Association. He, along with his Partner, Bruce L. Atkins, formed Deutsch Atkins, P.C. in 2006.

attorneys.bio:
Ms. Dev concentrates her practice on the representation of boards of education in all areas of school law including: labor and employment, special education, Section 504, student discipline, student records, Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act, Anti-Bullying Bill of Rights Act, School Ethics Act, student residency, civil rights, tenure, negotiations, Open Public Records Act, and Open Public Meetings Act. In connection with these representations, she is experienced in handling matters before State and Federal courts, including the Office of Administrative Law. Ms. Dev is an experienced special education litigator and defends school districts in due process hearings from inception through trial. In addition, she litigates matters before governmental agencies, including the U.S. Office for Civil Rights, New Jersey Public Employment Relations Commission, and New Jersey Division on Civil Rights. Ms. Dev routinely conducts training and seminars, drafts policies and manuals, and provides strategic advice to school administrators regarding school law issues. Ms. Dev also leads Capehart Scatchard's School Law Blog (www.njschoollawblog.com) which focuses on cases, court decisions, and current developments affecting education law in the State of New Jersey.

Ms. Dev founded and serves as the Chair of Capehart Scatchard's Diversity and Inclusion Committee. In 2017, the New Jersey Law Journal selected Ms. Dev as a Diverse Attorney of the Year. In July 2018, Ms. Dev was appointed as Capehart Scatchard's Hiring Shareholder.

attorneys.firm_name: Sarno da Costa D'Aniello Maceri Webb LLC
attorneys.practice_type: Medical Malpractice Lawyers in Roseland, NJ
attorneys.bio:
Daniel B. Devinney joined Sarno da Costa D’Aniello Maceri Webb LLC in 2016 as an associate in our Roseland office and was promoted to Counsel before making partner in 2020. He is certified as a civil trial attorney by the Supreme Court of New Jersey. He started off 2020 strong by securing a gross $650,000 jury verdict in an emergency medicine malpractice case, which was reported as one of the highest verdicts in New Jersey that year. Daniel focuses his practice on complex personal injury matters, including medical malpractice, dental malpractice, products liability, mass torts, and catastrophic personal injury cases.

During law school, Daniel was a recipient of the Presidential Merit Scholarship and completed an internship with the Community Health Law Project, during which time he focused on the legal hurdles faced by the indigent and mentally ill. After law school, Daniel served as a law clerk for the Honorable Bryan D. Garruto, J.S.C. (retired). At the conclusion of his clerkship, Daniel spent nearly 8 years working for one of the top personal injury defense firms in New Jersey, focusing on medical malpractice litigation. As Counsel, Daniel successfully handled over a hundred cases worth millions of dollars. He has intimate knowledge of the strategy and tactics utilized by the defense to successfully defend medical malpractice claims and will now utilize that knowledge to obtain outstanding results for injured patients.

In 2019, TopVericts.com listed a $3.25 million anesthesia malpractice case that partners Daniel B. Devinney and Paul M. da Costa handled amongst their list of top 50 Verdicts and Settlements in the United States. The list is comprised of cases filed either in a state or federal court, as well as those settled prior to commencing a lawsuit. More information regarding the list can be found here.

Daniel B. Devinney has secured numerous six and seven-figure verdicts and settlements on behalf of his clients. Daniel has experience arguing legal issues before the Appellate Division and the Supreme Court of New Jersey.

attorneys.name: Michael J. DiPiero
attorneys.practice_type: Commercial Lawyers in Westmont, NJ
attorneys.bio:
Michael J. DiPiero is a partner with the firm and concentrates his practice in commercial and labor and employment litigation. Mr. DiPiero specializes in management labor relations for both private and public sector employers, including collective negotiations, working conditions, employee disciplinary matters, labor grievance arbitrations, interest arbitration, tenure charges, mediation, unfair labor practice charges, plant closings and relocations, and employee engagement measures. In the public sector, Mr. DiPiero represents clients before the New Jersey Public Employment Relations Commission, the Civil Service Commission, and the Department of Education. In the private sector, Mr. DiPiero represents clients before the National Labor Relations Board and the Equal Employment Opportunity Commission. Mr. DiPiero has experience dealing with labor unions representing employees from all professions, including, for example, police and first responders, clerical employees, supervisory personnel, manufacturing employees, and employees in the building trades.

Mr. DiPiero graduated from St. Joseph's University with a bachelor's degree in 1996. He earned his law degree at Widener University School of Law in 2000 where he was a member of the Moe Levine Trial Advocacy Honor Society and a Staff Writer for the Widener Law Forum.

Prior to joining the firm, Mr. DiPiero was an Assistant Prosecutor for the Camden County, New Jersey Prosecutor's Office. He also served as a judicial law clerk for The Honorable Joseph M. Nardi, Jr. for the New Jersey Superior Court, Camden County.

Mr. DiPiero was admitted to practice in New Jersey and Pennsylvania in 2000. He is also admitted to practice before the following Federal jurisdictions: United States Supreme Court; United States Third Circuit Court of Appeals; and United States District Court (District of New Jersey and Eastern District of Pennsylvania). Mr. DiPiero is a member of the following professional organizations: the Camden County, New Jersey State, Pennsylvania and American Bar Associations; the North American Association of Educational Negotiators; the National Public Employer Labor Relations Association; the New Jersey School Boards Association; and the National School Boards Association's Council of School Attorneys.

Mr. DiPiero was born in Camden, New Jersey in 1973.

attorneys.name: Gaetano J. DiPersia
attorneys.practice_type: Litigation Lawyers in Red Bank, NJ
attorneys.bio:
Mr. DiPersia is an associate at McOmber McOmber & Luber, P.C. Mr. DiPersia’s primary areas of practice are commercial litigation, employment law, class action disputes, and business litigation.

A 2022 graduate of Villanova Law School, Mr. DiPersia started his practice at a Philadelphia area law firm, where his focused practice area was commercial litigation disputes. This included, but was not limited to, litigating contract disputes mainly in the construction and trucking industries.

While at Villanova Law, Mr. DiPersia was a student attorney in the Federal Tax Clinic, where he represented under-privileged individuals in disputes with the IRS. Additionally, Mr. DiPersia was a research assistant for the COVID-19 Legal Research Project, where he provided employees of the University with legal information pertaining to foreclosure and landlord-issues amid the COVID-19 Pandemic.

Mr. DiPersia also helped revive the Justinian Society at Villanova Law, a student organization related to informing the student body of important Italian-American figures in the legal field. Mr DiPersia served as treasurer, and later as President of the Justinian Society, and his duties included planning inter-university events as well as conducting outreach to Justinian Society factions at other Philadelphia Area Law Schools.

Mr. DiPersia joins McOmber McOmber & Luber, P.C. having previously worked as a law clerk during his second and third years of law school.

attorneys.name: Dennis M. Donnelly
attorneys.firm_name: Sarno da Costa D'Aniello Maceri Webb LLC
attorneys.practice_type: Medical Malpractice Lawyers in Roseland, NJ
attorneys.bio:
Dennis M. Donnelly is Of Counsel at Sarno da Costa D’Aniello Maceri Webb LLC in the firm’s Medical Malpractice/Personal Injury department. He is a vastly experienced New Jersey personal injury attorney and a Senior Partner at The Donnelly Law Firm. Over the course of his 35+ years in practice, he has earned numerous million- and multimillion-dollar results on behalf of clients who were severely injured due to the negligence of another person, company, or entity and has received immense recognition from both his clients and his peers.

AWARDS & DISTINCTIONS

Dennis is a distinguished member of the Inner Circle of Advocates, an organization described by The Washington Post as “a select group of 100 of the nation’s most celebrated trial lawyers.” Membership is determined through a rigorous invitation-only process, in which experience, reputation, judicial references, and peer evaluations are reviewed and assessed.

In 2001, he was given The Civil Trial Attorney Achievement Award from the Essex County Bar Association and also received the Pioneers Award from CCJ, The Consumers for Civil Justice, for his work in securing justice for consumers injured by bad products or bad medicine. In October of 2015, Dennis was awarded the 2015 Trial Attorneys of New Jersey Trial Bar award.

In 2022, the Northern New Jersey chapter of the American Board of Trial Attorneys awarded Dennis with the first ever “Jack Wurgraft Award” in recognition of his notable contributions to the plaintiff’s bar. Created in loving memory of the late Jack Wurgraft, the inaugural award was presented to Dennis for his superior trial skills and serves as a reflection of the respect he’s earned from both his peers and various members of the bench. As ABOTA so aptly describes him, Dennis is “a gentleman practitioner who gives back to the practice,” and this award symbolizes the admirable work he’s accomplished throughout his career.

Dennis’ innovative and successful trial strategies have also been cited in some of the leading textbooks on trial practice such as The Rules of the Road in Medical Malpractice cases.

MEMBERSHIPS & AFFILIATIONS

Dennis has been recognized by the National Law Journal, as well as by his peers locally and nationally, as one of the best plaintiff’s personal injury attorneys in New Jersey. He is a past president of the Northern New Jersey chapter of the American Board of Trial Advocates (ABOTA) and also the past president of the most exclusive group of plaintiff’s trial attorneys in the country, the Inner Circle of Advocates. Today, he remains on the Board of Directors for The Inner Circle of Advocates.

Dennis also recently served on the Board of Directors of the Attorneys Information Exchange Group, the only national association of lawyers who share information and strategy to successfully hold car manufacturers accountable for unsafe designs which kill and injure motorists every year. He is also regularly asked to lecture around the country on trial advocacy topics and has published articles on medical malpractice and product liability.

A LEGACY OF MULTI-MILLION-DOLLAR VERDICTS

Dennis regularly tries complex cases to outstanding verdicts in his two areas of special interest: medical malpractice and unsafe, dangerous products. In an age when most personal injury cases resolve in settlement, Dennis has successfully tried ten cases to jury verdicts over $1 million in the past ten years.

In the last fourteen months Dennis has tried three complex medical malpractice cases lasting more than one month each to successful multi-million-dollar verdicts in North, Central and South New Jersey. He has also settled more than 30 cases for more than $1 million at the same time. In the area of birth injuries, he has won all six cases he has tried to verdict in New Jersey, with one case resulting in a $14 million verdict. He has also won a verdict for failure in prenatal diagnosis in New York State for $3.6 million, which was the subject of a New York Times Magazine feature.

In 2025, Dennis secured a gross $19.1 million verdict* for his client who crashed into a guardrail after pulling onto the shoulder of the road while experiencing stroke symptoms. A state trooper failed to recognize the signs of the stroke and arrested her for driving while intoxicated, causing a two-hour delay in her diagnosis and treatment. As a result, the client now struggles with speech and comprehension. The verdict was reduced to approximately $11.4 million to account for the damages from the preexisting stroke that occurred.

COMMITMENT TO CONTINUING EDUCATION & PREVENTING MEDICAL MALPRACTICE

As a result of his extensive medical knowledge and experience with genetic issues in medicine, Dennis has been invited to conduct continuing medical education lectures to residents and practicing OB’s on how to provide proper prenatal screening and has also been invited to speak on medical-legal topics to doctors and lawyers in Holland, France, and Great Britain.

Dennis is known for his extensive and remarkable knowledge of case law in medical malpractice and product liability, and his skill in these legal areas makes him a valued instructor for New Jersey and National Continuing Legal Education groups. During the last five years, he has been asked to give more than 20 lectures in seminars across the country and New Jersey on topics including wrongful death, medical malpractice, crash-worthy vehicle claims, products liability, and using the internet to substantiate medical negligence. Dennis was also appointed as a member of the New Jersey Supreme Court’s Committee on Model Civil Jury charges for over ten years.

Dennis says that his frequent lecturing means that he is continually perfecting his craft. “Teaching any subject well means that you have to be on the cutting edge,” according to Dennis.

In seminars throughout the United States—as well as in Montreal, London, Paris, and Amsterdam—Dennis has lectured to doctors and lawyers on electronic medical records, safe medical care, and the use of the internet and computer presentations to expose negligent care and negligent practices. He has helped hundreds of other plaintiffs’ lawyers prove substandard medical care and defects in car design. Dennis also regularly publishes articles in national legal publications on medical malpractice and trial tactics, as well as on failures in prenatal diagnosis and design defects which make cars dangerous and unsafe.

Awards and Honors

Honors

Lawdragon 500 Leading Plaintiff Consumer Lawyer, 2019

He was selected for inclusion in the NJ Super Lawyers list: 2015-2025

The Best Lawyers in America® (Woodward/White, Inc.), 2020-2024, Best Lawyers® Lawyer of the Year – Medical Malpractice or Personal Injury, 2012, 2014, 2016

Essex County Bar Association, The Civil Trial Attorney Achievement Award, 2001

The Consumers for Civil Justice, Pioneers Award, 2001

American Board of Trial Attorneys, New Jersey Chapter, “Jack Wurgraft Award,” 2022

attorneys.name: Robert S. Dorkin
attorneys.practice_type: Divorce & Qualified Family Law Mediator Lawyers in Union, NJ
attorneys.bio:
Please spend a few minutes getting to know me.

As you are wandering through the Internet looking for a Family Lawyer you ask, "How can I tell one attorney from another?" This attorney has great credentials, but so does this one." It is not an easy decision to make. It is a decision that may affect the rest of your life and the lives of your children.

Being a Family Lawyer takes someone who cares about people, works hard and loves what he or she is doing. A Family Lawyer must have patience. A Family Lawyer must be a good listener. It is easy to put issues in 'small boxes,' label them, and move on to the next issue. With the volume of cases in the Court system, Judges use labels to simplify cases; it is human nature.

What if my issues do not fit into 'small boxes'? That is when you need to be represented by someone who can convince a Judge that your case and your life deserve a second look, a short pause before the Court slaps a label on it and moves it down the line for 'processing.'

You need to be represented by someone who understands the system and how the system can work for you and your family. Some of you have heard the stories about what goes on in divorce cases, custody cases, support cases, and the like. Some of these stories are true, but you do not have to accept all of these outcomes as inevitable.

I believe that I can make a difference in your case and your life. I will work hard to help you achieve your goals. My job is to point you in the right direction. Give you options when there are realistic alternatives. I will give you the tools to help you reorganize your life. This is a collaboration, a team effort. You will make the final decisions. No two cases are alike. People are individuals, not a compilation of dollars and cents. Sometimes a case needs a dose of common sense.

If you are looking for an attorney with a practical view of the Court system and litigation, please contact me. Litigation does not have to be expensive. You need to use your resources carefully. I will tell you honestly where it makes sense to stop, pause, and ask the Court for a second look.

Bob Dorkin

attorneys.name: Polina M. Dostalik Esq.
attorneys.practice_type: Divorce Lawyers in Livingston, NJ
attorneys.bio:
With more than 15 years of experience, Polina is a trusted and dedicated family and matrimonial law attorney known for guiding clients through some of life’s most challenging transitions with clarity, compassion, and strategic insight. She believes that effective representation begins with a strong attorney-client partnership, ensuring that her clients understand every step of the legal process and its potential impact on their lives and families.

Practice Areas

Practicing in both New Jersey and New York, Polina represents clients in all phases of matrimonial and family law matters, including litigation, arbitration, and mediation. Her practice encompasses a wide range of issues such as:

Divorce;

Equitable distribution;

Alimony and spousal support;

Child custody and parenting time;

Child support;

Paternity and parental rights;

Grandparents’ rights;

Marital, separation, and property settlement agreements;

Dissolution of civil unions and domestic partnerships;

Palimony;

Post-judgment enforcement or modifications; and

Domestic violence restraining orders.

In addition, Polina is highly skilled in negotiating and drafting comprehensive pre-nuptial, post-nuptial, and cohabitation agreements, tailored to protect her clients’ interests with foresight and legal precision.

Serving Russian and Eastern European Communities

As a Russian-speaking attorney, Polina is uniquely positioned to serve clients from the Russian and Eastern European communities across New Jersey and New York. Her cultural fluency and language skills enable her to build trust with clients, explain legal concepts clearly in their native language, and effectively represent them in both routine and high-stakes matters.

International and Interstate Family Law Experience

Polina also has deep experience in international and interstate family law, including matters involving the Hague Convention on the Civil Aspects of International Child Abduction. She has successfully handled cross-border custody and support disputes, parental child abduction cases, and multi-jurisdictional family law agreements, applying her knowledge of international treaty law and enforcement mechanisms with precision and care.

Approach and Advocacy

She is a strong and zealous courtroom advocate and a creative and skilled negotiator, always tailoring her approach to the client’s goals while remaining sensitive to the emotional dynamics of family law. Polina brings meticulous preparation and unwavering commitment to every case. She is especially attuned to the emotional complexity of family law and approaches each matter with sensitivity and professionalism.

Prior Experience

Prior to joining Ziegler Law Group LLC, Polina honed her litigation skills as an associate at Bressler, Amery, and Ross, P.C. While there, Polina practiced in areas of family law, securities, and commercial litigation. Her background in securities and commercial litigation further strengthens her ability to manage complex equitable distribution and business valuation issues in high-net-worth divorce cases.

Education and Service

A magna cum laude graduate of New York Law School, Polina served as an Executive Editor of the New York Law School Law Review, where her published note explored the legal implications of embryo adoption. As a student advocate with the NYLS Domestic Violence Project, she represented survivors of domestic violence in New York family courts. Since 2010, she has volunteered with the Battered Women’s Legal Advocacy Project in New Jersey.

Polina earned her undergraduate degree with high honors in English and Political Science from Rutgers University. She is fluent in Russian, and often assists international clients or Russian-speaking individuals seeking trustworthy and culturally competent legal representation.

Outside the Office

While not practicing law, Polina enjoys spending time with her husband and two children. She is an avid skier, hiker, and beachgoer.

Daniel R. Dowdy is an associate at Selikoff & Cohen.

Daniel has represented unions and union members before the Public Employment Relations Commission, the Office of Administrative Law, the School Ethics Commission, and other state agencies; in state trial and appellate courts; and in TEACHNJ tenure proceedings. A life-long resident of South Jersey, Leo continues to live in the area with his family, where he is active in his community, church, and he is currently Vice President of the New Jersey State Chess Federation.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content:
Leo B. Dubler III has been practicing law for 21 years, dedicating his career to representing individuals who have been victims of sexual harassment, victims of retaliation for being a whistleblower, victims of discrimination, and accident victims. Born and raised in New Jersey, Leo earned his both his undergraduate and law degrees from Rutgers University. After law school, Leo clerked for the Honorable Charles A. Little in Camden County Civil Court. After spending the first seven years of his career practicing in Atlantic City, Leo opened his own firm in 2001. His ambition was clear: to provide zealous, comprehensive, and compassionate advocacy for his clients and to help them seek compensation for the wrongs made against them. The firm takes on fewer cases so more time can spent on each client's matter. Throughout his career he has tried dozens of cases before a jury, and helped secure millions of dollars in compensation for his clients.

Leo is a Certified by the New Jersey Supreme Court as a Civil trial Attorney, a designation reserved for approximately 3% of New Jersey attorneys. Leo has been rated AV Preeminent through Martindale-Hubbell and named to the Super Lawyers. He is a member of Atlantic County, Burlington County, Gloucester County, Camden County, and New Jersey State Bar Associations. A life-long resident of South Jersey, Leo continues to live in the area with his family, where he is active in his community, church, and he is currently Vice President of the New Jersey State Chess Federation.

attorneys.name: Fawn B. Dyer
attorneys.practice_type: Family Law Lawyers in Livingston, NJ
attorneys.bio:
Fawn B. Dyer is highly experienced in all aspects of family law, including divorce, child support, child custody, alimony, equitable distribution, complex asset valuation, domestic violence, mediation, arbitration, termination of parental rights and all other family law matters.

Fawn is drawn to the practice of family law because it allows her to directly help people navigate through one of the most stressful times of their lives. Fawn has built a well-regarded reputation for handling complex, highly contested divorce and family matters, from the initial filing through case conclusion, as well as helping clients negotiate their matters through low conflict methods such as mediation. Fawn provides each of her clients with creative and compassionate legal representation that focuses on strategic solutions to address her clients’ unique needs and goals.

Fawn is also well-versed in real estate transactions, landlord-tenant matters, foreclosure defense, estate litigation, and consumer bankruptcies through the many clients that she has helped over the years.

She also served as an appointed pool attorney law guardian representing children in New Jersey Division of Child Protection and Permanency (formerly DYFS) child abuse and neglect cases. Fawn was appointed as law guardian for minor children-heirs in a complex foreclosure matter in Essex County. Among her notable court cases, Fawn successfully argued an appellate division case regarding college expense contribution: Novak v. Novak, No. A-2340-11t2, unpublished, NJ Appellate Division, Argued October 11, 2012, Decided March 22, 2013.

Fawn was judicial law clerk for Hon. Shirley A. Tolentino, J.S.C. (deceased) in the Superior Court of New Jersey, Hudson County, where she assisted her judge in all aspects of civil division court cases. Prior to being appointed as a judicial law clerk, Fawn interned for Hon. Shirley A. Tolentino, J.S.C. (deceased) and Hon. Torkwase Y. Sekou, J.S.C. in the Superior Court of New Jersey, Essex County, Family Part. During law school at Touro College Jacob D. Fuchsberg Law Center, Fawn represented clients in the Suffolk County Family Court in Central Islip, New York, as part of her law school’s family law clinic.

Prior to entering the law profession, Fawn worked for nearly 14 years in insurance, retirement, and financial services at two Fortune 500 companies with increasing responsibility during her tenure, mostly notably as Director of Institutional Services for a platform of unregistered commingled funds with over two billion in assets under management. She holds a Master of Business Administration in Finance from Rutgers Graduate School of Management and a Bachelor of Arts degree from Bowdoin College in Maine.

Fawn is a member of the American Bar Association, Family Law Section, and Phi Alpha Delta Law Fraternity. She is admitted to practice in the State of New Jersey, the United States District Court – District of New Jersey, the United States Court of Federal Claims, and the United States Supreme Court.

attorneys.name: Matthew Z. Earle
attorneys.firm_name: Kates Nussman Ellis Earle & Landolfi LLP
attorneys.practice_type: Community Association Law Lawyers in Hackensack, NJ
attorneys.bio:
Matthew Z. Earle

Matthew Z. Earle has been with the firm since April 2007. He concentrates his practice in the areas of community association law, construction defect litigation, general equity litigation, real estate tax appeals, international law, municipal land use, and commercial litigation in the state and federal courts of New Jersey and New York.

Mr. Earle provides a full range of legal services to the firm's community association clients, including, among other things: assisting with the transition of developer to unit owner control; interpreting and amending governing documents; preparing rules, resolutions, and other corporate documents; providing advice regarding management of association risk; assisting with insurance coverage issues; advising boards on fiduciary duties; handling covenant enforcement issues; assisting with the collection of arrears; administering association elections; and, representing community associations and individual owners in diverse litigated matters in various practice areas including, among others, construction defects, breach of contract, elections, and covenant enforcement. Furthermore, Mr. Earle frequently serves as an instructor in courses for both other attorneys and association board members on various topics including community association law, community association elections, and construction law. He and the firm are members of the New Jersey Chapter of the Community Association Institute (CAI-NJ). Mr. Earle is also a member of the CAI-NJ Legislative Action Committee, which is a committee that suggests changes to proposed laws to New Jersey elected officials in order to further the interests of community associations.

In addition to his experience in community association work, Mr. Earle has extensive experience handling complex litigation matters. He has handled, among other things, commercial contract claims, fraud claims, complex foreclosure claims, employment discrimination claims, defense of ADA claims against property owners, landlord-tenant matters, and civil rights claims. Also, Mr. Earle has represented clients in development applications before zoning and planning boards.

Representative matters include: successfully obtaining summary judgment dismissing various civil rights and tort claims while defending Township of Millburn municipal officials in the matter Haykell Development, LLC, et al. v. The Township of Millburn, et al., Docket No. ESX-L 6339-09; resolving multiple litigated and non-litigated condominium transition related matters with developers; successfully challenging the determination of a municipal zoning enforcement official; successfully resolving patent and trade secret litigation; and, successfully resolving various litigated matters involving community associations and their residents.

Mr. Earle, who is fluent in Mandarin Chinese, also has experience resolving disputes for Chinese based corporations and clients and in the United States, and assisting U.S. based clients resolve disputes in China.

Prior to joining the firm, Mr. Earle worked for a law firm in New York City that specialized in servicing Chinese speaking clients. Mr. Earle was a summer clerk for the Honorable M. Faith Angell, U.S. District Court, Eastern District of Pennsylvania.

Mr. Earle has published A Tribute to Frederic L. Kirgis, 62 Wash. & Lee L. Rev. 833 (2005). He has been Selected to the "Rising Stars" list by the New Jersey Super Lawyers Magazine in 2010, 2011, 2012, 2013, 2014, 2015, 2016, and 2017. Mr. Earle was also named as a Bergen County "Top Lawyer" by (201) Magazine in 2013 and 2017. Mr. Earle is a member of the New Jersey Bar Association and the Bergen County Bar Association, and serves on the Bergen County Bar Association General Equity and Construction Law Committees.

attorneys.name: Miriam S. Edelstein
attorneys.practice_type: Employment Law Lawyers in Mount Laurel, NJ
attorneys.bio:
Miriam S. Edelstein is a Partner with Costello & Silverman, LLC and represents individuals in employment and civil rights litigation across New Jersey and in southeastern Pennsylvania.

Miriam has focused on employment and civil rights law since she first began practicing in 2006, with her experience running the gamut from harassment, discrimination and retaliation claims, including whistleblower claims, to both individual and collective/class wage and hour actions.

Prior to joining the firm, Miriam practiced management-side Labor & Employment law and provided Human Resources counseling for over a dozen years at an AmLaw 100 firm as well as for a premier insurance carrier. During that time, Miriam also provided pro bono counsel to non-profit, charitable organizations, including Lambda Legal Defense & Education Fund, the nation's oldest and largest non-profit focused on the advancement of rights and protections for LGBTQ+ individuals. Miriam stepped away from private practice to join Lambda Legal full-time at its New York City headquarters as its Director of Strategic Partner Programs, working with the organization’s corporate sponsors to improve programs, policies and training to enhance their diversity, equity and inclusion (“DE&I”) efforts.

After returning to private practice, Miriam began advocating directly for plaintiffs when she joined Costello & Silverman, LLC in 2020. Drawing on more than a decade of prior legal practice representing companies and organizations across industries and sectors, ranging in size from small, start-ups to multinational, Fortune 20 corporations, Miriam's deep, substantive knowledge of employment and civil rights laws is rounded out by her practical knowledge of how employers and companies operate.

Outside of her practice, Miriam is highly committed to her volunteer work. She serves as an attorney-member of the New Jersey Supreme Court District Ethics Committee for District IIIB, and is on the Board of Governors for the New Jersey Association for Justice (“NJAJ”), where she is also a Co-Chair of the Diversity, Equity & Inclusion Committee, a member of the Education Committee, Civil Rights Committee, and Women Trial Lawyers’ Caucus, as well as works on amicus curiae briefs for NJAJ on cases pending before the New Jersey Supreme Court. She regularly organizes and presents CLE seminars focusing on substantive and procedural legal topics in employment law, civil litigation as well as DE&I topics, and has authored several articles for legal and business publications on these topics. Miriam is also a member of the New Jersey State Bar Association, the National LGBTQ+ Bar and a former Commissioner of the American Bar Association's Sexual Orientation and Gender Identity Commission.

Adjacent to her work within the legal profession, Miriam is most passionate about her outreach efforts to increase DE&I in the profession and among the future policy-makers and public in general by guest lecturing for students at Temple University on civics, workers' rights and civil rights.
