attorneys.name: Laura D. Ruccolo
attorneys.practice_type: Complex Civil Litigation Lawyers in Mt. Laurel, NJ
attorneys.bio:
As Co-Chair of the firm's Commercial Litigation Group, Ms. Ruccolo is an experienced "hands on" litigator with over 25 years of experience. She focuses her practice on complex commercial litigation, including the defense of class action litigation. She represents small, medium and large companies, banks and financial institutions and professionals and counsels them in all aspects of their business, from reviewing, negotiating and drafting contracts in a wide variety of areas, addressing employment issues and compliance issues. Ms. Ruccolo knows that open and regular communication with her client is essential to meeting the client's goals. Ms. Ruccolo tries to resolve business disputes before litigation becomes necessary.

Ms. Ruccolo's business background gives her insight and assists her in counseling and advising her clients. Prior to attending law school, Ms. Ruccolo worked for a local advertising newspaper, where she was responsible for supervising two departments with two shifts. Ms. Ruccolo has a Bachelor of Science Degree from Rutgers in Business Administration. Ms. Ruccolo's experience provides her with a business perspective that not all lawyers can offer. If litigation is necessary, she is tough and aggressive and has the courtroom experience to provide effective representation.

attorneys.name: Joseph E. Ruth
attorneys.firm_name: Gruccio Pepper De Santo & Ruth P.A.
attorneys.practice_type: Insurance Defense Lawyers in Vineland, NJ
attorneys.bio:
Joseph E. Ruth graduated from Villanova University in 1980 with a Bachelor of Arts Degree in History. In 1982, he received a Master of Arts Degree in History from the same University. In 1985, Mr. Ruth graduated from the Widener University School of Law.

Mr. Ruth was admitted to the practice of law in the states of New Jersey and Pennsylvania in 1987. In 1991, Mr. Ruth became an associate with the Gruccio Pepper Law Offices, and became a Shareholder in the firm in 2002.

Mr. Ruth’s practice focuses on the representation of clients in the trial of civil matters primarily involving the assertion or defense of personal injury claims. Mr. Ruth also handles criminal and municipal court matters, routinely appearing in the Superior Courts and Municipal Courts in southern New Jersey on behalf of clients who are charged with indictable, non-indictable, motor vehicle, and ordinance violation matters.

Mr. Ruth has also served as a court-appointed arbitrator in personal injury and automobile accident cases, and similarly is selected to serve as an arbitrator in common law arbitrations. Mr. Ruth has also lectured at numerous seminars the themes of which focused on the handling of personal injury cases from initial consultation, to investigation and evidence gathering/conservation, to pre-suit negotiations, to the institution of legal proceedings, to discovery and ultimately to the preparation and execution of successful trial strategies that best represent the interests of the client.

In 2002, Mr. Ruth’s trial skills were officially recognized by the New Jersey Supreme Court Board on Attorney Certification when the Court certified Mr. Ruth as a Civil Trial Attorney. Mr. Ruth has since maintained his Board Certification and routinely attends continuing legal education classes to stay current with the legal, trial and ethical issues he confronts in his practice.

Mr. Ruth is a member and former President of the Cumberland County Bar Association. He is also a member of the New Jersey State Bar Association, the Bar for the United States District Court of the District of New Jersey, the Bar of the United States Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit and the Bar of the United States Supreme Court. Mr. Ruth appears as trial counsel in Federal Court, and all the Superior and Municipal Courts in Southern New Jersey.

Mr. Ruth has also served as a member of the District I Ethics Committee (DEC), responsible for investigating allegations of ethical violations committed by attorneys practicing within the district. In 2010, Mr. Ruth served as Chairperson of the DEC and thereafter was selected by the Office of Attorney Ethics (OAE) to serve as a “Special Ethics Master” responsible for conducting the hearings of complex ethics matters and reporting the results of those hearings to the OAE.

Of Counsel | The Law Offices of Peter G. Aziz & Associates LLCFounding Partner | Sabbagh Thapar, LLC

Salim F. Sabbagh, Esq., serves as Of Counsel to The Law Offices of Peter G. Aziz & Associates LLC while also leading his own firm, Sabbagh Thapar, LLC, where his practice is devoted exclusively to representing individuals who have suffered serious personal injuries. Salim has earned a statewide and national reputation for delivering justice to clients injured in motor vehicle accidents, slip and fall incidents, dog attacks, and other negligence-related cases.

A seasoned trial attorney admitted in both New Jersey and New York, Salim has secured numerous multi-million-dollar verdicts and settlements on behalf of his clients. attorneys.name: Ellen Radow Sadat
attorneys.practice_type: Clean Air Act and NJ Air Pollution Control Act Lawyers in Haddonfield, NJ
attorneys.bio:
Ellen Radow Sadat practices in the areas of air, hazardous substance and water regulation at both the New Jersey and federal levels. Ellen is frequently called upon by Fortune 500 chemical and pharmaceutical companies and others to provide compliance and environmental transactional advice, to represent them in administrative permitting and enforcement matters, and to negotiate with the agencies on their behalf. In addition, Ellen represents companies subject to hazardous substance cleanups at the state and federal levels and in related private party disputes, as well as strategically managing Industrial Site Remediation Act requirements.

She has led internal environmental investigations and counseled clients performing audits, often resulting in self-reporting of violations and negotiating settlement agreements with the New Jersey Department of Environmental Protection (NJDEP) or U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA). Ellen previously served as an attorney at the EPA Region 2 Air and Superfund Branches and held various positions in the New Jersey Department of Environmental Protection (NJDEP) before entering private practice in 1987. While she was at the NJDEP, Ellen was a primary author of New Jersey's NJPDES Regulations, the state's key water discharge control program. She also was responsible for air, hazardous waste, solid waste, noise and pesticide enforcement.

Civic Board Memberships. Ellen served on the New Jersey Committee of the Regional Plan Association, was a board member of the Big Brothers/Big Sisters of Mercer County, and was a member, as well as a former vice president, of Homefront.

Professional Memberships. Ellen is member of the New Jersey State Bar Association, the former vice chair of the Central New Jersey Chapter of the Air & Waste Management Association, a former member of the New Jersey Business and Industry Association, Chemistry Council of New Jersey, the Association of Environmental Authorities, and the Water Environment Federation. She was legislatively appointed to the Small Business Assistance Program established under the Clean Air Act.

In General. Ellen is a member of the New Jersey bar. She served as adjunct professor of environmental law at Farleigh Dickinson University, 1978-1982 and at Rutgers University, New Brunswick, 2010-2012.

attorneys.name: Carmen Saginario Jr.
attorneys.practice_type: Labor and Employment - Employer Lawyers in Mt. Laurel, NJ
attorneys.bio:
As Co-Chair of the firm's Labor & Employment Group, Mr. Saginario focuses his practice on employment counseling and litigation. He regularly counsels clients on litigation avoidance, personnel policies and procedures including those associated with the Americans with Disabilities Act, Family and Medical Leave Act and Fair Labor Standards Act, employment discipline, layoffs and other terminations. Mr. Saginario directs and participates in internal investigations involving claims of harassment, policy violations, ethics and other employment issues. He also appears on behalf of private and public sector clients before the judiciary as well as State and Federal administrative agencies (EEOC, N.J. Division on Civil Rights, etc.). Mr. Saginario is also experienced in representing clients before arbitrators and mediators. He has negotiated numerous public collective negotiations agreements (e.g., law enforcement, public works, etc.) and has successfully participated in interest arbitration proceedings before the Public Employment Relations Commission.

Mr. Saginario also regularly represents clients in administrative and complex civil litigation matters and also supervises Capehart Scatchard's Corporate Compliance Group which counsels and assists public and private sector entities on establishing and implementing legal and ethics compliance programs.

Mr. Saginario serves as counsel for governmental and other entities (including counties, municipalities, school boards, and fire districts) and individuals with respect to laws governing public entities, as well as educational, procurement, environmental, transportation, and public safety issues.

attorneys.bio:
David is also an acknowledged leader in the New Jersey family law community for employing resolution methods, including Divorce Mediation and Collaborative Practice, to successfully minimize conflict and create constructive solutions.

As the Past President and current Executive Board member of the New Jersey Collaborative Law Group, David was instrumental in the passage of the New Jersey Family Collaborative Law Act of 2014. This milestone law paved the way for couples in the state to resolve family law matters through communication and cooperation, rather than conflict. David is a true specialist in helping clients take control of their futures and avoid the stress and expense of prolonged court battles through less adversarial approaches that create a healthy new chapter in their lives.

David graduated from Rutgers Law School, where he distinguished himself as an Editor of the prestigious Rutgers Law Review. He has also earned recognition as a New Jersey Super Lawyer, highlighting his exceptional standing among his legal peers. These accolades and leadership roles reflect the deep respect he has garnered within the legal community and provide clients with the confidence that their case is in the hands of a highly regarded and trusted professional.

When he is not helping clients, David is devoted to his family, which include a wife and two daughters whom he has supported in becoming respected medical and legal professionals in their own right, as well as three young grandchildren with whom he engages in various activities each weekend.

attorneys.firm_name: Law Offices of Peter G. Aziz & Associates LLC
attorneys.practice_type: Lawyers in Clifton, NJ
attorneys.bio:
Andrew brings a rich and diverse background to his legal practice, with broad experience in family law, civil litigation, as well as contract and commercial law. Known for devoting his full attention to every case because success lies not only in knowing the law, but in mastering the details that bring each case to life

Whether guiding individuals through emotionally charged divorce proceedings or advising businesses on complex commercial issues, Andrew is committed to delivering the highest caliber of legal representation and is unwavering in his pursuit of favorable results for his clients.

Before joining the firm, Andrew practiced law at a respected New Jersey law firm where he focused on family law and civil litigation. He has represented clients in all aspects of family law, including divorce, custody and parenting time, alimony, equitable distribution, pre-marital and mid-marriage agreements, and domestic violence matters. Prior to that, he practiced at a distinguished law firm in New York City, handling a wide array of complex commercial litigation cases and other civil matters. In addition to litigation, Andrew has represented clients of all sizes, from individuals to large companies, in business law and transactional matters.

Andrew's legal practice is further informed by his strong professional background in project and program management, mergers and acquisitions, vendor management, corporate compliance, and information technology. This unique combination of legal knowledge and business acumen enables him to offer holistic, strategic counsel to clients facing multifaceted legal challenges.

He earned his Juris Doctor from New York Law School’s accelerated honors program, completing the degree in two years rather than the traditional three. During law school, he was named to the Dean’s List, clerked for an Honorable Judge in the Superior Court of New Jersey, and worked as a summer associate at a New York City law firm.

Outside the office, Andrew trains in a martials arts called Krav Maga, a military self-defense system, and is learning to play the piano.

attorneys.name: Angelo Sarno
attorneys.firm_name: Sarno da Costa D'Aniello Maceri Webb LLC
attorneys.practice_type: Family Law Lawyers in Roseland, NJ
attorneys.bio:
Angelo Sarno is the founding and managing partner of the law firm Sarno da Costa D’Aniello Maceri Webb LLC. He is certified by the Supreme Court of New Jersey as a matrimonial attorney.

Angelo Sarno is a distinguished family law attorney, representing clients in various complex matrimonial cases throughout New Jersey. In 2014, Angelo received national recognition for his involvement in representing the parents in the matter Rachel Canning vs. Sean and Elizabeth Canning, a case that involved a lawsuit between a daughter and her parents. In addition, on September 25, 2014, Angelo Sarno’s successful arguments before the State Supreme Court in Maeker v. Ross established a legal precedent for the matrimonial law community. The unanimous Supreme Court, agreeing with Angelo’s arguments, ruled that oral palimony agreements entered into prior to the New Jersey Legislature’s amendment to the Statute of Frauds remain enforceable. In addition, Angelo Sarno co-authored a book titled New Jersey Family Law Forms for the New Jersey Law Journal.

Angelo has lectured and presented seminars for the American Academy of Matrimonial Attorneys, New Jersey Association for Justice (formerly ATLA – NJ Educational Foundation), and New Jersey Institute for Continuing Legal Education. Angelo has also taught the Family Law Paralegal Program course at Fairleigh Dickinson University. He has also provided legal commentary with a panel of experts on the O.J. Simpson custody case for the NJ8 News with Lynn Doyle.

attorneys.bio:
Bridget Saro is an associate attorney with Sellar Richardson P.C., with expertise in personal injury litigation.

She is a graduate of New York Law School, and admitted to practice in New Jersey, New York, United States District Court of New Jersey, United States District Court Southern District of New York, and Third Circuit Court of Appeals.

Ms. Saro started her career at Dinkes and Morelli in New York before changing to New Jersey practice with the Imperial, Zazzaro and Calabro. She then started with the Law Office of Frank Zarraro. She has over 30 years’ experience in civil litigation concentrating on insurance coverage, personal injury, insurance defense, and appellate practice. She successfully argued to include a child’s right to PIP coverage despite a parent’s misrepresentation in the case of Rutgers Cas. Ins. Co. v. LaCroix, 194 N.J. 515 (2008).

Ms. Saro is a member of the New Jersey State Bar Association, New Jersey Defense Association, Essex County Bar Association and serves as Essex County Bar Panelist.

attorneys.name: Victoria C. Schaefer
attorneys.practice_type: Employment Lawyers in Red Bank, NJ
attorneys.bio:
Ms. Schaefer is an associate at McOmber McOmber & Luber, P.C., in the firm’s Red Bank, New Jersey office. She primarily focuses her practice on employment litigation, representing clients in matters involving discrimination, sexual harassment, retaliation, wrongful termination, and whistleblower claims. Ms. Schaefer is a zealous advocate who believes that everyone has the right to work in a safe and comfortable workplace.

Ms. Schaefer graduated from the University of Texas at Austin with a Bachelor of Science in Public Health. While an undergraduate, she served as a legislative intern in the Texas House of Representatives handling constituent matters, strengthening her passion for the law and helping others. Following her graduation from UT Austin, she attended Seton Hall University School of Law, receiving a concentration in Health Law.

Following her first year at Seton Hall Law, Ms. Schaefer served as a Judicial Intern in the New Jersey Superior Court, Family Division in Monmouth County for the Honorable Theresa-Kondrup-Coyle. During her second year, Ms. Schaefer dove deeper into her passion for employment law and litigation, joining the team at McOmber McOmber & Luber, P.C. as a law clerk in the firm’s Red Bank Office.

While at Seton Hall Law, Ms. Schaefer was an associate editor for the Seton Hall Law Journal of Legislation and Public Policy. She served as the Vice President of the Health Law forum and Managing Editor of the Health Law Outlook. During her final year, Ms. Schaefer was selected for the Seton Hall University School of Law Settlement Conference Advocacy Program as a Student Advocate. Ms. Schaefer represented federal litigants in the District of New Jersey for settlement purposes handling cases such as FMLA Interference, wrongful termination, and representing incarcerated individuals in their Section 1983 claims.

Following her graduation from Seton Hall Law, Ms. Schaefer joined the McOmber McOmber & Luber team as an associate in the Red Bank office.

attorneys.bio:
Michael D. Schaller was admitted to practice in the State of New Jersey in 1998. Michael dedicates his practice to criminal defense matters in both municipal and county courts. Previous to joining KKJ&M, Michael was a member of the New Jersey State Police and retired after 26 years of service holding the rank of Major and position of Chief of Staff.

Michael has represented clients in County courts throughout New Jersey charged with crimes including distribution of drugs, aggravated assault, robbery and theft. Michael also represents clients in municipal courts throughout Ocean and Monmouth counties for offenses such as DWI, driving while suspended, possession of marijuana, shoplifting and disorderly persons offenses. While assigned to the Criminal Investigations Section, Michael conducted a broad spectrum of investigations targeting conspiracy, narcotics trafficking & assaults.

Michael has served as an Adjunct Professor at Seton Hall University and Georgian Court College on courses including Public Policy, Cyber Law, Employment Law and Business Law.

attorneys.name: William H. Schmidt Jr. Esq.
attorneys.practice_type: Business Lawyers in Englewood, NJ
attorneys.bio:
William Schmidt concentrates his practice in the areas of business, commercial, secured transaction, finance and real estate law, with emphasis on business counseling, business organization, corporate/limited liability company governance, contract preparation and review, loan transactions, mergers and acquisitions and real estate matters. Mr. Schmidt has broad and varied experience representing both lenders and borrowers in asset-based and real estate loan transactions. Mr. Schmidt has extensive experience in representing clients with respect to the sale and purchase of businesses (both asset and stock/membership interest sales), the sale and purchase of real estate and the preparation and/or review and negotiation of a broad range of commercial/business agreements including, but not limited to, consulting agreements, employment agreements, consignment agreements, confidentiality and non-disclosure agreements, non-competition agreements, distribution agreements, franchise agreements, stockholders' agreements, operating agreements and commercial and residential real estate leases. In addition, over the years, Mr. Schmidt has developed expertise in representing clients in the interstate natural gas pipeline, diamond/jewelry, textile and information technology staffing augmentation industries.

Mr. Schmidt served as Law Clerk to the Honorable Peter J. Cass, Judge of Superior Court of the State of New Jersey. Prior to joining the Firm as Counsel, Mr. Schmidt was partner in two prestigious New Jersey law firms. Before practicing law, Mr. Schmidt held management positions at Sea-Land Service, Inc., an intermodal transportation company.

In the nonprofit sector, Mr. Schmidt served as Trustee and Vice President of the Board of Trustees of Essex Valley School, Inc., a New Jersey private alternative middle/high school and served as a Board Director and Board Treasurer and President of Osteogenesis Imperfecta Foundation, Inc., a national voluntary health organization.

attorneys.name: Linda A. Schofel
attorneys.firm_name: Sarno da Costa D'Aniello Maceri Webb LLC
attorneys.practice_type: Family Law Lawyers in Roseland, NJ
attorneys.bio:
Linda Schofel has been a family law attorney for more than 30 years, including more than 20 years as a partner at her previous firm: Newman, McDonough, Schofel & Giger, P.C. In March of 2022, she moved to Sarno da Costa D’Aniello Maceri Webb to join their family law division as “Of Counsel.” She has Masters Degrees in Rehabilitation Counseling and Social Work. Ms. Schofel is also a Licensed Clinical Social Worker (LCSW) and is collaboratively trained. She is a trained mediator for domestic violence matters in the New Jersey pilot program. Her background, training, and experience in individual, group, and family therapy together with her degree in law led her to serve as a family and divorce mediator. Out of her dual background, she has developed an award-winning reputation as a fair, patient, thoughtful, and resourceful parenting coordinator and guardian ad litem for children and adults. Ms. Schofel has been working with the courts in matters pertaining to families and children in various capacities since 1973, including serving as a court-appointed therapist and forensic social worker, as well as directing the Adolescent Assessment Team at the District Court in Somerville, Massachusetts. She also maintained a private therapy practice in Cambridge, Massachusetts. Ms. Schofel’s level and scope of achievement have resulted in appointments from judges in Bergen, Essex, Hudson, Hunterdon, Middlesex, Morris, Passaic, Somerset, Sussex, and Union County Superior Courts to serve as a Guardian Ad Litem and/or as a Parent Coordinator where she has served with distinction. She has appeared in court on numerous occasions, including an argument before the Supreme Court of New Jersey. Among her many honors, Ms. Schofel has been included by Super Lawyers for the years 2007 through 2023. In 2009, she was named as among the top 50 New Jersey women attorneys.

attorneys.practice_type: Workers' Compensation Lawyers in Cherry Hill, NJ
attorneys.bio:
Alan L. Schwalbe is a partner at Jacobs, Schwalbe & Petruzzelli, P.C. Since 1980 Mr. Schwalbe has been practicing workers' compensation, personal injury litigation and Social Security disability claims. He has represented petitioners and plaintiffs before the New Jersey Division of Worker's Compensation and in the New Jersey Superior Courts, both at the trial level and in the appellate courts, as well as in the Federal District Courts and in the US Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit. Mr. Schwalbe is certified by the Supreme Court of New Jersey as a Workers' Compensation Attorney and is the subject of a biography published in Who's Who in American Law. He was just honored with the highest possible rating - AV Preeminent by Martindale-Hubbell.

Mr. Schwalbe has lectured frequently on radio, television and before professional and civic groups on topics relating to workers' compensation and has written and published several articles on subjects relating to New Jersey Workers' Compensation law. One article that was written by Mr. Schwalbe for New Jersey Lawyer titled: "Update: Third-Party Workers Comp Liens," Mr. Schwalbe received his B.A. degree from Mary Washington College (now the University of Mary Washington), and his J.D. degree at the Rutgers’ University School of Law, Camden.

On November 29, 2023 Mr. Schwalbe was a Presenter, for a Live Online Seminar entitled New Jersey Workers' Compensation Fundamentals.

Mr. Schwalbe has served as a Board Member, Officer and President of the Camden County Bar Association and as a Trustee, Officer and President of the Camden County Bar Foundation. He has also served as a trustee of the Camden Regional Legal Services, and is a former member of the Supreme Court of New Jersey District Ethics Committee, Burlington County, District IIIB. Mr. Schwalbe is also the current co-chair of the Workers' Compensation Committee and past co-chair of the Public Benefits Committee of the Camden County Bar Association. He is a member of the New Jersey State and American Bar Associations and the New Jersey Association for Justice, formerly the Association of Trial Lawyers of America-New Jersey.

attorneys.name: Howard J. Schwartz Esq.
attorneys.practice_type: Business Law Lawyers in Princeton, NJ
attorneys.bio:
Howard Schwartz is a veteran trial lawyer and litigator with more than 25 years of high level, sophisticated experience in business and commercial disputes in multiple jurisdictions, including New York and New Jersey. He has been first chair and lead trial counsel in cases concerning contract disputes involving purchase and sale of businesses, close corporation shareholder conflicts, employment discrimination, intellectual property rights including copyright and trademark rights, both in international arenas and solely in the United States.

He has represented the successful party in an arbitration with 3 arbitrators over 76 days of testimony concerning the sale of a business, a restrictive covenant and patent interpretation.

During the course of his work, Mr. Schwartz has represented multiple parties in a single case, worked with General Counsel and business executives to analyze risk, to determine whether to initiate a case, to determine when to settle, if at all, and the overall strategy to apply to a particular set of facts and circumstances.

Representative clients represented by Mr. Schwartz were public companies, including one of the largest pharmaceutical companies and one of the largest book publishers in the world, the producer of “the Good, the Bad and the Ugly,” the authors of “Grease,” the author of “The First Wives’ Club,” a contract manufacturer of confectionary goods for one of the largest food companies and one of the world’s most prominent luxury resort management companies.

Mr. Schwartz represents small family owned and operated businesses and individuals, providing them with the high level, sophisticated care to successfully resolve each crisis and dispute.

Mr. Schwartz graduated from New York University School of Law, was a master of the John H. Lifland Inn of Court, listed in Who’s Who, listed in Best Lawyers of New Jersey, Best Lawyers of New York, and a lecturer for ABA sponsored CLE.

attorneys.name: Mark R. Scirocco Esq.
attorneys.practice_type: Lawyers in Morristown, NJ
attorneys.bio:
Mark R. Scirocco is a partner at Scirocco Law, P.C. He specializes in insurance defense, insurance coverage, construction defect, toxic tort, employment, dram shop, professional negligence, premises liability, and employment law. Mark has a long record of successfully handling high-profile matters in New Jersey state and federal trial courts. He is also an experienced appellate advocate, having argued multiple times before the Supreme Court of New Jersey and the New Jersey Appellate Division. His precedent setting cases include The Estate of Narleski v. Gomes, 244 N.J. 199 (2020), which involved social host liability for those under the age of 21 who facilitate underage drinking in their homes, and Pareja v. Princeton Int'l Props., 246 N.J. 546 (2021), involving liability for commercial property owners during snowstorms.

Prior to joining the firm, Mark clerked for a judge on the Fairfax Circuit Court in Fairfax, VA. He is a graduate of the George Mason University Antonin Scalia Law School. He achieved his undergraduate degree from Providence College, where he graduated summa cum laude.

While in law school, Mark was one of 12 students selected as part of the George Mason Supreme Court Clinic and worked on several matters before the Supreme Court of the United States. He also interned in various capacities for the Federal Government including at the U.S. House of Representatives, Committee on Oversight and Government Reform; the U.S. Court of Federal Claims, chambers of Judge Lawrence Block; and the U.S. Department of Justice, Criminal Division, Fraud Section. In 2012, Mark’s Moot Court team won First Place at the Billings, Exum & Frye National Moot Court Competition at Elon University School of Law. He was named Best Oral Advocate in the final round of that competition, which was argued before a panel of current and retired justices of the North Carolina Supreme Court.

Mark has previously served as a Trustee of the Morris County Bar Foundation. He is currently appointed by the Supreme Court of New Jersey to the District X Fee Arbitration Committee.

attorneys.name: Jason Shafron Esq.
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Hackensack, NJ
attorneys.bio:
Jason T. Shafron concentrates his practice in the areas of business law and litigation; employment, real estate and personal injury litigation; and government law. He is also experienced in zoning, planning, and land use issues, and he possesses insight into the codes and complex regulations that effect property use in New Jersey today. His work has included matters such as product liability, construction, trade secret, employment, and real estate cases in state and federal trial and appellate courts, and representation of individuals and companies in diverse business disputes.

A 1988 graduate of Bucknell University, Mr. Shafron earned B.A. degrees in both Economics and Political Science. During his studies at Villanova University School of Law, he served as a research assistant in bankruptcy and tax law, as well as studying in London, England. After he received his J.D. in 1991, Mr. Shafron served as a judicial clerk to the Honorable Thomas S. O'Brien, J.A.D., of the New Jersey Superior Court, Appellate Division.

Mr. Shafron's legal experience was broadened by his time practicing law in San Francisco. He gained invaluable experience from Silicon Valley where he represented numerous types of businesses, from start-ups to Fortune 50 corporations. He successfully has litigated ERISA; insurance coverage; stock option dispute; product liability; real estate; and class action cases. Mr. Shafron has also represented financial institutions, private lenders, developers, and brokers in varied real estate-related transactions and litigation.

Mr. Shafron is a member of the Bergen County, New Jersey, and American Bar Associations. He has participated in the Bergen County Bar Association's Annual Land Use Symposium, where he lectured regarding the impact of a U.S. Supreme Court decision on eminent domain and development in New Jersey, and serves as a judge for the Bar Association's Mock Trial Competition. As a member of the Justice William J. Brennan Jr. Chapter of the American Inns of Court, Mr. Shafron further honed his litigation skills during a two-year training program.

attorneys.name: Richard A. Shapiro
attorneys.firm_name: Weinberger Divorce & Family Law Group, LLC
attorneys.practice_type: Alimony and Palimony Lawyers in Mount Laurel, NJ
attorneys.bio:
Richard “Rick” Shapiro, Esq. is a family law attorney with Weinberger Divorce & Family Law Group, LLC. Drawn to the challenging yet rewarding nature of family law and the ability it gives him to assist people during times of great uncertainty in their lives, Rick has successfully handled countless family and matrimonial cases throughout his esteemed career, covering all aspects of divorce, asset division, child custody, child support, domestic violence, post-judgment modifications, enforcement of family court orders, and related legal matters.

With decades of experience, Rick has developed a deep understanding of the complexities of family law, allowing him to craft strategic solutions that not only address his clients’ immediate concerns but also set them up for a more secure future. Clients rely on Rick for his unwavering commitment to resolving their legal challenges with a clear focus on their personal goals. Recognizing how overwhelming family law matters can be, Rick excels at finding creative solutions to complex issues, helping clients uncover the potential positives in difficult situations and ensuring they emerge stronger and more confident on the other side.

Rick’s approach is grounded in problem-solving, always prioritizing what truly matters to his clients. Whether negotiating with opposing counsel to reach a mutually accepted resolution or preparing for trial, Rick remains laser-focused on achieving the best possible outcomes. His ability to cut through distractions and keep the process moving forward gives clients confidence and peace of mind that they are in capable hands.

In addition to his extensive family law experience, Rick’s background in business transactions equips him to handle complex cases involving business ownership and financial intricacies. This added layer of financial skill ensures clients with high-stakes assets receive comprehensive representation tailored to their unique circumstances.

Rick earned his JD with honors from Rutgers University School of Law and holds a BA in politics from Brandeis University. He has been a respected member of the New Jersey State Bar Association for decades and is an active member of the Camden County Bar Association.

Outside of the courtroom, Rick enjoys cheering on his favorite football team (Go Birds!), spending time with his two dogs, and indulging in great food and wine.

attorneys.firm_name: R.C. Shea & Associates, Counsellors at Law
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Toms River, NJ
attorneys.bio:
Christopher R. Shea (“Chris”) specializes in Personal Injury, Workers’ Compensation, Construction, Land Use, Criminal Defense, and Discrimination cases. Chris has received his LLM, (Masters Degree) in Trial Advocacy from the nationally ranked Temple University School of Law in Philadelphia and regularly represents clients in Federal, State, and Municipal Courts throughout New Jersey.

Despite his love of the Court room, Chris’ favorite aspect of the law is working with his clients to reveal the truth in their case. You see, Chris grew up around the law. As a boy, Chris would accompany his father Robert C. Shea to hearings, trials, and client meetings whenever he had the opportunity. It was through these experiences Chris quickly learned that you cannot expect a judge or jury to understand and feel the injustice suffered by your client unless you take the time to understand it yourself.

To this day, Chris keeps this key lesson in mind, as shown through his empathetic approach with clients, as well as, his ability to convey their story in the court room.

In addition to his legal accolades, Chris is an active member of Ocean County and has served on multiple boards including, the Ocean County Vocational Technical School, United Way, and the Boy Scouts.

attorneys.name: Robert C. Shea
attorneys.firm_name: R.C. Shea & Associates, Counsellors at Law
attorneys.practice_type: Land Use and Planning / Development / Litigation Lawyers in Toms River, NJ
attorneys.bio:
Robert C. Shea, Esquire, has been practicing law in Toms River since 1979. Bob was born in Hudson County, but moved to Toms River in 1968. He had begun high school at St. Peter’s Preparatory School in Jersey City. When his family moved to Toms River, he continued his education at Toms River High School North. He was part of the first graduating class from that facility. After high school, he attended Villanova University, graduating Cum Laude in 1975. He completed his education at the University of Dayton Law School, graduating from the JD/MBA Program and received his law degree in 1979.

Being active in the community has always been a priority for Bob. During the last 30 years, Bob has assisted numerous organizations by chairing and serving on various boards. He has worked intimately with the Toms River/Ocean County Chamber of Commerce and served as Chairman of that organization in 2003. He has also served on the Board of the Toms River Student Loan Fund as a trustee, and has devoted time and energy to the American Cancer Society, American Heart Association, United Way, Toms River Technology Foundation, Ocean County Vocational Foundation, Ocean County Tourism Counsel, Jersey Shore Council of Boy Scouts, and Jersey Shore Council of Girl Scouts. He currently serves as a member of the Toms River Downtown Business Improvement District and chairs the Economic Development Committee which is seeking to bring economic growth to the downtown Toms River area. He is a past recipient of the Ocean County Chamber of Commerce Citizen of the Year, 2004; Toms River Student Loan Fund Honoree, 2001; Good Scout Award, Jersey Shore Council Boy Scouts of America, 2009; Toms River/Ocean County Chamber of Commerce Pinnacle Award 2010. He also received a Special Achievement Award by the Columbia Civic League of Ocean County in 2004. He also serves on the advisory board of Shore Community Bank He is the host of Inside the Law and writes a weekly column for the Toms River Times; Manchester Times; Berkeley Times; and the Brick Township Times.

He also regularly appears as numerous news outlets including, but not limited to, CNN, and Fox News through Comcast.net.

He also continues to act as Master of Ceremonies for numerous organizations including the Toms River/Ocean County Chamber of Commerce; American Cancer Society; Toms River Student Loan Fund; Children’s Specialty Hospital; and numerous other charitable organizations.

Mr. Shea is a multi-disciplined attorney with 32 years of experience. He has extensive experience in the land use and development practice and has assisted some of the major corporations in America in securing their development approvals on a municipal, county and state level. He has appeared before over 100 planning board in the State of New Jersey. He has assisted clients with the New Jersey Department of Transportation applications and permits and has negotiated resolutions with the New Jersey Department of Environmental Protection.

Mr. Shea also has extensive trial and appellate experience in litigating complex commercial and land use matters.

He has also extensive trial experience in Personal Injury matters and Workers’ Compensation claims.

He has been successful in obtaining multi-million dollar settlements for clients who suffered serious personal injury as well as those who have been injured at work.

Mr. Shea frequently appears and tries cases in the New Jersey Superior Court and has argued numerous appeals in the Superior Court of New Jersey, Appellate Division and the New Jersey Supreme Court.

Mr. Shea specializes in the areas of Land Use and Planning and Development/Litigation; Personal Injury law; Workers’ Compensation law; and Elder law/Estate litigation.

Mr. Shea’s professional affiliations include the American Bar Association; American Trial Lawyers’ Association; National Academy of Elder Attorneys; New Jersey Bar Association (subsection Personal Injury and Land Use Committee) and the Villanova Alumnus Committee.

attorneys.name: Brenden T. Shur
attorneys.firm_name: The Law Offices of John Zarych
attorneys.practice_type: Criminal Law Lawyers in Northfield, NJ
attorneys.bio:
Mr. Shur has a passion for arguing cases for his clients. He is an experienced trial attorney and accomplished legal writer. Brenden is an active member of the National Association of Criminal Defense Lawyers, American Bar Association, Atlantic County Bar Association, The National Trial Lawyers, Cape May County Bar Association, New Jersey State Bar Association and the NRA.

He received his Juris Doctor Degree from Rutgers School of Law - Camden. While attending law school, Mr. Shur was honored as a Top-10 Oralist and Octofinalist in The Honorable James Hunter III Memorial Advanced Moot Court Competition. Prior to attending Rutgers Law School, Mr. Shur had a successful career in journalism. During that time, Mr. Shur worked as a reporter for the Press of Atlantic City and the Ocean County Observer. While at the Ocean County Observer, Mr. Shur was a beat reporter assigned to covering police and courts. As a result, Mr. Shur spent countless hours observing and reporting on various criminal trials, including capital murder cases. It was after observing court proceedings for several years that he became motivated to obtain his Juris Doctor and get into the legal arena. His reporting earned him a commendation from the Ocean County Prosecutor's Office for his accuracy in reporting. During law school, Mr. Shur also volunteered at the Atlantic City Rescue Mission, using the skills he learned as a cook while earning his way through college to prepare food for the homeless and destitute.

Mr. Shur believes the legal profession and journalism have much in common. He utilizes the skills of research and writing, which are the hallmarks of a good journalist, to vigorously defend his clients. He believes that the best way to manage a situation is to get out in front of a problem and create a framework within which the case will be viewed by all parties. By using this technique, Mr. Shur is often able to obtain remarkable results as he creates a narrative for his clients to humanize them to the prosecutors.

attorneys.name: Ronald P. Sierzega
attorneys.practice_type: Estate Planning and Litigation Lawyers in Woodbury, NJ
attorneys.bio:
Mr. Sierzega was born and raised in the Lehigh Valley in Pennsylvania. He graduated as a National Merit Scholar from Whitehall High School, in Whitehall, Pennsylvania, where he lettered in tennis.

Mr. Sierzega attended Villanova University, where he graduated with a Bachelor of Arts degree. During his time at Villanova University, Mr. Sierzega was President of Sigma Nu Fraternity, as well as the Treasurer of the Interfraternity Council.

Following graduation, Mr. Sierzega returned to attend Villanova University School of Law, where he graduated with his Juris Doctor in 1995. After passing the Pennsylvania and New Jersey bar exams, Mr. Sierzega practiced at a defense firm in Cherry Hill, New Jersey, becoming a partner after 6 years. Mr. Sierzega then moved to Hoffman DiMuzio, in Gloucester County, where he headed their commercial department. Mr. Sierzega has 25 years experience as a practicing New Jersey attorney and has lived in Gloucester County for the past 21 years.

Mr. Sierzega took the opportunity to join Puff & Cockerill at the beginning of 2008. His practice consists of all types of litigation, with an emphasis in estate litigation, estate planning, commercial law, consumer fraud, insurance, small business and real estate matters. Within the Estate Planning spectrum, Mr. Sierzega handles wills, trusts and estate administration. Over the course of his 25 years of experience, Mr. Sierzega has had several published opinions by the New Jersey Supreme Court and New Jersey Appellate Division.

Mr. Sierzega is currently a Trustee and member of the Gloucester County Bar Association. He is a former Chair of the Gloucester County Civil Practice Committee and former President of the Gloucester County Bar Association. Mr. Sierzega is currently the Co-Chairman of the Elder Law Committee of the Bar Association.

Mr. Sierzega lives in West Deptford, New Jersey with his wife Beth and their two daughters, Alexa and Taylor. Mr. Sierzega is an active long-distance runner, having completed several marathons including the New York City Marathon in the past few years.

attorneys.practice_type: Employment Lawyers in Mount Laurel, NJ
attorneys.bio:
Daniel Silverman graduated from The George Washington University in 2005 and earned his J.D. from Rutgers-Camden School of Law in 2008. While in law school, he was awarded a Governor's Executive Fellowship by the Rutgers Eagleton Institute of Politics, an interdisciplinary fellowship that provides select Rutgers graduate students the opportunity to further their understanding of government, public affairs and the practice of politics, as well as to connect the fellowship experience to their chosen fields of study. Following his graduation Dan clerked in the Superior Court of New Jersey before entering private practice.

Dan joined the firm as an associate in 2010 and had was elevated to partner in 2015. He has devoted his practice primarily to employment and civil rights litigation since that time. He conducts all aspects of litigation, including trying numerous matters to verdict. Dan brings to the firm practical experience and a lifelong commitment to equality. He is an active member of the New Jersey Association for Justice. He resides in South Jersey with his family. He is licensed to practice law in New Jersey and Pennsylvania.

attorneys.name: Kendal Sim Esq.
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Palisades Park, NJ
attorneys.bio:
Kendal Sim graduated cum laude from Fordham University School of Law. While attending law school, he was a member of the Fordham Urban Law Journal. Kendal is admitted to practice before the state courts of New York and New Jersey as well as the U.S. District Court for the Southern and Eastern Districts of New York and the District of New Jersey.

Kendal began his legal career working primary in the commercial litigation department prosecuting and defending cases involving contract disputes, labor law claims and matrimonial law. However, Kendal also worked in personal injury department and successfully resolved numerous cases. After gaining valuable experience in the commercial litigation department, Kendal decided to devote this practice solely to personal injury law where he found helping those wrongfully injured due to the negligence of others to be the most rewarding aspect of his profession.

Kendal now focuses on achieving the individual goals required by his clients, taking into account the unique circumstances of each client to determine the best course of action. Kendal has settled cases pre-litigation to achieve quick and favorable results for his clients. He has also litigated cases when warranted, such as when the at-fault carrier presents unsatisfactory offers or attempts to disclaim liability. In sum, Kendal has a track record of obtaining favorable results tailored to meet the individual needs of his clients.

attorneys.name: Salvatore A. Simeone
attorneys.firm_name: Weinberger Divorce & Family Law Group, LLC
attorneys.practice_type: Alimony and Palimony Lawyers in Parsippany, NJ
attorneys.bio:
Salvatore “Sal” Simeone, Esq. is a partner at Weinberger Divorce & Family Law Group, LLC. Mr. Simeone is certified by the Supreme Court of New Jersey as a matrimonial law attorney, a designation of legal expertise earned by only a small number of attorneys statewide. Throughout his distinguished career, Mr. Simeone has dedicated his practice to assisting clients in all their divorce and family matters, with a special focus on high-conflict divorce cases, custody battles, custodial parent relocation, domestic violence, alimony, child support, and contested asset and complex business valuations, as well as the various facets of equitable distribution.

Sal Simeone was drawn to family law early on in his career while serving as a clerk for the honorable Judge Catherine Langlois in the Superior Court’s family division. He quickly realized that family law was the area of law where he could make the greatest difference in people’s lives. Decades later, his passion for family law and commitment to his clients remain unwavering. In every case he represents, Mr. Simeone guides his clients with great care and skill through even the most difficult and intricate of divorce and family matters, prioritizing open and honest communication at every turn. As he describes, “I’m very sincere and very candid with my clients. I give my clients a true assessment of their case when they sit down in front of me. I think that my clients can feel the sincerity across the table.”

In the courtroom, Mr. Simeone is a zealous advocate for his clients, fighting tenaciously to protect their rights. Drawing from his years of experience, he meticulously crafts smart legal strategies that position his clients for success. Mr. Simeone will pursue out of court settlement options whenever it is in his client’s best interests. His reputation as a formidable litigator is an extremely helpful tool for securing a fast and favorable settlement for his clients when negotiating with adversarial counsel.

Honed over his years of experience in family law, Mr. Simeone’s subspecialties include complex business valuations in divorce as well as child support and custody removal cases, where he has represented both mothers and fathers. He finds great satisfaction in making a positive impact in the lives of parents and children and is a fierce supporter of his client’s rights to their children. Mr. Simeone also handles adoptions, cases involving the Division of Child Protection and Permanency, and is often appointed as a Guardian Ad Litem and Parenting Coordinator by the New Jersey Courts.

Helping clients from throughout New Jersey, Mr. Simeone practices primarily in Morris, Sussex, Essex, Somerset, Union and Bergen Counties but has also practiced as far south as Monmouth, Ocean and Salem Counties and as far north as Passaic County.

Outside the courtroom, Mr. Simeone has volunteered his time to the Morris County Battered Women Legal Advocacy Program, where he consulted with victims of domestic abuse on a pro bono basis. He has also volunteered his time to present educational programs on behalf of the Women’s Center at the County College of Morris, Randolph, New Jersey.

Mr. Simeone was awarded his Juris Doctorate from Seton Hall University School of Law and is admitted to the New Jersey State Bar and United States District Court for the State of New Jersey.

Mr. Simeone is a Member of the New Jersey State Bar Association as well as the Morris County Bar Association. He has been named a New Jersey Super Lawyer every year since 2005 to the present. He is a former member and Sergeant at Arms of the American Academy of Matrimonial Lawyers (AAML) and also served as a barrister to the NJ Inn of the Court, North Jersey section. Additionally, Mr. Simeone was trained at the American Bar Association Family Law Trial Advocacy Institute in Houston, Texas for two consecutive years.

An active member of his community, Sal Simeone recently enjoyed coaching high school basketball at Columbia High School.

attorneys.name: Britt J. Simon
attorneys.practice_type: Wills & Estates Planning Lawyers in Somerville, NJ
attorneys.bio:
Managing Partner | Simon Law Group, LLC – Somerville, NJ

As Managing Partner of Simon Law Group, LLC, Britt J. Simon brings more than two decades of proven legal experience representing clients across Somerset County, Hunterdon County, and throughout New Jersey. Known for his strategic approach, courtroom skill, and unwavering client advocacy, Britt has successfully handled hundreds of matters involving family law, domestic violence, real estate, and civil litigation.

In his family law practice, Britt guides clients through complex and emotionally charged issues such as divorce, child custody, alimony, equitable distribution, and post-judgment modifications. He is also a strong advocate in domestic violence cases, representing both those seeking protection and those defending against restraining orders. His balanced approach—compassionate yet assertive—has earned him the trust of clients navigating some of life’s most difficult transitions.

Beyond family law, Britt has extensive experience in real estate transactions and disputes, including residential closings and contract negotiations. His background in civil and general litigation gives him the breadth and depth to resolve disputes efficiently, whether through negotiation or trial.

Britt is known for his direct communication style, practical advice, and commitment to achieving results. He takes pride in building long-term relationships with clients and ensuring that every person who walks through his door feels heard, informed, and well-represented.

attorneys.name: Rosemary Simon
attorneys.practice_type: Guardianships and Conservatorships Lawyers in Allenhurst, NJ
attorneys.bio:
Ms. Simon was fortunate to discover her passion for the practice of elder and disability law from the onset of her legal education. Ms. Simon received a Juris Doctor from the City University of New York, School of Law where she completed her clinical training with the nationally recognized Main Street Services Elder Law clinic. Since being admitted to practice law in both States of New Jersey and New York, Ms. Simon has devoted her efforts to the advocacy and practice of elder and disability law.

Ms. Simon is appointed by the New Jersey Superior Court to serve as attorney or guardian in adult guardianship matters. Ms. Simon also represents families seeking guardianship of their loved one who is a recipient of Division of Developmental Disabilities services. Further, Ms. Simon has engaged in family adoption matters.

Prior to her legal endeavors, Ms. Simon received her undergraduate degree from New York University. Thereafter, she was employed within the mental health field as a substance abuse counselor and eventually held the position of Clinical Supervisor of an outpatient drug treatment facility.

Jeffrey S. Simons is a partner in the law firm of Jacobs, Schwalbe, & Petruzzelli, P.C. He is admitted to practice law in both New Jersey and Pennsylvania, as well as the District of New Jersey and Eastern District of Pennsylvania Federal Courts.

attorneys.practice_type: Business Lawyers in Freehold, NJ
attorneys.bio:
With a background in both law and business, in the context of litigation, Jonathan D. Singer understands the importance of directing negotiations and communicating complex legal arguments with clarity and knowledge. Jonathan represents individuals and entities in a wide variety of business and personal litigation matters, and criminal defense, all across the State of New Jersey.

Prior to forming Singer Law LLC, Jonathan’s previous law experience includes co-founding the Singer Riviere Law Group LLC where he gained valuable experience in the practice areas of commercial disputes and transactions, personal injury, family law, criminal defense and bankruptcy law, amongst others.

When Jonathan was an undergraduate student at the Ivy League institution of Cornell University, he had decided he wanted to become an attorney, specializing in business law. However, as we all know, life happens and instead of going to law school, Jonathan entered the business world in the finance industry. But, after living in New York City during 9/11, Jonathan realized that it was time to do what he had always wanted to do and went back to law school to become a lawyer.

Jonathan has recently been named a Rising Star by Super Lawyers, a distinguished honor not awarded to many attorneys!

Jonathan resides with his wife and family in Monmouth County, New Jersey and enjoys running, working out and raising his children.

attorneys.name: Melinda L. Singer
attorneys.practice_type: Family Law Lawyers in Hackensack, NJ
attorneys.bio:
Melinda is Certified by the Supreme Court of New Jersey as a Matrimonial Law Attorney. Melinda is admitted to practice law in New Jersey, New York, Colorado and the Supreme Court of New Jersey. She is a solo practitioner in Bergen County practicing for over 40 years where her practice is devoted to Family Law. Melinda is a member of the Supreme Court of New Jersey Family Law Practice Committee, a past member of the Supreme Court of New Jersey Ad Hoc Committee on Trade Names, a member of the New Jersey State Bar Association, New Jersey Association for Justice, Bergen County Bar Association and Women Lawyers in Bergen. She has been the Chair of a Bergen County Early Settlement Panel since 1988, helping litigants to resolve their cases. Melinda is also a Special Ethics Master, as the Trier of Fact or Judge, for complex Ethics cases. Melinda is a Court-Approved Family Law Domestic Violence Economic Mediator. Melinda is also a court-approved Family Law Mediator. She is a Trained Collaborative Law Attorney and also trained as a Family Law Arbitrator by the American Academy of Matrimonial Lawyers.

Having litigated for several high profile clients, Melinda is often asked to provide legal commentary for TV stations, such as Tru TV, Fox TV and MSNBC, providing insightful legal analysis. Melinda has been a guest TV commentator since 1998.

Melinda is accessible to her clients first and foremost. She is committed to providing insightful and hands-on legal outcomes for her clients, whether it is a negotiated Property Settlement Agreement, a litigated Plenary Hearing or a Domestic Violence Trial.

More than anything, Melinda understands and "gets" the emotional turmoil impacting the client and impending divorce in Family Law. They are inextricably tied, and must be delicately unwound with sensitivity, so that the client is not lead down a path of "litigation through anger", which leads to excessive counsel fees, frustration and no resolution. Melinda also vigorously represents litigants that are unmarried, who need to resolve support and parenting issues. Melinda is accessible to her clients, and is passionate about the practice of law to help clients attain solutions.

attorneys.name: Tara S. Sinha
attorneys.practice_type: Estate Administration Lawyers in Florham Park, NJ
attorneys.bio:
Tara S. Sinha focuses her practice in estate administration, estate planning, and federal and state taxation. In the administration of estates, Tara helps her clients navigate some of the most difficult periods of their lives after experiencing the death of a loved one, including dealing with the courts, financial institutions, and managing disputes among family members. Tara also assists her planning clients to achieve effective estate plans that consider effective tax administration, family goals, and management of assets, including retirement accounts and planning.

Tara’s estate and trust administration services include probating Wills, preparation of federal, New Jersey, and New York estate and inheritance tax returns, gift tax returns, effectuating post-mortem planning techniques, and asset transfers, including closely-held business interests. Tara has administered thousands of estates, ranging from relatively modest cases to estates exceeding $100 million. She also has extensive experiencing engaging with federal and state authorities in examinations and audits of federal and state estate, inheritance, and gift tax returns, focusing on issues such as inter-vivos transfers, valuation discounts, generation-skipping transfers, and use of promissory notes.

For her estate planning clients, Tara advises clients regarding the development of estate plans that consider estate and gift taxes, as well as generation-skipping transfer tax, including Wills, inter-vivos and testamentary trusts, special needs trust planning, preservation trusts, Powers of Attorney, Living Wills, and other planning techniques.

Tara has served for many years as a member of the New Jersey State Bar’s Inheritance Tax Committee and is a member of the New Jersey State Bar’s Real Property Trust and Estate Section’s Board of Consultors. She is a fellow of the American College of Trust and Estate Counsel (ACTEC) and has been published multiple times in the New Jersey Law Journal. She is a frequent lecturer for the New Jersey Institute of Continuing Legal Education, New York City Bar, Practicing Law Institute, and other organizations. Since 2024, Tara has been named in the Best Lawyers in America for Trusts and Estates. To learn more about the selection process of these awards please click the following - Best Lawyers of America

attorneys.name: Martin P. Skolnick
attorneys.practice_type: Construction Law Lawyers in Roseland, NJ
attorneys.bio:
Practical, Forward-Thinking Legal Guidance

martin@skolnicklegalgroup.com

Martin has a rare combination of skills, experience and incredible determination that enables him to obtain exceptional results for his clients.

Martin P. Skolnick is the founder and Managing Attorney of the Skolnick Legal Group. Martin represents general contractors, subcontractors, and owners in construction litigation and arbitration matters. Martin also counsels construction companies and their senior management teams with the numerous legal issues construction companies encounter on a daily basis, including change order disputes, contract disputes, construction lien preparation and filing, permit issues, and employee issues. Martin also has substantial experience handling a wide range of commercial, real estate, and personal injury matters.

Martin began his legal career by serving as a law clerk to the Hon. Jamie S. Perri of the Superior Court of New Jersey. After completing his judicial clerkship, Martin joined a prominent commercial and business litigation firm in New York City where he represented Fortune 500 companies in a broad range of complex commercial and construction litigation matters, including construction disputes, domestic and international disputes, multi-million dollar contract claims, and injunction proceedings involving non-compete and non-disclosure agreements.

Martin was then offered the opportunity to join a New Jersey-based litigation and real estate firm where he headed up the firm's commercial and construction litigation practice representing real estate investment companies and closely held businesses in a wide range of matters including construction disputes, commercial litigation, and real estate litigation matters.

Thereafter, Martin left private practice to serve as General Counsel to a large construction company servicing major commercial and retail projects throughout the Northeast. During his more than five (5) years as General Counsel, Martin advised senior management teams and supported daily business operations with respect to all legal and regulatory issues including commercial contracts and disputes, litigation and risk management, business development, regulatory compliance, employment and human resources, intellectual property, and general corporate matters. He also appeared as counsel of record in numerous construction disputes in state and federal court in New York and New Jersey and successfully collected millions of dollars in disputed amounts owed to his client.

In his spare time, Martin is an avid reader and devoted athlete. He was a member of the Rutgers University golf team. After college Martin became a dedicated tri-athlete and runner. Martin previously completed two ironman triathlons and two marathons. While he no longer competes in long distance endurance events. Martin now applies that same focus, dedication, determination and persistence towards tirelessly working to achieve the best possible results for his clients.

attorneys.name: Shelley B. Slafkes
attorneys.practice_type: Bankruptcy Lawyers in Maplewood, NJ
attorneys.bio:
During my 30 year career I have practiced law in both the private and non-profit sectors. My practice is concentrated in the areas of consumer rights, bankruptcy and commercial litigation. In 1995, my husband Bruce Levitt and I decided to found our own firm, Levitt & Slafkes, P.C. so that we could focus our practice on small businesses and on individuals from all walks of life in both bankruptcy related and litigation matters.

My core belief is that you succeed by treating others with fairness and respect. When you sit down with me to discuss your difficult financial situation, I will treat you as a real person, with real concerns and not just another case number.

Here’s some of my background. I received my undergraduate degree with honors, in psychology from Brooklyn College and my law degree with honors from Emory University Law School. In 2008 I earned my Masters of Social Work with honors from Rutgers University and am a licensed social worker. I believe that my social work training and experience allows me to bring a unique perspective to the practice of bankruptcy and foreclosure law.

I have had articles published in the New Jersey Law Journal and have participated in the Bankruptcy Inn of Court and Max Gardner's Consumer Defense Academy

I have a long standing commitment to volunteerism and the importance of contributing to my community. I served three terms as an elected member of the South Orange Maplewood Board of Education. I have also mentored youth and served on numerous nonprofit boards including Family Promise of Morris County, Family Connections, South Orange Maplewood Community Coalition on Race and the Columbia High School Scholarship Fund. Additionally, in 2005 I had the honor of serving on the Governor’s Task Force on Mental Health, Children’s Advisory Subcommittee.

Laurence Slous is a partner in the firm's business and commercial real estate transactional group. His practice encompasses business entity formation, including limited liability companies, purchase and sale of small to medium size businesses, commercial real estate transactions, as well as business and commercial real estate loan transactions. attorneys.name: Amy Smith
attorneys.practice_type: Family Law Lawyers in Marlton, NJ
attorneys.bio:
Amy Smith focuses her practice on all types of matrimonial and family law matters. A highly accomplished family law attorney with more than 20 years of experience, Amy goes above and beyond for her clients.

Amy works with clients to ensure the most fair and equitable outcome and is accustomed to dealing with sensitive, emotional issues involved with family law. She represents her clients with a focus on settlement and will fight for what is in her client's best interest. Amy also has received substantial trial experience in family law matters, including divorce, dissolution of civil unions and domestic partnerships, child custody, child support, equitable distribution, pre-marital agreements, and domestic violence.

While serving as a Prosecutor in Burlington County, Amy garnered extensive experience in the areas of domestic violence, domestic violence weapon forfeiture hearings, criminal matters in municipal court, and drug offenses. Passionate about domestic violence matters, Amy is known for her experience in this complex field. She was named the Burlington County Bar Association's liaison to the Domestic Violence Working Group of the Prosecutor's Office.

Amy was honored as "Women's Advocate of the Year" by the National Association of Women Business Owners (NAWBO) South Jersey in 2019.

Amy is a founding partner of Women Owned Law. She is also a Matrimonial Early Settlement Panelist for Burlington and Gloucester counties. She volunteers with Project SARAH (Stop Abusive Relationships at Home), a domestic violence program, and serves as a Board Member for the nonprofit Volunteer UP. Amy is also a teen mentor for the Alice Paul Institute and has participated as a panelist for SJ Magazine's Women's Roundtable. In addition, she is an active member of the Burlington County Bar Association, Camden County Bar Association, and New Jersey State Bar Association.

Before entering private practice, Amy served as a law clerk to the Honorable Marilyn Rhyne Herr, J.S.C. in the Family Part of the Superior Court. Following her clerkship, Amy worked with the Burlington County Prosecutor's Office where she tried numerous jury trials as member of the trial team.

attorneys.firm_name: Piro Zinna Cifelli Paris & Genitempo LLC
attorneys.practice_type: Estate Planning and Administration Lawyers in Nutley, NJ
attorneys.bio:
Michelle Erica Smith joined the firm in 2013 and focuses her practice in the areas of estate planning, administration and elder law. Michelle is passionate about helping clients navigate the complex and often sensitive topics of estate planning or the loss of a loved one and the administration of their estate. In addition, she is skilled in aiding clients plan for the protection of their assets within the stringent Medicaid rules. Further, when a parent or loved one becomes incapacitated and can no longer handle their own affairs, Michelle is experienced in representing clients in Guardianship proceedings.

Michelle began her career as a Judicial Law Clerk to the Honorable Maureen B. Mantineo, P.J.S.C, in the Superior Court of New Jersey, Hudson County, Family Part. After practicing law in the matrimonial and family law field, she completed graduate studies and obtained an advanced legal degree, Masters of Law in Taxation (LL.M. in Taxation) from New York Law School in 2012. During her time at New York Law School, Michelle concentrated her studies on estate and tax planning, making her particularly skilled in these areas of law. Michelle is admitted to the New Jersey and Pennsylvania Bars, and the bar of the United States District Court for the District of New Jersey. Prior to joining the firm, she practiced with Levine DeSantis, LLC. In addition to her LL.M. in Taxation from New York Law School, she obtained a B.A. in Political Science from the University of Delaware (2004) and her J.D. from Widener University School of Law (2007).

attorneys.practice_type: Labor and Employment - Employer Lawyers in Mt. Laurel, NJ
attorneys.bio:
As Co-Chair of the firm's Labor & Employment Group, Mr. Smith focuses his practice in employment litigation and preventative employment practices, including counseling employers on the creation of employment policies, non-compete and trade secret agreements, and training employers to avoid employment-related litigation. He represents both companies and individuals in related complex commercial litigation before federal states courts and administrative agencies in labor and employment cases including race, gender, age, national origin, disability and workplace harassment and discrimination matters, wage-and-hour disputes, restrictive covenants, grievances, arbitrations, drug testing, and employment related contract issues.

Mr. Smith also counsels health care clients in reviewing employment contracts, negotiating restrictive covenants and handling actions related to the enforcement of noncompete provisions against physicians and other health care professionals.

attorneys.bio:
Serving Ewing, New Jersey, and the surrounding areas for more than a decade, the Law Offices of Sklar Smith-Sklar has established a reputation for being a client-focused and results-oriented legal team. We always strive to ensure our clients will find dedicated personal service and tenacious advocacy from attorneys who truly care about their success.

As a full-service law firm, we take pride in offering exceptional legal service to every client who turns to our law office. Our team works diligently to identify needs, customize strategies and pursue positive results. Clients in Mercer County and throughout the state can rely on our diverse range of experience, in-depth knowledge of the law and tenacious advocacy in all legal matters pertaining to the following:

Bankruptcy

Divorce

Personal injury

Criminal law

Immigration

Workers' compensation

From fighting for damages after suffering a serious personal injury that resulted in lifelong debilitation to helping other clients pursue a fair child custody order, our goal is your long-term success. Our law firm also understands that bankruptcy and other money-related legal concerns arise from some of life's most complicated legal issues. Our experienced team can help you determine if bankruptcy is the right path for you to overcome your debt issues, prevent foreclosure on your home and obtain a fresh financial start.

You can learn more about how the attorneys at the Law Offices of Sklar Smith-Sklar can assist you with your legal concerns by reaching out to our law firm and scheduling a free evaluation of your case today.

We are a debt relief agency. We help people file for bankruptcy relief under the U.S. Bankruptcy Code.

attorneys.name: John T. Somohano Esq.
attorneys.practice_type: Criminal Law Lawyers in Woodland Park, NJ
attorneys.bio:
John T. Somohano is a partner with the firm Bastarrika, Soto, Gonzalez & Somohano, LLP since 2008. He joined the firm on August 2004. He is a member of the BSGS Criminal, Municipal Court, and Worker’s Compensation practice groups.

Mr. Somohano represents clients in various areas of criminal law including, homicide/manslaughter, sex assault, drug offenses, and white collar crimes. He also represents injured workers suing their employers or complex DWI / driving offenses in municipal courts all throughout the State of New Jersey.

He has extensive civil and municipal court trial experience, and has persevered through several high profile criminal matters as well. Mr. Somohano has proudly served as assistant municipal public defender in the Passaic and Paterson Municipal Courts. Mr. Somohano also represents those injured at work to ensure their fair treatment in New Jersey through his Workers Compensation Practice.

Mr. Somohano received his B.S. from Rutgers University, New Brunswick, New Jersey in 1996. He attended and graduated from Thomas M. Cooley Law School in Lansing, Michigan where he earned his J.D. in September 2000. He is a lifelong New Jersey resident and was married in 2007. Mr. Somohano was born to Cuban parents and is fluent in Spanish.

attorneys.name: Franklin G. Soto Esq.
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Woodland Park, NJ
attorneys.bio:
Franklin G. Soto is a partner with Bastarrika, Guzman, Soto & Gonzalez, LLP. He concentrates his practice in the areas of personal injury, criminal defense, bankruptcy, commercial and civil litigation. He also handles all aspects of commercial and residential real estate matters, including but not limited to zoning, planning, acquisition and financing. His experience in these areas is extensive.

Mr. Soto began his career as an Assistant District Attorney in the New York County District Attorney’s Office. There he was charged with the prosecution of felonies, misdemeanors and violations of the law from arrest to their conclusion. He used that experience to fashion a litigation expertise. Mr. Soto has tried numerous civil and criminal matters before juries of this State and others.

His prior internships at the Essex County Prosecutor’s Office and for the Honorable Anne E. Thompson in the United States District Court of New Jersey have also permitted him to understand the inner workings of both the New Jersey Superior Court and the Federal Court system.

Mr. Soto has handled numerous personal injury matters and has successfully recovered millions of dollars for clients who have suffered injury as a result of the negligence of others. Currently, in addition to his civil and criminal practice, Mr. Soto also handles numerous matters before the Bankruptcy Court. He assists individuals and small businesses to navigate through insolvency proceedings as well as reorganization. In addition, Mr. Soto handles commercial and consumer real estate matters. He has tried many of these matters from partition to partnership disputes before the Chancery Courts of this State. Mr. Soto is fluent in Spanish and lectures regularly at seminars focusing on the purchase and sale of residential properties, bankruptcy and criminal law and has a regular featured column in a local periodical. Mr. Soto has also been featured as a commentator on local radio stations discussing various issues in criminal law.

If you are facing insurmountable debt, there are ways out. I am bankruptcy attorney Joel R. Spivack. For more than 20 years, my Cherry Hill, New Jersey, law firm has helped Delaware Valley residents overcome their debt and regain their financial freedom.

I provide comprehensive debt relief services; when you come into the Law Office of Joel R. Spivack, I will thoroughly examine your financial situation to help you reach a solution that best fits your needs. Whether you are considering Chapter 7 or Chapter 13 bankruptcy, a short sale of your real estate assets or any other debt relief tool, I will help you weigh your options and choose the best path forward.
