attorneys.name: Joseph C. Visalli Ret.
attorneys.practice_type: Arbitration Lawyers in Cherry Hill, NJ
attorneys.bio:
The Honorable Joseph C. Visalli (Ret.) served for 22 as a New Jersey Superior Court justice in Cape May County. He now serves the Ferrara Law Firm as "of counsel," and is available for arbitration, mediation and civil litigation. On the N.J. Superior Court, Judge Visalli spent two years in family court (1986-1988) and three years in criminal court (1988-1991) before spending 17 years (1991-2008) as the only judge hearing civil litigation. Prior to that, Judge Visalli spent six years as a Municipal Court judge in Wildwood and West Wildwood (1980-86) and North Wildwood (1983-86), while also maintaining a private practice.

A native of Philadelphia, Judge Visalli holds a B.S. in business administration from LaSalle University, and a J.D. from Duquesne University School of Law, where he was an editor of the Law Review. He is a member of the Cape May County Bar Association, the New Jersey State Bar Association and the New Jersey Association of Professional Mediators.

Prior to becoming an attorney, Judge Visalli served as a Lieutenant in the United States Army, teaching other officers in Fort Sill, OK. He is married to Jane and has two daughters.

attorneys.practice_type: Workers Compensation Lawyers in Belford, NJ
attorneys.bio:
Strong representation is important in injury claims-adversaries in court will often directly attack your right to fair and significant compensation, using tactics such as calling your honesty or injuries into question. When you are facing a tough battle, you want Attorney Celine Vitale by your side. Clients and colleagues alike know her for her intense passion for the rights of accident victims.

If you need a relentless fighter in your corner, call Celine Vitale at Levinson Axelrod, P.A. Her practice is solely devoted to advocating on behalf of those who have suffered as a result of negligence. While she is a fierce fighter in the courtroom, she provides nothing but empathy and compassion to her clients. No person is simply a case number to Celine-everyone's case represents real, human needs, and she will fight for the resources you need.

Celine has been practicing law for over a decade, focusing her work on Workers' Compensation, Personal Injury, and Social Security Disability Law. She has also addressed crucial legal matters before the Appellate Court in the Superior Court system.

Whatever the circumstances of your injury, need, or claim, she has the experience and strength to see your case through. With our firm's extensive resource and her personal approach, you will never feel abandoned or on your own while working with us. Celine's compassion and fierce determination in the courtroom is a hallmark of her practice, and is also a demonstration of the type of representation our clients can expect from Levinson Axelrod, P.A.

attorneys.name: Anthony M. Vizzoni
attorneys.practice_type: Estate Planning - Wills and Trusts Lawyers in Bridgewater, NJ
attorneys.bio:
The founder and sole Member of Vizzoni Law Firm, L.L.C., Anthony M. Vizzoni, Esq, earned his Master of Laws degree in taxation from New York University, and his law degree from Seton Hall University where he graduated cum laude. He also earned a bachelor's degree in finance from the W. P. Carey School of Business at Arizona State University. This level of knowledge and his 30 years of experience allow Anthony to effectively and efficiently represent clients to preserve family assets, meet client needs, minimize income, gift and death tax exposures, transition family assets or businesses, and provide for the controlled disposition of wealth from generation to generation.

Anthony’s area of practice and expertise is focused on estate planning, estate, gift tax and generation skipping gift and death tax, probate and estate administration, asset protection planning and elder law planning. This includes Wills, trusts of all kinds, appropriate beneficiary designations for non-probate assets such as retirement accounts and life insurance, business succession planning, planning with family limited partnerships and limited liability companies, probate, estate administration and elder law long-term care planning for Medicaid eligibility.

Anthony is capable of handling small and large estates whose needs range from simple to highly sophisticated and provides his clients with a sensible and comprehensive plan for the orderly disposition of wealth during lifetime and/or at death. Trusts and related plans designed to achieve gift and death tax savings and are used where appropriate.

Trusts for non-tax purposes are also used where appropriate. Examples include a trust designed to facilitate an asset protection or asset preservation plan, including self-settled Delaware Trusts and Dynasty Trusts, as well as Special Needs Trust designed to preserve government entitlements due to disabled persons. Another example includes trusts designed to achieve Medicaid eligibility. Where probate avoidance, privacy or estate lien issues are a concern, a Revocable Living Trust may be the appropriate alternative to a Will. Finally, Anthony recommends and prepares Durable Powers of Attorney and Living Wills/Health Care Directives as a part of all estate plans.

Anthony also helps families with probate and estate administration. His elder law practice includes planning for Medicaid eligibility and establishing Living Wills/Health Care Directives.

When planning an estate, many factors are taken into consideration including desired asset disposition, business succession, asset protection, trusts for dependents and the attendant tax implications. What sets Anthony apart from other estate planners is his personalized “listen first” approach which yields an estate planning product that is comprehensive and customized to each client’s stated needs, objectives and desires.

What sets Anthony apart from other estate administration attorneys is his personal attention to providing the guidance and direction, or, at the discretion of each client, the direct assistance required to identify and address all of the required aspects of the probate and estate administration process in an efficient and cost effective manner.

Anthony’s mission is to establish long term relationships by providing competent advice and service on a timely and attentive basis; maintaining open dialogue and communication during the course of any engagement; and providing personal accessibility to address client questions and concerns on a same day basis.

Hailey received her Bachelor of Arts in Political Science from Mount St. Mary's University in May 2017. She was a member of their Division I swim team and successfully completed a 15-year competitive swim career.

Thereafter, Hailey attended Elisabeth Haub School of Law at Pace University where she graduated cum laude in May 2021. During law school, she was a member of her school's Advocacy Honor Board and served as a moot court coordinator. She participated in several moot court and mock trial competitions. Hailey was also a member of her school's Family Law Society and served as co-president.

Hailey is admitted to practice law in the State of New Jersey. She is also a member of the New Jersey State Bar Association, the Bergen County Bar Association and the Barry I. Croland Family Law Inns of Court.

attorneys.name: Todd Wachtel
attorneys.practice_type: Worker's Compensation Lawyers in Raritan, NJ
attorneys.bio:
Todd graduated from the International Studies Specialized Learning Center at Freehold Township High School in 1990. He obtained a Bachelor of Science from Syracuse University in 1994. Following college, he earned his law degree from Widener University School of Law in Wilmington Delaware in 1997. He was admitted to the bar of the Commonwealth of Pennsylvania the same year, and the State of New Jersey in 1998.

Upon graduating from law school, he clerked for the Honorable Frederick P. De Vesa, J.S.C., and then went on to work in private practice. Prior to joining the firm, Todd was employed by the State of New Jersey as a Deputy Attorney General where he represented the State in Workers' Compensation claims throughout New Jersey. This learning experience was invaluable in teaching how to move cases through the complicated Workers' Compensation system today for Levinson Axelrod.

Todd has been a coach for numerous towns in high-school mock trial competitions, and sat on the Executive Board of Jewish Family and Children's Services of Mercer County. He is a member of the Justice Coleman Workers' Compensation Inn of Court, and counsel to the New Jersey Advisory Council on Safety and Health, and works with various other community groups. Most recently, he has been asked to serve on the Executive Committee of Temple Beth Chaim's Mens' Club, and will serve as President in the near future.

Todd argued Martinez v. Silverine, 361 N.J. Super. 99 (App. Div. 2003), which resulted in a published opinion from the New Jersey Appellate Division. Over the years, this case has become the major case involving how benefits are calculated for injured workers who suffer an amputation, and has been referenced and upheld by numerous other Courts. One-hundred percent of his legal practice is devoted to helping injured workers. He has aggressively obtained benefits for thousands of injured workers in the State of New Jersey, and enjoys finding creative solutions to challenging cases. He lives with his wife, son and daughter in Princeton, New Jersey.

Todd has been Certified as a Workers' Compensation attorney by the New Jersey Supreme Court.

attorneys.name: Chancelor G. Wahl
attorneys.practice_type: Employment Lawyers in Red Bank, NJ
attorneys.bio:
Mr. Wahl is an associate at McOmber McOmber & Luber, P.C. in the firm’s Marlton, New Jersey office. Mr. Wahl primarily focuses his practice on employment law and civil litigation, representing clients in matters involving discrimination, sexual harassment,retaliation, wrongful termination, and whistleblower claims.

In 2021, Mr. Wahl graduated summa cum laude from Ithaca College, completing all coursework in three years, with a Bachelor of Arts in Politics. While attending Ithaca College, Mr. Wahl participated in a group advocacy project to support an employee of an international humanitarian organization who had suffered racial discrimination in the workplace. Subsequently, Mr. Wahl attended Rutgers Law School – Camden on a Dean’s Merit Scholarship.

During law school, Mr. Wahl served as President of the Rutgers Environmental Law Society, working to promote environmental sustainability and provide resources for students interested in the field of environmental law. Mr. Wahl also served on the Rutgers University Law Review as an Associate Managing Editor. While serving on the Law Review, Mr. Wahl authored his Note exploring solutions to the epidemic of misinformation in American news media, which was chosen for publication within Vol. 77. In 2025, Mr. Wahl graduated cum laude from Rutgers Law School – Camden.

While in law school, Mr. Wahl served as a law clerk in both plaintiff- and defense-side law firms, experiencing the diverse and varying approaches to resolving legal disputes in litigation. During this time, Mr. Wahl served as a law clerk at McOmber McOmber & Luber, P.C., in the Marlton office, gaining valuable experience and serving clients in employment matters.

Mr. Wahl currently resides in Philadelphia. In his free time, he enjoys marathon training, discovering new things to eat and drink, and exploring the world with his girlfriend and dog.

attorneys.name: Kenneth M. Warren Jr.
attorneys.practice_type: Immigration Law Lawyers in Atlantic City, NJ
attorneys.bio:
Kenneth M. Warren Jr., Esq. completed his undergraduate at Seton Hall University in South Orange, New Jersey where he graduated with High Honors and received a Baccalaureate of Arts degree in History and Philosophy. During his time at Seton Hall, Mr. Warren was a member of the National Honor Society, member of Phi Alpha Theta, member of Phi Alpha Delta, and awarded the Annual George L.A. Reilly Award for Historical Research.

Mr. Warren began his legal career upon entering Rutgers Camden School of Law in Camden, New Jersey. Upon entry of law school, he was awarded the Vincent S. Haneman and Joseph B. Perskie Scholarship Award by the Atlantic County Bar Association and the Honorable Nathan C. Staller Law Scholarship Foundation Award by the Cape May County Bar Association.

During his years of legal study, he interned for a New Jersey Superior Court Judge in the Atlantic County Superior Court, Family Division, a New Jersey Superior Court Judge in the Atlantic County Superior Court, Criminal Division, a Federal Magistrate Judge in the Eastern District of Pennsylvania in the Federal Prisoner Re-entry Program. He also was selected to represent juvenile clients in the Rutgers Children’s Justice Clinic in Camden and Burlington Counties. He completed New Jersey Court Mediation training and New Jersey Domestic Violence Victims training where he volunteered his time helping the local community during hard times.

After graduating from Rutgers Camden School of Law, Mr. Warren was admitted to practice law in New Jersey and Pennsylvania and accepted a position as an attorney at Leonard Law Group, where the focus of his practice includes family law, immigration, civil matters and representing government entities.

Mr. Warren is currently a Partner in the merged firm of Leonard, Warren & Leonard LLC where he runs the immigration, family and government practices in the firm. He actively represents private clients and government entities.

He has represented clients from over 68 countries around the world in complex Federal matters. He is also a trustee of the Atlantic County Bar Association and an active member of the American Immigration Lawyers Association.

Mr. Warren represents, or has represented, many municipalities and counties, including but not limited to the Township of Hamilton, the City of Estell Manor, the City of Atlantic City, the City of Pleasantville, and Atlantic County, in the capacities of Solicitor, Conflict Solicitor, Redevelopment Counsel, Legislative Counsel and Litigation Counsel.

Mr. Warren also serves as Solicitor to the Atlantic County Republican Committee and advises as to political matter throughout the County and State of New Jersey.

attorneys.bio:
Hop T. Wechsler is a shareholder in Selikoff & Cohen.

Hop has represented unions and union members before the New Jersey Supreme Court, the Public Employment Relations Commission, the Office of Administrative Law, and other state agencies as well as in TEACHNJ tenure proceedings. Areas of expertise include tenure rights claims, workplace accommodation and discrimination claims, unfair labor practices, union representation petitions, tenure charges and other disciplinary matters.

Hop previously worked in Scientific, Technical and Medical (STM) publishing for 18 years, both in copyright permissions and as a journal publisher, and as a paralegal for an immigration law firm. During law school, Hop was also a research assistant for a law professor at Rutgers-Camden, focusing on public policy options for ensuring economic human rights, specifically the right to employment.

attorneys.name: Michael A. Weinberg
attorneys.practice_type: Alimony Lawyers in Marlton, NJ
attorneys.bio:
Michael Weinberg is Certified by the Supreme Court of New Jersey as a Matrimonial Law Attorney.

Michael has previously served as Chair of the New Jersey State Bar Association Family Law Executive Committee and Co-Chair of the Camden County Bar Association Family Law Section. He has been honored by being named in several editions of Best Lawyers in America and received the honor of “Lawyer of the Year” for Family Law in Cherry Hill by Best Lawyers in America 2022.

Michael is a frequent lecturer on matrimonial topics before various groups, including the New Jersey State Bar Association, New Jersey Institute for Continuing Legal Education, the American Academy of Matrimonial Lawyers, the American Trial Lawyers Association, and the National Business Institute.

His written articles have been published in the New Jersey Family Lawyer, where he serves as an Associate Managing Editor. He has also appeared on the television programs “Legal Lines” and “Legally Speaking” to discuss recent New Jersey matrimonial law developments.

Michael represents high-net-worth individuals, business executives, entrepreneurs, and their spouses in complex and sensitive divorce and other matrimonial matters. This includes negotiating prenuptial and postnuptial agreements and representing individuals involved in contested child custody and support matters.

Michael also makes himself available to serve as a mediator or arbitrator in family law cases. He has been an active member of the state and local New Jersey matrimonial bar and serves as a Matrimonial Early Settlement Panelist for Burlington, Camden, and Gloucester counties.

attorneys.bio:
Bari Zell Weinberger is a nationally recognized New Jersey divorce and family law attorney whose practice is devoted exclusively to matrimonial and family matters. As the Founder and Managing Partner of Weinberger Divorce & Family Law Group, LLC, she represents clients in all aspects of divorce and family law, including child custody and parenting time, child support, alimony, asset and property division, and complex financial disputes. Her approach is practical and client-focused, helping individuals make informed decisions that protect their children, financial security, and long-term well-being.

Bari is designated by the New Jersey Supreme Court as a Certified Matrimonial Attorney, a distinction held by fewer than 0.5% of attorneys in the state. This certification reflects her depth of experience, legal knowledge, and demonstrated skill in handling complex family law matters. For clients, it provides the assurance that their case is being handled by an attorney whose expertise has been rigorously vetted at the highest level.

In addition to litigation, Bari is a court-approved Family Law Mediator and is trained in collaborative divorce. This allows her to offer alternative dispute resolution options when appropriate and to tailor her strategy to each client’s goals, whether that means strong courtroom advocacy or a more private, solution-focused approach designed to reduce conflict, cost, and emotional strain.

As a widely respected thought leader in family law, Bari is frequently called upon by the media to provide insight on divorce and family law issues. Her commentary has appeared in national and regional consumer outlets including The Wall Street Journal, Forbes, CBS, ABC, and the New Jersey Law Journal. She is also the author of a comprehensive series of consumer-focused books and guides on divorce and family law topics, helping individuals better understand their rights, options, and the legal process. In addition, she has served as an editor and associate author of New Jersey Family Law Practice, a multi-volume legal treatise relied upon by judges and attorneys throughout the state.

Bari’s professional excellence has earned consistent recognition from both peers and clients, including an AV Preeminent® rating from Martindale-Hubbell, Super Lawyers honors, inclusion on the Best Lawyers in New Jersey and Best Lawyers in the United States lists, and multiple Client Satisfaction Awards. She has also been recognized as a Top Woman in the Law by the New Jersey Law Journal and as a Top 50 Woman in Business by NJBIZ.

Before founding her firm, Bari clerked for judges in the New Jersey Family Part, gaining valuable insight into how family law cases are evaluated and decided from the bench – experience that continues to benefit her clients today.

Clients who work with Bari value her combination of legal precision, strategic thinking, and genuine empathy. She is known for being direct, prepared, and deeply invested in helping clients move forward with clarity, stability, and peace of mind.

attorneys.bio:
Mr. Weinstein practices in the areas of Business Law, Commercial Transactions, Contract Law, Finance Law, Asset Protection Law, Government Contracting Law, Franchise Law, Debtor-Creditor Law, Health Care Law, and Intellectual Property Law. Additionally, Mr. Weinstein has extensive experience representing various major financial institutions. Mr. Weinstein has also served as General Counsel for numerous public and privately held companies. Mr. Weinstein is a member of the American Bar Association, Business Law Section; New Jersey State Bar Association, Business Law Section; New York State Bar Association, International Law, Contract & Commercial Law Committee. Mr. Weinstein has also served as the Chairman of the Electronic Funds Transfer Committee of the American Bar Association's Section of Science and Technology and was Vice-Chairman of the American Bar Association's Section of Science and Technology Computer Crime Committee. Mr. Weinstein in June of 2025 has been awarded the Lawyers of Distinction title and membership.

Mr. Weinstein was also Chief Executive Officer of Tekflow Inc., a company that provided comprehensive business technology solutions and consulting services to technology and investment banking companies. Mr. Weinstein has many years of experience providing corporations with practical, comprehensive technology business solutions as a technology consultant. He has consulted on numerous business development projects in the banking, educational, energy, software, telecommunications, and high-technology industries. Mr. Weinstein also served on the Board of Advisors to Duration Inc., a multinational software development company.

Mr. Weinstein received his JD from the Hofstra University School of Law in Hempstead, NY, and his BA in Political Science from Wittenberg University in Springfield, Ohio. He is admitted to practice law in New York and New Jersey. Mr. Weinstein has been admitted to appear before the United States District Court for the District of New Jersey and the United States District Court for the Eastern and Southern Districts of New York, as well as the State Courts in New Jersey and New York.

attorneys.name: Janell Weinstein
attorneys.firm_name: Weinberger Divorce & Family Law Group, LLC
attorneys.practice_type: Divorce and Legal Separations Lawyers in Hackensack, NJ
attorneys.bio:
Janell Weinstein, Esq. is an attorney at Weinberger Divorce & Family Law Group, LLC. Janell exclusively focuses her practice in matrimonial and family law, providing her clients with highly experienced representation in their legal matters including divorce, child support, alimony, custody, parenting time, relocation of a child out of the State of New Jersey, equitable distribution, complex property distribution in high-asset cases, post-judgment modification and enforcement matters, domestic partnerships and premarital agreements, domestic violence, and other related matters.

Janell is passionate about helping people navigate their legal issues, no matter how complex, and is especially sensitive to the difficult emotions and financial concerns often involved in divorce and family matters. She is a zealous and effective advocate for her clients, taking great pride in helping her clients reach their goals and arrive at a successful resolution of their case. Janell’s practical-problem-solving approach and calming professionalism give her clients great peace of mind every step of the way.

Drawing upon her extensive experience in the law, Janell is a highly skilled litigator with an esteemed reputation for protecting her clients’ interests in complex, highly contested divorce and family matters. She is equally adept at helping her clients resolve their matters through low conflict methods, including mediation, and will pursue out-of-court settlement opportunities whenever possible. Janell understands that every case is different, and carefully analyzes the facts and issues in each case to provide her clients with the representation and resolution method that best matches their needs and goals. Janell is extremely responsive to questions and takes the time to explain to her clients all aspects of their case so that they can make the best decision for their future.

Early on in her career, Janell had the opportunity to practice in other areas of the law in addition to family law such as real estate, foreclosure, creditor rights and personal injury. Whenever her clients’ family law matters involve these other areas of the law, she is able to quickly identify and understand key concerns and potential solutions. Janell will then work with her client to create and implement a plan that addresses all issues and safeguards her client’s rights.

Janell Weinstein is an active member of the family law community. She currently serves as a volunteer panelist in the Matrimonial Early Settlement Panel program in Bergen County Family Part in the Superior Court of New Jersey, and is also a Master in the New Jersey Barry Croland Family Law Inns of Court. She previously volunteered at the Women’s Rights Information Center in Englewood, New Jersey giving legal guidance to women contemplating divorce or dealing with family matters.

Janell is admitted to practice in the State of New Jersey, the State of New York, United States District Court, District of New Jersey and United States District Court, Southern District of New York. She is a member of the New Jersey State Bar Association, and a member of the Family Law Committee of the Bergen County Bar Association. She served on the Fee Arbitration Committee for three years and has been a panel member for matrimonial seminars conducted by the New Jersey Institute for Continuing Legal Education. Janell is also a member of Jewish Bar Association of New Jersey.

Janell has a distinct ability to explain legal principles in a way that people can understand. With her energetic personality, she is often called to give her expert opinion on television and radio. Janell appears as a guest commentator for Court TV and Your World with Neil Cavuto on Fox News.

She also appeared on Fox and Friends, CNN, HLN, Inside Edition, The Bill Cunningham Show, WPIX- NY, TruTV, LXTV-NBC and Daybreak (formerly GMTV) in the United Kingdom.

Janell was a legal correspondent for the “Vinnie & Me” show on Sirius/XM and discussed current legal issues on various radio programs such as 77 WABC with Rita Cosby. As a frequent guest on “The Ralphie Radio Show” which aired on 97 BHT in Pennsylvania and 92 ProFM in Rhode Island, she would talk about celebrity legal issues. As a guest on “The World of TJ McCormack” on LaTalkRadio.com, she discussed pop culture issues and family matters.

In addition to her television and radio appearances, Janell was a writer and contributing legal expert for FirstWivesWorld.com, a website that focused exclusively on family and divorce issues. She has been interviewed by many print media outlets to give her legal opinion. Janell has been quoted in newspapers such as the San Francisco Chronicle and Bergen Record.

Janell was born in London, England. She received a B.A. from Rutgers University, Douglass College. While in college, she was an Intern for the Northeast Midwest Congressional Coalition in Washington D.C., attending Congressional hearings and markups of legislation, and performing extensive research and written analysis of legislative issues at that time. Janell had unique experience, early on, to see and develop an understanding of the legislative process first hand.

After college, Janell attended Hofstra University School of Law where she was awarded a Juris Doctor. Upon receiving her law degree, she served as a judicial law clerk for the Honorable Jonathan N. Harris, in the Criminal Part of the Superior Court in New Jersey where she also mediated small claims and landlord tenant matters. Janell’s law clerk experience provided her insight to the workings of the court system and an understanding of New Jersey law and procedure. This experience has remained valuable throughout her legal career.

In her free time, Janell enjoys traveling and spending time with her family and friends.

attorneys.name: Bonnie M Weir
attorneys.practice_type: Business & Commercial Litigation Lawyers in Bridgewater, NJ
attorneys.bio:
Bonnie M. Weir is the founder of The Weir Law Firm, located in Bridgewater, New Jersey. She graduated from Seton Hall University School of Law in 1989.

Ms. Weir was admitted to the New Jersey State Court and the United States District Court for the District of New Jersey in 1989. In January 1990, Ms. Weir was admitted to the New York State Court and United States District Court for the Northern District of New York. She is also admitted to the Third Circuit Court of Appeals.

As an Assistant Attorney General for the State of New York, Ms. Weir gained substantial litigation and trial experience by personally handling 32 trials in two years. She defended the State and its agencies in tort and contract actions. She was also appointed by the New Jersey Supreme Court to serve on the District XIII Ethics Committee from September of 2006 through June of 2010.

Prior to founding The Weir Law Firm, Ms. Weir gained extensive experience practicing complex commercial litigation and bankruptcy in both New Jersey and New York. She also served as in-house counsel for a banking institution located in upstate New York.

Immediately prior to founding The Weir Law Firm, Ms. Weir spent eight years as a senior counsel with a law firm specializing in healthcare in Bridgewater, New Jersey. In that position, she represented members of the health care community in State and Federal court as well as administrative matters and hospital proceedings.

Ms. Weir is also an adjunct college professor with courses including Alternate Dispute Resolution and Business Law. She previously taught Collections and Bankruptcy.

At The Weir Law Firm, Ms. Weir uses her educational background in finance to guide her representation of individual and corporate clients in business/commercial matter, health care, family law, general litigation and appellate matters. Contact her today to schedule an appointment.

attorneys.name: William E. Wells Jr.
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Manasquan, NJ
attorneys.bio:
A well-established trial attorney in the area of personal injury, William E. Wells is a partner at the firm of Kitrick, McWeeney & Wells, LLC., and is certified by the Supreme Court of New Jersey as a civil trial attorney; a distinction held by less than 3% of New Jersey's attorneys. Mr. Wells works out of the firm’s office in Manasquan, New Jersey. Although concentrating his practice primarily in the counties of Ocean, Monmouth, Mercer, Middlesex, Burlington, Camden, Atlantic and Cape May, he has handled injury cases across all regions of New Jersey.

Completing his Bachelor of Arts degree in 2011 from The Citadel, Mr. Wells joined Seton Hall University Law School, from which he graduated in 2014 with his doctorate in jurisprudence. Since graduation, he has obtained licenses to practice in New Jersey and admissions to the U.S. District Court for the District of New Jersey and the U.S. Supreme Court. Before joining Kitrick, McWeeney & Wells, LLC, he clerked for the Honorable Judge Rochelle Gizinski.

Mr. Wells is driven by the passion to help people in need of legal assistance and has successfully won compensations as verdicts/settlements for his clients in various cases. Handling a wide range of cases involving injured workers or individuals due to medical malpractice, slip-and-fall accidents or motor vehicle accidents, he has gained the confidence of his clients with a compassionate approach and clear communication. He is also lauded by his clients for making the extra effort to keep them updated about the progress in their cases and in maximizing compensation for their injuries.

Moreover, Mr. Wells is a member of the American Association for Justice, the New Jersey Association for Justice, the New Jersey State Bar Association, the Monmouth County Bar Association, the Ocean County Bar Association, and is recognized as a member of The National Trial Lawyers, Top 40 Under 40 and the Million Dollar Advocates Forum.

attorneys.name: Thomas A. Whelihan
attorneys.practice_type: Estate and Trust Litigation Lawyers in Cherry Hill, NJ
attorneys.bio:
Thomas A. Whelihan, is the owner and managing member of the Whelihan Law Firm, LLC. Mr. Whelihan has been an active litigator for over 30 years. His practice is focused primarily on disputes involving estates, trusts, guardianships and related litigation, representing beneficiaries and fiduciaries. He also represents litigants in commercial and corporate disputes. Mr. Whelihan has tried cases and conducted hearings in both state and federal court. A significant portion of Mr. Whelihan's practice includes estate and tax planning, probate and estate administration, counseling families, individuals, and business owners in the range of issues surrounding the preservation and transfer of assets during life and upon death. In addition to preparing wills, trust agreements, powers of attorney and health care directives, Mr. Whelihan serves clients in trust and estate administration, probate and tax compliances and preparation.

After completing his undergraduate studies at the University of Scranton, Mr. Whelihan earned his law degree from Rutgers University in Camden, New Jersey. He was awarded a Certification in Estate Planning and a Master of Laws in Taxation from Temple University, Philadelphia, Pennsylvania. Mr. Whelihan is admitted to practice law in New Jersey, New York and Pennsylvania. He is a member of the New Jersey State Bar Association, Tax and Real Property, Probate Sections, and the Burlington Country Bar Association.

attorneys.practice_type: Workers’ Compensation Lawyers in New Brunswick, NJ
attorneys.bio:
Robert B. White, III has been a successful trial attorney and advocate for his clients since beginning the practice of law in 2002. He is a tireless and dedicated litigator who is as comfortable in Court as he is in his living room. He is originally from Philadelphia and comes from a family of successful attorneys who have been getting results for their clients throughout the Delaware Valley for 3 generations.

Rob has handled a vast number of complex and major cases in the areas of Workers Compensation, Criminal Defense and Personal Injury. He has maintained a winning record for his client's throughout his career by combining diligence in his preparation along with the ability to listen and understand people both whom he represents and who he argues to on behalf of his clients.

In addition to his work as an attorney, Rob likes to keep himself firmly planted on the street and in the workforce so he never loses his appreciation and understanding of the people he is helping. As an active volunteer firefighter and community crusader, Rob has learned the value of hard work, elbow grease and getting his hands dirty and he brings that same ethic and mentality to his representation of his clients.

Rob's experience and determination in his practice has led him to oversee the Workers Compensation practice for the entire South Jersey division of Garces, Grabler & LeBrocq. Supervising the Workers Compensation clients in both the firm's Trenton and Freehold offices allows him to bring his knowledge, experience and effort to all the injured workers that the firm represents from Mercer, Monmouth, Camden, Burlington and Ocean Counties.

Rob is a graduate of Ithaca College and the Widener University School of Law and is a licensed and practicing attorney in both the State of New Jersey and the Commonwealth of Pennsylvania.

attorneys.name: Robert B. White III
attorneys.practice_type: Workers’ Compensation Lawyers in Mount Laurel, NJ
attorneys.bio:
Robert B. White III is a lifelong resident of the Delaware Valley and has been a winning trial lawyer since 2002. He is a third generation attorney whose family has been collectively practicing law for over 100 years. Mr. White grew up in Cheltenham, PA and developed his sense of community and hometown pride in the Northeast Philly region. Mr. White graduated high school from Penn Charter in 1995. He received his Bachelor’s Degree from Ithaca College in 1999 with a major in Politics and extracurricular focuses in Journalism and Radio Broadcasting. While at Ithaca College, Mr. White achieved the distinction of becoming the first ever member of a freshman class to be elected to the Editorial Board of the school newspaper, The Ithacan. After graduating college, Mr. White obtained his Law Degree from the Delaware Law School of Widener University in Wilmington, DE. He spent most of his 3rd year of law school working as a Supreme Court-approved student attorney for the Montgomery County District Attorney’s Office. He directly and personally prosecuted many in-court criminal proceedings and established his love for being in a Court Room litigating cases.

After graduating law school and passing the bar, Mr. White became a staff trial attorney for the New Jersey Office of the Public Defender. Within his first year with that office, he became a lead trial team attorney and litigated dozens of winning jury trials as a senior trial lawyer. He then expanded his legal career into private practice, becoming a civil personal injury trial attorney while also continuing to handle private client criminal and municipal defense matters. Since then, Mr. White has successfully litigated a multitude of civil and criminal jury trials. But in that same time, Mr. White also expanded, and progressively focused, his practice towards the handling of Workers’ Compensation matters for employees and laborers who get hurt and suffer injuries as a result of and in the course of their employment. For over 15 years, Mr. White has extensively represented injured workers. He has obtained millions of dollars in benefits for his clients from their employers that regularly sought to refuse to properly compensate their employees. This progressive focus in Workers’ Compensation continues Mr. White’s first and foremost goal in becoming a lawyer in the first place. Which is to represent, battle, and win for regular, hard working people who find themselves forced to have to navigate a legal system that is not inherently designed to support and truly protect them.

In his free time, Mr. White is a volunteer firefighter of over 15 years and comes from 4 generations of City of Philadelphia career firefighters and volunteer firefighters from both Pennsylvania and New Jersey. He is also an avid Scuba Diver and Equestrian Horse Rider

attorneys.name: Scott M. Wilhelm Esq.
attorneys.practice_type: Criminal Defense/Municipal Court Defense Lawyers in Phillipsburg, NJ
attorneys.bio:
Scott M. Wilhelm practices law in New Jersey and Pennsylvania where he specializes in criminal defense, civil litigation, personal injury, bankruptcy, land use and real estate law. He is graduate of Phillipsburg High School, Moravian College (magna cum laude) and Villanova University School of Law. Upon graduation, he served a one-year clerkship for the Honorable John F. Kingfield, J.S.C., in the Superior Court of New Jersey, Warren County. He has engaged in the private practice of law and is admitted to practice before the United States Supreme Court, the United States Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit, the United States District Court of the District of New Jersey, the United States District Court for the Eastern District of Pennsylvania, the United States District Court for the Middle District of Pennsylvania and all Courts in the State of New Jersey and in the Commonwealth of Pennsylvania. He has tried fourteen criminal felony cases, including homicide, to jury verdict. He has represented thousands of clients in his areas of practice and regularly appears before petit juries, judges, arbitrators and mediators. Scott has represented thousands of indigent defendants in New Jersey municipal courts where he is recognized by the New Jersey Supreme Court as a certified attorney. He actively participates in continuing legal education including being a presenter. He currently represents two municipal Land Use Boards, serves as an arbitrator for the United States District Court for the Eastern District of Pennsylvania and the Northampton County Court of Common Pleas and is an active participant is bar association activities and is a past president of the Warren County Bar Association and Hunterdon County Bar Association. Scott is involved in his community and is an elected representative in his hometown. Scott has been recognized in New Jersey as a “Super Lawyer.” With nearly 30 years of experience, Scott believes that he has the work ethic, experience and legal acumen to continue to be a zealous advocate for his clients.

attorneys.name: Anthony Wilkinson
attorneys.practice_type: Business Law Lawyers in Edison, NJ
attorneys.bio:
A few months ago, I received an unexpected notice – a random ethics compliance audit was scheduled for my firm by our state. The letter, much like the stop sign at the end of my street, was abrupt and impossible to ignore. Suddenly, I was facing the daunting task of proving my firm’s compliance to a third-party auditor, with no assurance of what they might find.

However, I’m thrilled to share with you that after undergoing the ethics audit, I received a report from the auditors confirming that I was in 100% compliance with the standards they were evaluating. It was a gratifying affirmation of the dedication and diligence my firm puts into maintaining the highest ethical standards.

It’s possible your business is facing a crisis. You can visualize a great outcome, but you just don’t know how to make it a reality. You’re afraid of what might happen if you do nothing… but what can you do?

Some business owners know about the problem, but – for whatever reason – they choose to do nothing about it. Perhaps there are other priorities, and it’s just not that big of a deal at that point in time. Maybe they believe that the chance of an unfavorable outcome actually happening is so low that it’s not worth fixing the problem.

Other business owners know about the problem, they want to solve it, but they just don’t know how. “Where do I start? Can I do it on my own? Who can I turn to for help?” These common questions cause paralysis, and the problem lingers and festers.

Finally, there’s another group of business owners who know about the problem, want to solve it, AND they also know how to solve it. Their problem is that they are just not ready to take action at the current time. They may need more money. Or perhaps they need a large block of “free time” to initiate the project that will finally solve the issue. It could also be that there are other stakeholders that need to be convinced first in order to garner the support required for the project to succeed. This leads to more procrastination and delays as the problem only becomes worse.

I became a business attorney to help business owners like you. I attended Yale Law School, and during my studies, my focus was always corporate and commercial law. I even took a couple financial management courses while I was at Yale. But why business law instead of family law, immigration law, real estate law, or some other area of practice? Well, it’s because I have been an entrepreneur since I was about seven years old, when I made snowflakes out of paper and sold them door-to-door in my neighborhood. Not long after that, I ran the quintessential lemonade stand. Then there were the mail order greeting cards that I also sold door-to-door. And all of that was just in elementary school! In middle school, I was making potholders to sell to friends and family, and learning how to invest in stocks. After graduating college, I started small businesses in a number of areas, but none have been as successful – or as fulfilling – as running my own law firm. Since I have always had an entrepreneurial mindset, I chose an area of law where I could assist fellow entrepreneurs in achieving their dreams!

I am a teacher – albeit only occasionally as an adjunct professor at a local college and as a volunteer at my church. But nevertheless, I am a teacher at heart. I teach entrepreneurs, founders, and executives how to get their businesses from point A to point B. I want my clients to understand why they are in their current situation, why the destination is better than their current position, and the path to get to the destination. Most importantly, I want them to know how to keep the situation from ever happening to them again.

I am also a tenacious problem solver. That comes from my training as an electrical and computer engineer at the University of Michigan. I graduated summa cum laude at the top of my class, and then worked as a software engineer for a short stint before going to law school. I truly enjoy untangling the complex business issues my clients present, and giving them clarity about the path to a better situation.

But that’s all about me on the outside. What about me on the inside? Focusing on the inside is one of the elements that set me apart from other attorneys. I spend time considering how my clients (and their counterparties) think and feel. This significantly improves the rate of successful outcomes for deals and agreements. The key here is to understand expectations and to craft an agreement that satisfies said expectations. I love to read books, watch videos, and attend events centered around personal development, how people make decisions, and how people change. I’ve been studying these areas for decades, and this has made me a much better business attorney.

I am a man of deep spiritual faith. I have adopted a firm motto that describes the core values that I uphold not only personally with my friends and family, but also professionally with my clients: Trustworthy business advisors keeping your business on TRACK! Trustworthy. Reliable. Available. Caring. Knowledgeable. I exhibit these traits to please my God, and the inevitable result is that they also please my clients. To be “trustworthy” means that I look not to my own interests, but to the interests of my clients. To be “reliable” means that my “yes” means “yes.” I keep my word. I keep my commitments – even when it hurts. To be “available” means I make myself accessible to my clients on the same basis I make myself accessible to my closest friends. To “care” means to feel and to express compassion for another’s adverse situation, and to be willing to take action to alleviate it. To be “knowledgeable” means having the learning, understanding, and skill in the principles that are applicable to a given situation. Trustworthy. Reliable. Available. Caring. Knowledgeable. These are the five core precepts instilled in every team member at our firm. These are the important values we demonstrate to our clients. These are the key principles that make us who we are at Wilkinson Law.

Mr. Wilkinson attended the University of Michigan as an undergraduate, where he graduated at the top of his class in electrical and computer engineering before earning his Juris Doctor degree at Yale Law School.

Mr. Wilkinson began his legal career as a judicial law clerk for Chief Justice Robert N. Wilentz of the New Jersey Supreme Court. Following his clerkship, he was awarded a position as an associate in the Project Finance Group of the elite law firm of Dewey Ballantine in Manhattan. He has also served as president of an organization that managed the investment activities and tax reporting of the corporate general partner for a five-member investment partnership.

With his extensive background in technology, finance, and business law, including researching and writing his own patent, Mr. Wilkinson is well-positioned to analyze his clients' industries, business interests and legal needs, and to help them develop a road map for their success. He is skilled in clearly communicating complex legal concepts in a way that enables clients to confidently make the decisions that will best serve them and their companies.

To “care” means to feel and to express compassion for another’s adverse situation, and to be willing to take action to alleviate it. To be “knowledgeable” means having the learning, understanding, and skill in the principles that are applicable to a given situation. Trustworthy. Reliable. Available. Caring. Knowledgeable. These are the five core precepts instilled in every team member at our firm. These are the important values we demonstrate to our clients. These are the key principles that make us who we are at Wilkinson Law.

Mr. Wilkinson attended the University of Michigan as an undergraduate, where he graduated at the top of his class in electrical and computer engineering before earning his Juris Doctor degree at Yale Law School.

Mr. Wilkinson began his legal career as a judicial law clerk for Chief Justice Robert N. Wilentz of the New Jersey Supreme Court. Following his clerkship, he was awarded a position as an associate in the Project Finance Group of the elite law firm of Dewey Ballantine in Manhattan. He has also served as president of an organization that managed the investment activities and tax reporting of the corporate general partner for a five-member investment partnership.

With his extensive background in technology, finance, and business law, including researching and writing his own patent, Mr. Wilkinson is well-positioned to analyze his clients' industries, business interests and legal needs, and to help them develop a road map for their success. He is skilled in clearly communicating complex legal concepts in a way that enables clients to confidently make the decisions that will best serve them and their companies.

attorneys.name: Tara Jones Willecke
attorneys.practice_type: Family Law Lawyers in Livingston, NJ
attorneys.bio:
Tara has been practicing family law exclusively for twenty-one years and is Of Counsel.

Tara is known as a formidable attorney steeped in the facts of each client’s matter. Tara’s reputation highlights her ability in exploring avenues to settle family law matters and disputes outside of court, whenever possible, to minimize the “damage” to the family unit. Tara’s commitment is that litigation should be an option exercised only after careful consideration of the client’s objectives and a thoughtful discussion about the best way to attain those goals. Tara is known a straight shooter who counsels her clients and then employs the best strategy to accomplish the client’s goals.

*While Tara settles the majority of her cases (even if those cases are litigated for a time), there are situations that arise, in which fair and equitable settlements cannot be achieved, even despite great effort and attention. In these instances, Tara deliberately and strategically litigates cases on her clients’ behalf in both the Supreme Court and Family Courts of this State. Tara demonstrates her preparedness, is attentive to detail and is a zealous advocate for her clients. Tara is recognized for her familiarity with, and extensive knowledge of, her clients, their spouses and children. Tara is committed to taking the time to gather this information, in an immersive manner because this information is pivotal in determining whether and how a case can be settled or whether and how a case should be litigated to conclusion.

*Tara has acquired extensive experience counseling high net worth individuals (and their spouses) in connection with high conflict, emotionally charged and sensitive family law matters. These matters often include complex financial and valuation issues, tax issues and trusts and estates issues.

attorneys.name: Allison C. Williams Esq.
attorneys.practice_type: Family Law Lawyers in Parsippany, NJ
attorneys.bio:
Allison C. Williams is the Founder and Managing Partner of Williams Law Group, LLC with offices in Parsippany and Short Hills, New Jersey. She practices exclusively in the area of matrimonial and family law, with an emphasis on complex Child Welfare matters, including representation of parents in Child Abuse and Neglect matters, parents in Termination of Parental Rights matters, representation of foster parents, and consultation to matrimonial counsel regarding child abuse investigations and related issues. She has a statewide practice, currently handling matters in 16 counties across the State and in the Office of Administrative Law (OAL).

Ms. Williams has established an extensive career as an international speaker in the field of child welfare law, a national CLE provider to judges, lawyers, paralegals and the legal community, a statewide thought-leader appearing in various local and national news media, and a zealous advocate trying cases in every county in New Jersey.

Ms. Williams is a Fellow of the American Academy of Matrimonial Lawyers and is the first attorney in New Jersey to have become Board-Certified by the National Board of Trial Advocacy in the field of Family Law. She has served the New Jersey bar in a host of leadership positions, including serving as a member of the New Jersey Board on Attorney Certification (NJBAC) – Matrimonial Committee, a New Jersey Supreme Court committee that determine eligibility of candidates to be certified as a recognized practitioner in the field of matrimonial law; a member of the Family Law Executive Committee (FLEC) of the New Jersey State Bar Association (NJSBA), on which committee she lead the Child Abuse Law Subcommittee; and as past president of the Certified Attorneys Section of NJSBA.

She has served as an Editor on the Board of the New Jersey Family Lawyer, a publication of NJSBA distributed to family law judges and attorneys. Ms. Williams lectures frequently for several professional organizations, including the New Jersey Institute of Continuing Legal Education (ICLE), and her articles have appeared in the New Jersey Lawyer, the New Jersey Family Lawyer, and other publications state-wide.

An established thought leader in the field of child welfare law, Ms. Williams has been featured in a book about the Child Welfare System A Kid from the Bronx, by Dr. Norman Weistuch. She has appeared on the Katie Couric show to provide her insights on parents falsely accused of child abuse. She has been interviewed by numerous television, radio and news outlets on precedential child abuse rulings. Her website, www.NewJerseyDYFSdefense.com, formerly a Blog, has been cited by news media for the parental defense position on matters pending before the New Jersey Supreme Court.

Prior to entering private practice, Ms. Williams served as Judicial Law Clerk for the Honorable James A. Farber, J.S.C., in the Superior Court of New Jersey, Chancery Division – Family Part. Through that experience, Ms. Williams learned the inner workings of the judiciary and has used that knowledge the advance the interests of thousands of families across New Jersey.

Ms. Williams received her B.S., magna cum laude, and her M.S., summa cum laude, from Florida State University. She received her J.D., cum laude, from Syracuse University College of Law. Well respected by her peers, she has been selected for inclusion on New Jersey Super Lawyers Rising Star list continuously from 2008 – 2013, the New Jersey Super Lawyers List from 2014 – present, the Top 100 New Jersey Super Lawyers list from 2017 – present;, and the Top 50 Women Super Lawyer list from 2016 – present. For many years, she has been voted by her clients as New Jersey’s Best for Families.

attorneys.name: Karen Tichenor Willitts Esq.
attorneys.practice_type: Family and Matrimonial Law Lawyers in West Caldwell, NJ
attorneys.bio:
Karen Tichenor Willitts, Esq. is a divorce and family law attorney with Cipriano Law Offices, P.C.

With more than 26 years of dedicated experience exclusively in matrimonial and family law, Ms. Willitts is a highly regarded practitioner known for her depth of knowledge and compassionate advocacy. Her practice encompasses all areas of family law, including divorce, child custody and support, alimony, equitable distribution, complex asset valuation, adoption, and domestic violence matters.

Ms. Willitts provides her clients with thoughtful, creative, and compassionate representation tailored to their unique needs and goals. She takes a strategic approach to achieving the best legal outcomes while protecting her clients’ rights and the well-being of their children. Whenever appropriate, Ms. Willitts seeks to resolve matters through low-conflict methods such as mediation, promoting solutions that preserve dignity and minimize emotional and financial strain.

Ms. Willitts also recognizes that certain outcomes can only be achieved through court intervention. When litigation becomes necessary, she is a skilled and zealous advocate, dedicated to protecting her clients’ interests at every stage. Drawing on her extensive experience in complex matrimonial matters, Ms. Willitts has earned a reputation for guiding clients through highly contested divorce and family disputes with diligence, precision, and unwavering commitment—from initial filings through final resolution.

Ms. Willitts is attuned to the concerns of divorcing parents and the impact of family transitions on children. Her goal is to help clients resolve the complex and often emotional challenges of divorce in a manner that allows them to move forward with confidence and peace of mind.

Before beginning her legal career, Ms. Willitts worked as a financial analyst at Goldman Sachs & Co. in New York. She draws upon this financial background to navigate matters involving complex asset valuations, business interests, and the division of financial investments.

Ms. Willitts earned her Juris Doctor from Rutgers Law School–Newark and served as a judicial law clerk to the Honorable Amy Piro Chambers, P.J.S.C., in the Civil Division of the Superior Court of New Jersey, Middlesex County. She graduated from Rutgers University, where she earned her Bachelor of Arts in Economics.

Ms. Willitts is admitted to practice before the New Jersey Bar and the U.S. District Court for the District of New Jersey.

attorneys.name: Phillip C. Wiskow
attorneys.firm_name: Sarno da Costa D'Aniello Maceri Webb LLC
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Roseland, NJ
attorneys.bio:
Phillip C. Wiskow is Of Counsel at Sarno da Costa D’Aniello Maceri Webb LLC. Phil is also a Member of the Gelman Gelman Wiskow & McCarthy LLC law firm. With over 38 years of experience, Phil has successfully litigated more than 15 cases that resulted in settlements or verdicts of over a million dollars. He has also tried more than 125 jury trials to completion in the state and federal courts.

Phil is certified by the New Jersey Supreme Court as a Civil Trial Attorney. Less than two percent of all trial attorneys in New Jersey have earned this distinction. Certification involves a rigorous application process that requires lawyers to demonstrate a high level of experience and knowledge in civil law, successful completion of a written examination, and recognition by peers as having superb litigation skills and a solid reputation for professionalism and ethics. Phil has been certified for more than 25 years.

In 2009, the New Jersey Association for Justice (the state’s largest group of trial attorneys) asked Phil to argue an important case before the New Jersey Supreme Court. This was his second appearance before the Supreme Court that year. In 2013, Phil successfully argued his third case before the NJ Supreme Court and made “new law” in the area of ski safety.

Phil is passionate about social justice. He prides himself on his ability to take on cases most other attorneys would not even consider, and he wins many of them. Recently, he negotiated a $750,000 settlement on a case three (3) other law firms rejected. Phil’s mother was the victim of medical malpractice, and his motto is that the client always comes first, no questions asked.

Phil was born in Jersey City and raised in Wharton. He resides in Avon by the Sea, N.J., with his wife, Carey, and French bulldog, Hugo. He enjoys physical exercise, golf, reading, and traveling during his free time. He also enjoys most sports and hopes to watch “his Jets” win a Super Bowl again.

attorneys.bio:
Criminal Defense & Personal Injury Attorney

Gregg A. Wisotsky received his Bachelor of Arts degree from Tulane University in 1987, where he majored in Economics and was accepted in the Scholars and Honors program. He received his Juris Doctor Degree from Emory University School of Law, Atlanta , Georgia in 1990. While attending Emory University he was an active member of the Moot Court Society.

After graduating from law school Gregg moved to New Jersey where he sat for both the New York and New Jersey Bar examinations. Currently, he is licensed to practice in both New York and New Jersey and is authorized to appear in the trial and appellate courts in both states. Additionally he is licensed to practice in the United States District Court for the district of New Jersey.

I have the legal knowledge and experience to bring cases to successful results, but am not stuffy or elitist. I am equally comfortable interacting with brain surgeons and construction workers, CEO's of major corporations and laborers.

I am a regular person fortunate to do what I love, and who happens to be an attorney. I have a wife and four awesome children. My personal experiences have allowed me to be empathetic to people who have suffered a personal injury.

In the field of criminal defense, I live by the axiom that people are presumed innocent until proven guilty. I understand that innocent people are charged with crimes, that people who have limited culpability are often over-charged, and that even the guilty need someone to stand up for their rights. I provide a strong, non-judgmental defense to all of my clients.

Any attorney with integrity will tell you that they cannot promise a particular result in any particular case. However, a caring and skilled attorney will be able to point to their experience and their credentials as proof of their merit. I am distinguished by my experience, results, and the respect I have earned from legal professionals and the local community.

I have 17 years experience as a licensed attorney. I am licensed to practice in both New York and New Jersey . I have been appointed to the Board of Governors for the New Jersey Association of Justice, (NJAJ). Additionally, I have been appointed to be Co-Chair of the Criminal and Municipal Court section of (NJAJ). I am also a member of the Association of Criminal Defense Lawyers of New Jersey (ACDL-NJ).

I am happily married with four beautiful children, David, Jason, Nicolette, and Jessica. I actively participate in my children's athletic, musical and academic endeavors.

I also enjoy playing golf as often as possible and am a passionate Harley Davidson owner. I routinely enjoy traveling the countryside on my motorcycle with my wife and companion, Linda Wisotsky.

At the Law Office of Gregg Wisotsky, we practice in the following areas:

Criminal Defense

DWI/DUI Defense

Traffic and all Municipal Court Matters

Personal Injury and Wrongful Death

Workers' Compensation

Medical Malpractice

Product's Liability

Construction Site Accidents

Premises Liability

Car, Truck , and Motorcycle Accidents

Catastrophic Injuries

attorneys.practice_type: Estate Planning Lawyers in Florham Park, NJ
attorneys.bio:
Leonard J. Witman is a senior tax and estate planning attorney at the firm of Witman Stadtmauer, P.A. He is a respected authority in tax, estate, retirement benefits and deferred compensation law and a well-known national lecturer and author on these subjects. Before entering private practice, Lenny worked as a Tax Law Specialist in the Employee Plans and Exempt Organizations Division for the Internal Revenue Service.

Lenny has extensive experience counseling clients regarding employee benefits such as 401(k) plans, profit sharing plans, defined benefit plans, cash balance plans, 403(b) plans, 457 plans, executive compensation, non-qualified deferred compensation, 409A compliance, health and other welfare benefit plans, cafeteria (Section 125) plans and other fringe benefits. In addition, he represents clients in audits before government agencies.

In 2020, Lenny was awarded the Dorothy G. Black Distinguished Service Award. This award recognized his distinguished service to the Trust and Estate part of the Real Property, Trust and Estate law section of the New Jersey State Bar Association for his work in trust and estate law in New Jersey. Lenny has held numerous leadership roles in professional organizations, including the American College of Trust and Estate Counsel (serving as the former New Jersey chair) and the American College of Employee Benefit Counsel. He has chaired the New Jersey State Bar Association Employee Benefits Committee and Taxation Section. He is also the author of books and has taught law at Seton Hall Law School and Rutgers University Graduate Business School. Lenny has been recognized in The Best Lawyers in America each year since 1995 and has been recognized as a New Jersey Super Lawyers. attorneys.name: Andrew M. Wolfenson
attorneys.practice_type: Probate and Probate Litigation Lawyers in Union, NJ
attorneys.bio:
Attorney Andrew Wolfenson, the founder and senior partner of the firm, has maintained his practice in Union Township for over 30 years. He practices in courts throughout North and Central New Jersey, and his reputation for reaching pragmatic solutions to complex situations, as well as his acumen in the varied fields of Estates, Real Estate, Family Law, and Litigation has led to his appointment by the court, on numerous occasions, to serve as the Administrator of contested estates, as well as mediator or fiscal agent in contested litigations.

Mr. Wolfenson’s zealous advocacy on his clients’ behalf, and his continuing concern for the rights of non-custodial parents, resulted in a New Jersey appeals court establishing a new standard by which a custodial parent is permitted to relocate within the state in the case of A.J. v. R.J., 461 N.J. Super. 173 (App. Div. 2019). Now, the “best interests” of the children must be considered by the court before allowing a custodial parent to relocate within the state, as opposed to the prior, far more permissive, standard.

Awarded the prestigious honor of being named to “Lawyers of Distinction,” he has also been recognized as one of New Jersey’s “Top Attorneys for Families” by New Jersey Family Monthly, a distinction earned through client votes for seven consecutive years. Andrew was selected as a Super Lawyer for 2025 and 2026. Being selected as a Super Lawyer is a prestigious honor that signifies recognition of an attorney’s exceptional professional achievements and peer recognition. It reflects a high degree of respect within the legal community, as the selection process involves rigorous evaluation based on peer nominations, independent research, and professional accomplishments. This distinction highlights not only legal expertise but also ethical practice and dedication to clients. For clients and colleagues, a Super Lawyer designation serves as a mark of credibility and excellence in the legal field.

In his spare time, Attorney Wolfenson is an avid baseball fan and serves as Commissioner of a fantasy baseball league. He is also an accomplished author, having published several novels, including two legal thrillers. His first work, In His Own Defense, introduces the main character, Eric Goldberg, an attorney based in Elizabeth, New Jersey, and explores the limitations of the attorney-client privilege while taking readers from Elizabeth to São Paulo, Brazil. In the sequel, In His Ex-Wife’s Defense, Goldberg represents his ex-wife in a case centered on New Jersey’s texting and driving laws, while also examining politics and the relationship between politicians and the media. He is also nearing the fulfillment of his lifelong goal of attending a game in every Major League Baseball city.

The third book, Deadly Fantasy: A Baseball Story, focuses on one man’s obsession with winning his fantasy baseball league to the detriment of other aspects of his life. It also provides readers with a critical comparison of the current statistics-based approach to evaluating baseball players versus the more traditional, “human” approach to player selection.

attorneys.name: Tiffany M Yacullo
attorneys.practice_type: Employment Lawyers in Red Bank, NJ
attorneys.bio:
Ms. Yacullo is an Associate Attorney at McOmber McOmber & Luber, P.C. in Red Bank, New Jersey. She handles predominantly employment litigation matters, including discrimination, sexual harassment, retaliation, wrongful termination, and whistleblower claims. Ms. Yacullo zealously advocates for her clients to ensure their voices are heard and justice is rightfully served.

In 2017, Ms. Yacullo graduated magna cum laude from Seton Hall University where she earned her Bachelor of Arts in Journalism. Afterward, Ms. Yacullo attended New York Law School on a Dean’s Merit Scholarship. She earned her Juris Doctor from New York Law School in 2020 and was admitted to the New Jersey Bar in 2021.

During law school, Ms. Yacullo worked at Wall Street-based law firm Robert Wisniewski, P.C. as a Summer Associate. In this position, she assisted in the successful litigation of fair wages, workplace discrimination, harassment, and retaliation matters. Additionally, Ms. Yacullo was selected to participate in the prestigious, year-long Prosecution Clinic of the King’s County District Attorney’s Office in Brooklyn, New York. Through these experiences, Ms. Yacullo discovered her unwavering dedication to social justice and advocacy.

Upon graduation, Ms. Yacullo returned to her home state, New Jersey, where she served as the 2020-2021 Judicial Law Clerk to the Honorable John I. Gizzo, J.S.C., Essex Vicinage, Criminal Division. During her clerkship, she performed extensive legal research for various criminal issues, drafted memoranda for the judge, and edited and drafted all opinions and orders of the court.

In 2021, Ms. Yacullo took a position as an Assistant Prosecutor at Essex County Prosecutor’s Office. Ms. Yacullo initially worked in the Domestic Violence Unit where she handled approximately 120 active cases and later worked in the Special Remand Court where she handled approximately 300 active cases. In these assignments, she evaluated and prosecuted criminal cases from arraignment to trial. By consistently reviewing discovery, negotiating pleas, and appearing at court proceedings, Ms. Yacullo gained strong analytical and problem-resolution skills. Moreover, through motion practice, witness interviewing and trial preparations, Ms. Yacullo became proficient in and passionate about case strategy and evidence investigation. Ms. Yacullo conducted several trials during her tenure as a prosecutor and secured favorable outcomes for the State and victims in these cases.

Now, as an Associate, Ms. Yacullo utilizes her legal background to effectively advocate for employees treated unjustly in the workplace to achieve positive results and improved circumstances.

attorneys.name: Narae Yim
attorneys.practice_type: Commercial Litigation (Civil) Lawyers in Palisades Park, NJ
attorneys.bio:
Narae Yim, Esq. is a dual-licensed attorney admitted to both the Korean Bar and the New York State Bar.

She graduated magna cum laude from Yonsei University Law School and she ranked 7th out of over 3,000 candidates in the 2017 Korean Bar Exam, being admitted as a lawyer shortly after.

Narae began her legal career at Bae, Kim & Lee LLC (“BKL”) (법무법인(유한)태평양), one of South Korea’s most prestigious law firms. Over six years in BKL’s Corporate Practice Group, she advised domestic and multinational clients, such as Samsung, LG, SK, Hyundai, and Lotte. During her practice, she has covered a wide range of legal matters, including:

Mergers & Acquisitions (M&A): Regulatory filings, due diligence, and contract drafting.

Civil Litigation: Contract disputes, breaches of share purchase agreements, and product warranties.

Criminal Defense: Bribery allegations and breaches of fiduciary duty.

Compliance: Corporate governance, data privacy, competition law, and employment matters.

Secondments: Served as in-house legal counsel at major companies, including ByteDance (TikTok) Korea, LG Chem Ltd., and the Korean branch of an overseas financial group.

In 2023, Narae relocated to the U.S. to enrich her legal career. She earned a Master of Laws (LL.M.) degree in Corporation Law from NYU School of Law and subsequently passed the State of New York State Bar Exam. She is now admitted to practice in New York and qualified for admission in all 40 other states participating in the Uniform Bar Exam (UBE).

At Kim, Lim and Partners (“KLP”), Narae specializes in the prosecution and defense in complex commercial/business litigations involving breach of contract, partnership dispute business litigation, business fraud, and shareholder disputes.

A native Korean speaker, Narae is able to provide service to Korean clients without language barrier and is able to represent clients in matters involving a heavy load of documents in Korean without obstacle.

attorneys.name: Amanda Yu
attorneys.practice_type: Family and Matrimonial Law Lawyers in Hackensack, NJ
attorneys.bio:
Amanda M. Yu joined Lesnevich, Marzano-Lesnevich, O'Cathain & O'Cathain, LLC, as an associate in 2017. Born and raised in New Jersey, Amanda earned her B.A. from Rutgers University as part of the last graduating class of Rutgers College. She then earned her J.D. from Fordham University School of Law in May of 2014.

Amanda began her legal journey when she interned at Central Jersey Legal Services in New Brunswick while attending Rutgers. She became determined to attend law school and her passion for family law was ignited. Amanda stays close to the Rutgers community through her work with the Office for Violence Prevention and Victim Assistance conducting trainings and information sessions for students, faculty, and staff on temporary and final restraining orders.

While in law school, Amanda joined the Domestic Violence Action Center through which she became a trained Courtroom Advocate for Sanctuary for Families assisting domestic violence victims in obtaining Orders of Protection. Amanda was also awarded the prestigious Deborah T. Poritz Summer Public Interest Legal Fellowship through which she was able to return to CJLS and practice under R.1:21-3(b). Amanda was also selected to participate in Fordham's Family Advocacy Clinic where she fought tirelessly to prevail against the New York City Department of Education on behalf of underprivileged students seeking a free, appropriate, public education. She then became a Teaching Assistant for the clinic and guided other students in their casework as well as maintained her own caseload. For her time and dedication, Amanda was awarded the Archibald R. Murray Public Service Award, summa cum laude, for completing more than 1000 hours of pro bono or community service work during law school.

In addition to gaining invaluable experience during her time at Fordham, Amanda was elected to be the Student Bar Association President and served in that capacity during her final year of law school. She continues to be involved in the Fordham Law community through her membership of the Fordham Law Alumni Association and the Recent Graduates Committee. She also serves as an executive board member on the Fordham Alumni Attorneys of Color - New Attorneys Division.

After graduation from law school, Amanda served as judicial law clerk to the Honorable Linda E. Mallozzi, J.S.C. She began her clerkship assigned to the non-dissolution, domestic violence, and contempt cases, but spent the majority of her year handling dissolution cases.

Amanda practices exclusively in the field of family and matrimonial law. She is admitted to practice in New Jersey, the District of New Jersey, and New York. Amanda is a member of the Family Law Section and Young Lawyers Division of the New Jersey State Bar Association, the Somerset County Bar Association, the Union County Bar Association, the New York State Bar Association, and the American Bar Association.

Awards and Honors

Honors

Deborah T. Poritz Summer Public Interest Legal Fellowship

attorneys.name: Jack S. Zakim
attorneys.firm_name: Kates Nussman Ellis Earle & Landolfi LLP
attorneys.practice_type: Real Estate Lawyers in Hackensack, NJ
attorneys.bio:
Jack Zakim is a partner of Zakim & Zakim, P.C. and has been of counsel to Kates Nussman Ellis Earle & Landolfi LLP since 2005. He is also of counsel to the firm of Schulman Blitz, LP where he maintains a New York City office.

Jack is a graduate of the University of Cincinnati where he received his Bachelor of Arts degree in 1967. After enrolling in law school at the George Washington University National Law Center (GW) in Washington, D.C. for one year in 1967, Jack spent the next 3 years in the entertainment industry producing musical events in numerous venues before returning to G.W. law school where he received his juris doctor degree in 1973. Jack was admitted to practice in New Jersey, inclusive of the United States District Court for the District of New Jersey in 1973 and has been a continuous member of the Bergen County and New Jersey Bar Associations ever since.

Jack spent the first 25 years of his professional career running a successful solo practice with several associates. During the course of those 25 years Jack maintained a litigation and transaction practice with personal responsibility for a variety of disciplines. Thereafter Jack was a senior partner for 7 years at the firm of Kleeblat, Galler, Abramson, Davidson & Zakim in Hackensack, New Jersey where he concentrated on commercial transactions and commercial litigation, with an emphasis in commercial real estate.

In recent years Jack has devoted a substantial portion of his practice to commercial real estate transactions including leasing, financing, foreclosure, tax appeals, development, condemnation, sales and acquisitions, and counts among his clientele private and publicly held companies and local and regional institutional and private real estate lenders, developers and brokers.

Jack is a conscientious professional with a reputation amongst his peers as a dedicated and zealous advocate for his clients. Jack’s competitive nature as an advocate can be traced to his years as a competitive athlete. Jack was an N.C.A.A. all american swimmer and continues to foster his athletic prowess by competing in the United States Master Swimming Association meets and is consistently ranked nationally and internationally in several events. He also competes as a triathlete, in local and regional events throughout the year.

Jack has been active in many communal organizations and has served as a trustee in his synagogue, the Jewish Federation of North Jersey, the North Jersey YM/YWHA, and the Jewish Historical Society of North Jersey.

Awards and Honors

Honors

Legal Services of New Jersey Equal Justice Medal, 2019
